UQOLOTHAKAMANGO womculi we-kwaito, uThebe, ugubha iminyaka engu-30 esemculweni ngokuhlanganisa iqophamlando elizochaza konke ngempilo yakhe.

UThebe uzakhele udumo ngezingoma okubalwa kuzo iGroovers Prayer, Ungawa Kum, Safety Belt nezinye.

Muva nje upikwe engomeni ka-Abidoza ethi Bophilo Bo noKabza De Small noScotts Maphuma.

Ekhuluma naleli phephandaba, uThebe (53) uthe ukuhlanganisa iminyaka engu-30 ecula yiyona nto enkulu aseke ayizuza.

"Uhambo belunezingqinamba, kwehla kuphinde kunyukele. I-kwaito sayiqala phansi kunzima kodwa kube kuhle konke ngoba umuntu ukwazile ukukhulisa izingane waba nomndeni," kusho uThebe.

Uthe ababaningi abantu abakwazi ukuhlanganisa le minyaka becula.

"Okubalulekile ukuthi uhloniphe umsebenzi ungathathi kancane abalandeli. Kuthathele phezulu noma kuyinto yezokungcebeleka kodwa ihloniphe. Ngike ngibone abamanje bayatefa kakhulu. Uma uya emsebenzini usuke ungayi otshwaleni. Ukunikezwa iziphuzo akumele kube yimpoqo kodwa kusuke enhliziyweni yokuqashile ukuze ukhululeke. Ukuhamba nabantu abaningi ngeke kukubuyisele ngalutho kunalokho badonsela wena emuva. Uma uba nenkinga abaveli bona kuvela igama lakho," kuchaza uThebe.

Uthe umatasa nokuhlanganisa iqophamlando elikhuluma ngempilo yakhe nebanga aselihambile emculweni.

"Senza kabusha nezingoma zami ezizohambisana nalo iqophamlando. Nginethemba lokuthi lizophuma ngasekupheleni konyaka ngoba sesineminyaka emibili siqalile."

Uthe ufuna ukuxoxa ngempilo yakhe aveze ukuthi udlondlobale kanjani ngethemba lokugqugquzela abanye ngoba baningi bebuza.

I-AFRICAN National Congress (ANC) isobishini njengoba seyize yafakwa eNkantolo eNkulu yaseGoli ngenxa yezinsolo zokugweva nemali yamaciko ewu-R423 228, 75.

Isolezwe lithole ukuthi le nhlangano ezinze eLuthuli House eGoli igqigqiswa kule nkantolo yinhlangano eqoqa imali ngomculo osuke udlalwe emisakazweni naseziteshini zethelevishini iSouth African Music Rights Organisation (Samro) ngenxa yomculo owadlalwa kwiSiyanqoba Rally eyayiseFNB Stadium ngo-2024.

Ukunqwaha kwale nhlangano nalesi samba esicishe sibe yingxenye yesigidi kuphoqe abaholi beSamro ukuba bafake amaphepha enkantolo ngenhloso yokuphoqa i-ANC ukuba ikhokhe  isikweletu.

Ebuzwa yiSolezwe ngalezi zindaba, okhulumela i-ANC kuzwelonke, uMahlengi Bhengu Motsiri, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi asefikile amaphepha asenkantolo ekomkhulu lale nhlangano. Uvele washaya ngezimfishane wathi basasifunda isinqumo senkantolo.

"Sizobe sesichaza kabanzi ngesinyathelo esizothathwa emuva kwalokho."

Isolezwe libuye lathola ukuthi kufakwana enkantolo nje kungenxa yesivumelwano esenziwa yisikhulu seSamro uKarabo Senna nemenenja jikelele ye-ANC uPatrick Flusk ngoJuni 24, 2024.

Lesi sivumelwano esibhalwe phansi sasigunyaza i-ANC ukuba idlale ngokukhululeka umculo oqanjwe amaciko angamalungu eSamro kunoma yikuphi lapho kuhlangene khona amalungu kaKhongolose.

Nebala kwiSiyanqoba Rally zaqhululwa izingoma zamaciko anganyelwe yiSamro. Emuva kwalokho abakwaSamro babe sebethumela i-invoice emahhovisi ale nhlangano ngenhloso yokuba bakhokhelwe imali.

Esikhundleni senkokhelo kuthiwa ubuholi bale nhlangano sebubhala buyacisha, bubamba buyayeka, budla amazambane ashisayo. Phezu koxhaxha lwezincwadi esezibhalelwe i-ANC kodwa kunhlanga zimuka nomoya.

Oyisikhulu ophikweni lwezokuxhumana kwaSamro, uNthabiseng Motsei, ucashunwe ekuqinisekisa ukuthi umacashelana abawudlaliswa yi-ANC sewubame emphinjeni. Uthe le mali abayifuneli bona kodwa bafuna ukuyidlulisela emacikweni okwadlalwa izingoma zawo eralini ye-ANC.

Isolezwe like labika ukuthi iSamro ayisakugunyazi ukuba kudlalwe umculo wamalungu ayo emicimbini ehlanganisa abantu kungekho sivumelwano nabagqugquzeli. Sekudingeka umgqugquzeli womcimbi abathumelele uhlu lwezingoma ezidlaliwe njengoba kwenziwa emsakazweni.

Unxuse abalandeli abamthanda ngeqiniso ukuba bengamfaki emincintiswaneni ngenxa yokusabela umsebenzi awenzela bona. Uthe imincintiswano igcina seyimenza agcine esecula ngenhliziyo embi ngenxa yobuhlungu.

"Mina ngiyeneliseka ngoxhaso abanginikeza lona ko-Apple Music, Spotify nakwiYouTube."

Kwenzeka lokhu nje, nango-2024 akubanga kuhle nakubalandeli bomculi waseMzimkhulu, uSolwazi, emuva kokuba iQuantum liwinwe wumculi wasoPhongolo, uGatsheni.

UMA ungeneme ngemiphumela yakho ka-matric, ucabanga ukuthi kabalenzanga iqiniso, zikhona ezinye izindlela ongazenza ukuze ugcine wenelisekile.

Kulezi zindlela kufaka ukuthi ucele ukuphinde umakelwe kabusha izifundo zakho, noma ufune ukubona iphepha olibhalile ukuthi limakwe kanjani.

Ngokolwazi olukhishwe nguMnyango wezeMfundo eyisiSekelo, uma ufuna ukubheka ukuthi iphepha limakwe kanjani, noma ufuna ukulibona lonke lelo phepha olibhalile kuzokudla u-R230. Uma ufuna ukumakelwa kabusha kubiza u-R120.

Izicelo zokwenza lokhu zivulwe namhlanje kanti kuvalwa emva kwezinsuku eziyisikhombisa kudedelwe imiphumela ka-matric.

Ulwazi luveza ukuthi imiphumela yokuphinde umakelwe kabusha izokhishwa ngoMashi 7, 2025. Le miphumela izotholakala esikhungweni obhalele kusona.

Kulabo abafuna ukuphucula izifundo zabo, bangafaka izicelo zokuthi babhale izivivinyo zokuchibiyela ezingoMeyi/Juni nonyaka.

Usuku lokuvala ukufaka izicelo zokuphinde ubhale uFebhuwari 7.

“Abangabhalanga kumele balethe ubufakazi obukhomba ukuthi ababhalanga ngenxa yokuthi babegula, kwakushoniwe ekhaya noma ezinye izizathu ezinqala. Ukuze babhalise kumele babe namamaki aziwa nge-School Based Assessment (SBA),” kusho umnyango.

Nalabo ababhala u-matric omdala, kusuka ngo-2008 kuya manje, abafuna ukuphucula imiphumela yabo, basenalo ithuba lokwenza lokhu ngokuthi babhale ngoMeyi/Juni nonyaka.

Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ubonga ugogo nomkhulu abamkhulisile wakwazi ukuzimisela.

"Ngikhuliswe ngokuthi kuhle ukuhlonipha noma yikuphi lapho osuke uhamba khona, ngakho esikoleni yilapho ebengizimisele khona ngoba bengifuna ukuthi ngenze kahle. Ezifundweni zami kusuka kuGrade 10, bengizitshela ukuthi ngifuna ukwenza kahle ukuze ngihambe ngiye esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme ngiqhubeke nokufunda," kusho uSinokholo.

Uthe imali yoxhaso abayitholile izobasiza kakhulu njengoba abanye babo bentula futhi bengazi nokuthi bazoyithathaphi imali yokuyobhalisa.

"Siyabonga kuMasipala ngokusinika lolu xhaso lokuqhuba imfundo. Siyathemba ukuthi konke kuzohamba ngendlela uma sesihambile, ngiyanxusa nabanye abaku-matric ukuthi bazimisele njengoba kuthela izithelo ezinhle ekugcineni," kuchaza yena.

UMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi oyiMeya yaseBaqulusini uthe zingu-15 izikole eziphase kahle.

"Sibonga ukuthi kuzona zonke izindawo akukho mibhikisho esike saba nayo, ethinta ukungenami kwabafundi, okunye okusijabulisayo wukubona izingane ziphasa kahle izifundo iMaths nePhysics. Ngiyanxusa ukuthi othisha bazimisele kakhulu  baqinise kulezi zifundo, angisho ukuthi abanye othisha abenzi kahle kodwa lezi zifundo zombili yizona ezithandwa kakhulu manje futhi ezinamathuba amaningi omsebenzi," kusho uMkhwanazi.

Uthe imali abayinike abafundi ayichazi ukuthi njengoMasipala banemali kodwa bekumele bakwenze lokhu ukubonga abafundi.

Uveze ukuthi izidingo eziya emphakathini basazoqhubeka nokuzisa noma ngaphansi kwasiphi isimo.

Inhlangano iMind Empowers Youth Organisation (MEYO), esineminyaka engu-16 isebenza ekuthuthukiseni intsha, iyaqhubeka nokuqinisa izinhlelo zayo ngokubamba iqhaza emazweni angaphandle.

Lokhu kudalulwe uSihlalo wayo, uDkt Thobani Makhaza oveze ukuthu ngo-April uzobhekisa amabombo ephesheya ngenhloso yokuyofuna uxhaso lwemali ezolekelela ekufundiseni abafundi baKwaZulu Natal nakwezinye izifundazwe.

"Kumqoka ukuthi senze konke okusemandleni ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bethu bayakuthola ukufunda. Akumele bagcine bengafundanga ngoba nakhu benenkinga yezezimali," usho kanjena.

Uthe selokhu iMeyo yasungulwa seyiklame indima enkulu kakhulu ekufukuleni ezeMfundo ezweni lonke.

Uthe ukholwa ukuthi ukuze iMeyo izokhula kuhle ukuthi ibe nobudlelwane nanamanye anazwe angaphandle.

Ugcizelele ukuthi imfundo yisona sikhali abantu abasha abathembe sona ukuze babe nekusasa eliqhakazile.

Wathi yingakho ke kumqoka ukuba iMeyo ibhukule ilekelele ngayo yonke indlela.

Uveze ukuthi lolu hambo luzobandakanya ukubamba iqhaza ezingqungqutheleni ezifana ne-ASETE-26 e-Istanbul nezinye ezihlelelwe inyanga ka-April.

Uthe lezi zingqungquthela zinikeza amathuba okushintshana ngolwazi lwezemfundo, ukwakha ubudlelwano bamazwe ngamazwe kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali zokweseka izinhlelo ze-MEYO zokuthuthukisa imfundo namakhono entsha.

Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinkundla zamazwe ngamazwe, i-MEYO, iyaqhubeka nokwakha ubudlelwane namazwe omhlaba, iqoqe izimali, futhi iqhubekisele phambili umgomo wayo wokunika amandla intsha entulayo eNingizimu Afrika, igxile kakhulu emfundweni, ekuthuthukiseni amakhono nasekuvezeni amakhono ahlukahlukene.

IMeyo yaziwa kakhulu ngokuxhasa abafundi kulezi zifundo ezilandelayo .Izifundo Zobunjiniyela (Engineering Studies) – N3 kuya ku-N6:Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, izifundo zokuphatha nezamabhizinisi – N4 kuya ku-N6: human resources management, educare (Teaching) Medical secretary, legal secretary, public relations management, marketing management kanye ne-financial management.

UMSUNGULI wenhlangano iMarch and March, elwa udaba lwabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho, uNkk Jacinta Ngobese-Zuma, uthi akukho okuzoba namandla ukubaphuca ilungelo labo lokubhikisha.

UNkk Ngobese-Zuma ubekhuluma ngaphandle kwesiteshi samaphoyisa, iPoint, eSouth Beach, eThekwini, lapho obekuthiwa akazinikele khona izolo, kulandela ukuvulelwa icala lokuphehla udweshu emphakathini.

Lokhu kuza emva kwemibhikisho ebiholwa yiMarch and March kanjalo nezinye izinhlangano ezinomuzwa ofanayo ezifana ne-Operation Dudula kanjalo neMKP ngaphandle kwesikole, i-Addington Primary ngeledlule.

Imibhikisho ibimayelana nesikhalazo sokuthi kukhona inqwaba yezingane zakuleli ezingazitholanga izikhala zokufunda kulesi sikole okuthiwa sigcwele inqwaba yezingane zabokufika.

UNkk Ngobese-Zuma utshele abezindaba ukuthi ukubhikisha kungelinye lamalungelo abantu futhi akekho ongabaphuca lona.

“Asikho isitatimende samaphoyisa esingasivimba. Akukho kusatshiswa ngamaphoyisa okungasivimba. Akukho nokukodwa okungasiphuca lelo lungelo lokuthi siphume siye laphaya, sifike sibhikishele ukuthi izingane zabakuleli zifakwe esikoleni sakuleli,” usho kanje.

Uveze ukuthi uthe uma efika ngaphakathi esiteshini samaphoyisa, uthole umphenyi omtshele ukuthi ufuna isitatimende kubona (March and March).

Uthe ngokuboniswa abameli bakhe, bakhethe ukuthi bazinike isikhathi ukusibhala ngoba akuyena yedwa obekwa icala kodwa kukhona ne-Operation Dudulu kanjalo neMKP ngombhikisho ababanawo ngoLwesithathu olwedlule. 

Uthe basebumnyameni ngokuthi elani ngempela icala ababekwa lona.

“Uma sibekwa icala, kungani singabekwanga lona ngalolo suku? Kwakunenqwaba yamaphoyisa laphayana, kanjalo namaveni awo. Uma kwakukhona ababekubona ukuthi akukho emthethweni, kwakufanele sibekwe icala khona lapho,” usho kanje.

Umkhankaso weMarch and March uqale ngoMashi nyakenye, kanti ulwa nabokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho.

Ubonakele uba mandla esibhedlela i-Addington, eSouth Beach nyakenye, lapho amalungu enhlangano ebekanisa ngaphandle kwesibhedlela afune ukubona amaphepha avumela abokufika ukuthi babe kuleli ngaphambi kokuba bangene ngaphakathi.

Ubonakele nakwezinye izindawo KwaZulu-Natal kanjalo nakwezinye izifundazwe. Ngesikhathi kuvulwa izikole, amalungu enhlangano, okufaka phakathi naye uNkk Ngobese-Zuma, banikele esikoleni i-Addington, kulandela ukuthola isikhalazo sokuthi kukhona izingane zabakuleli ezingu-66 ezingathathwanga yilesi sikole.

IMEYA kaMasipala weTheku uMnuz Cyril Xaba iphonsele inselelo ubuholi bomdabu nobulawula ukusebenza kwezindawo zasemakhaya ukuthi busondele kuhulumeni, ukuze kube nezinhlelo zokufukula izindawo zasemakhaya zokuvakasha okuzokwenzakwande izivakashi ezifaka imali emnothweni wezindawo ezinjalo ezinganakekile.

UXaba usho njalo ethula inkulumo yakhe yosuku emcimbini wokwethula umbiko wokuthi idolobha iTheku lenze kanjani kwezokuvakasha ngamaholidi kaKhisimusi noNcibijane, obuse-Octavia Boutique Hotel, eNanda, enyakatho yeTheku ngoLwesine.

Uthe lokhu ukusho ngoba ebona ubuhle behhotela abenzele umcimbi wakhe kulona, athe limkhumbuza omunye wombono ayenawo esewuMphathiswa woMnyango wezoLimo nokuThuthukisa iziNdawo zasemaKhaya kule minyaka edlule.

“Kwakuvele kusemqondweni wami ukuthi kube nohlelo oluqondile lokuthi kufukulwe futhi kuthuthukiswe izindawo zasemakhaya nezasemalokishini ukuze zibe sesimeni esizosiza ukufukula umnotho wakhona, bese kufukuleka nemboni yezokuvakasha.

“Sengithi angiphinde ngikusho lokhu manje ngoba ngiyabona ukuthi namanje sisanenkinga yokuthi izindawo eziningi zasemakhaya zisantula ingqalasizinda, okungathi uma kuqalwa uhlelo lokuthi zithuthukiswe kube kuningi okuhle okungenzeka kule mboni,” kusho uXaba.

Eqhuba, uthe inselelo ekhona okwamanje wukuthi akukuhle ukubambisana phakathi kobuholi bezindawo zasemakhaya nohulumeni, okwenza ukuthi kube nzima kwesinye isikhathi ukungenelela ukuzama ukufukula izindawo ezengamelwe yibona ngenxa yokuthi miningi kakhulu imicikilisho okusuke kudingeka ukuthi ilandelwe andukuba kube khona uhlelo lokungenela ukuthuthukisa izindawo zabo olungase lwenziwe.

“Yingakho nemicimbi efuze lona esihlangene ngawo kumqoka ukuhlangana kuyona, bese siyabhunga ngezinto eziyizinselelo ezisimisa ndawonye njengalena, ngethemba ukuthi kukhona okuhle esingaphuma nakho uma sibambisana. Ubuhle baleli hhotela esikulona kufakazela ukuthi uma kutshalwa imali emnothweni wezindawo zasemalokishini kukhona okuhle okungenzeka, kanti futhi lisekhona nethuba lokuthi kwenzeke okufanayo ezindaweni ezisemakhaya nezintula ingqalasizinda,” usho kanje.

IMEYA yakuMasipala iBig 5 Hlabisa, uMnuz Comfort Khumalo, idonse abafundi ngezindlebe ngomkhuba wokuthanda ubumnandi baze bakhohlwe yinhloso yokuba semanyuvesi .

UKhumalo usho lokhu ngesikhathi kuhalaliselwa abafundi abaphase ngamalengiso izivivinyo zika-matric ezikoleni ezingaphansi kukaMasipala iBig 5 Hlabisa.

“Ithuba lokufunda liyafika, lidlule bese usala nesikweletu enhlizweni yakho. Siyanxusa ukuba ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuthi ufunde, uqikelele uphinde ukhumbule isimo osishiye ekhaya,” kuphetha uKhumalo.

UMengameli we-IFP futhi ongungqongqoshe womNyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana kuzwelonke, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa, uhalalisele uKhumalo noMnyango wezeMfundo njengoba abafundi abangaphezulu kuka-8000 bethole imiphumela ebenza bayoqhuba izifundo zabo nasemanyuvesi.

UHlabisa,odabuka kulesi sifunda, uthe ukholwa ukuthi laba bafundi bazobuya emakhaya emuva kokuphothula iziqu zabo sebezothuthukisa izindawo zasemakhaya.

Izikole ezingaphansi koMkhanyakude ziphase ngo- 100% kanti uMkhandlu iBig 5 Hlabisa unikele ngama- vawusha abiza uR10 000 kumfundi ngamunye.

UHlabisa uqhakambise iqhaza elibanjwa abantu besifazane emakhaya emuva kokuphumelela empilweni.

UHlabisa uthe noma ungahamba izwe uliqede, umuzi onezingane ezingafundile ugqama njengembuzi emhlophe endaweni eyihlungu.

“Kodwa emphakathini onezingane ezifundile awubuzi , izakhiwo uzibona udlula ukuthi ikhona ingane efundile. Izingane ezifundile azizigqaji ngemixhaso eyakhiwe emakubo. Yingakho zizinikela ekwakheni,” kusho uHlabisa.

Eqhuba uHlabisa uthe amantombazane yiwo ahamba phambili ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi avuse ikhaya.

“Amantombazane awaqali ngokuthenga imoto, uma ethola umsebenzi kodwa abafana bagijimela zona.”

Omunye wabazali, uMnuz Thokozani Mbatha uthe indodana yakhe ibihlezi iyingane ezimisela kakhulu ezifundweni zayo.

“Ngiyakujabulela ukusebenza ngokuzikhandla kukaThabani nokubayingane elalelayo kanti nami futhi bengimvusa. Njengoba ngizommela lapha namuhla yingoba yena useCape Town eNyuvesi yaseStellebosch lapho ayokwenza khona izifundo zakhe zobudokotela,” kusho uMbatha.

Phakathi kwezicukuthwane ezizohambela indumezulu yomcimbi okulesi sikole esiKwaNgono, eNkandla, kubalwa owayengumengameli wakuleli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, noNdunankulu waKwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.

OyiPhini likathishanhloko wesikole, uMnuz Philani Dumakude, uthe umcimbi uzobe umkhulu ukwedlula yonke eyake yabakhona emlandweni waseBizimali.

"Umcimbi wokuvalelisa uthishomkhulu wethu, ubaba wethu, umholi wethu ebesimthanda. Ebesimhlonipha. Ohambe lapha ngoJulayi 31, 2024, okuwusuku agcine ngalo (eseyothatha umhlalaphansi). Elokhu aqala layikhaya ngoJanuwari ka-1995."

UDumakude uchaze uNtuli njengesishoshovu semfundo esibe namagalelo amakhulu empumelelweni yesikole.

"Ngesikhathi efika, sasingekho isikole. Kwakusengamakilasi amathathu, ayengangenalo uphahla. Enezimbobo, ungena nanoma yikuphi lapho uthanda khona. Wafike wathatha izingane ezazikhona ngaleso sikhathi, wayozicelela esikoleni esingomakhelwane ukuba zifundele khona, ezama ukwenza iBizimali yakheke."

UDumakude uthe emuva kokuba seyakhekile iBizimali, uNtuli wabe esezilanda izingane ukuba zizofundela khona.

Uthe ngo-1997 uNtuli wakha igumbi elisha lokufundela abafundi bakaStd 9 (Grade 11), kwathi ngonyaka olandelayo wakha igumbi lokuqala lika-matric waseBizimali.

"(Loyo matric) wenza kahle kakhulu ngoba ngithi ngalowo nyaka kwafeyila umfundi oyedwa. Kusukela lapho iBizimali yabe seyithola u-100%. Ngaleso sikhathi eBizimali kwakusafunda izingane zendawo kuphela kodwa ngemiphumela emihle, yadonsa izingane zakuyo yonke iKZN. Njengamanje sinezifundazwe eziningi. SinoGauteng."

Uthe isikole siyayikazela ngezifundiswa ezidlule khona okubalwa kuzo odokotela, abameli, nezintatheli.

UDumakude uthe izinto ezaba wumqondo kaNtuli eBizimali nezafukula imiphumela yakulesi sikole, ukufunda ebusuku, ngezimpelasonto nangamaholidi.

Uthe umphakathi awukwamukelanga kahle lokho ngoba wawukhala ngokuthi awusakwazi ukuthuma izingane futhi azisakwazi nokuyolusa izinkomo.

"Indaba yokufunda ebusuku neyama- extra classes yaqala layikhaya."

UDumakude uthe uNtuli ushiye nyakenye isikole sinabafundi abangaphezu kuka-2 700 nothisha abawu-88.

"Siyabonga ukuthola ithuba lokusebenza nothishonhloko. Usikhulisile saba ngamadoda. Saba ngomama. Siyabonga ngemfundiso yakhe."

Esephetha uDumakude uthe kumenywa nanoma wubani ukuba abe yingxenye yalo mcimbi wokuthulela uNtuli isigqoko esadla anhlamvana.

UMNDENI wakwaGumede, esigodini saseDanganya, eMgababa, sewuzokwazi ukulala ubuthongo njengoba ngoLwesibili uzofihla umzukulu wawo, uLethokuhle Simphiwe Gumede.

Ngokusho kwesimemezelo salo omndeni esithunyelelwe Isolezwe, uLethokuhle (14) uzofihlwa emathuneni asekhaya kule ndawo emuva kwenkonzo ezokuba kwa-No 214730, emgwaqweni uR102 Main Road, eDanganya, eMgaba Area 5 kusukela ngo-9 ekuseni.

Lo mndeni bewungasabuthi quthu ubuthongo emuva kokuphazanyiswa kwezinhlelo zawo zokufihla uLethokuhle obefunda uGrade 8 eMkomaas Secondary.

Umufi kufanele ngabe ufihlwe ngesonto eledlule kodwa kwaphazamisa ukufika komunye umndeni obusola ukuthi isidumbu sikaLethokuhle ngesawo.

“Wabhaliswa ngoLwesibili (olwandulela olwedlule), kwafika umyalezo othi kunabanye abathi nabo banomuntu obalahlekele eThekwini.”

Lo mthombo uthe lwenziwe ulibofuzo ngoMsombuluko owedlule, kwacaca ukuthi isidumbu esitholakele ngesikaLethokuhle.

ULethokuhle waseDanganya, eMgababa, wamuka olwandle ngenyanga eyedlule kade ezama ukuhlenga umngani wakhe owayegwiliza.

Umkhulu kamufi, uMnuz Sindile Gumede, wathi uLethokuhle watholakala elinyazwe kabi wulwandle.

"Umndeni nezihlobo basathukile futhi akukamukeleki ukuhamba kwakhe umfana. Nokho-ke sibonga ukumthola."

ULethokuhle waphenduka iqhawe ehlenga umngani wakhe owayemuka kodwa yena akabange esaluthola usizo, wagcina ehambe kanjalo namagagasi. Ngokusho kukaGumede, umzukulu wakhe wamukiswa ngamagagasi asolwandle olungasemtholampilo eDanganya Area 5A.

"Zathi izingane zakwamakhelwane zazinyenyile ziyobhukuda. Kwabe sekumuka ingane yakwaMsomi engumngani wabo. OLetho nabanye basala ngenkathi abanye beyobiza umzali walo omukayo, yilapho uLetho aba nozwelo, wangena wakhipha umngani wakhe. Ngebhadi yena akabange esakwazi ukuphuma. Bathi bambona esephakamisa isandla, efuna usizo, ngebhadi bona abakwazanga ukumsiza."

"Silusizi emndenini wakwaGumede ngomzukulu wethu okunguyena omdala kunabanye ekhaya," kuphetha uGumede

UMCULI kamaskandi oqengqeleza phambili ngokudayisa kwengoma yakhe kuma-Official SA Charts (kwi-local Top 10 nakwi-International Top 20), uFeza Langa, ukhuthaze abafundi ngokubaluleka kwesikole. Uthe noma ngabe unaliphi ikhono kodwa kusemqoka ukuba ulishebe nesicucu semfundo.

NgoLwesihlanu, uFeza (29) - oshisa izikhotha kulezi zinsuku ngenoni elithi Umaqondana - ubekhuluma nabafundi abaphumelele ngamalengiso izifundo ezisemqoka nabebezenza ngaphansi kohlelo olubizwa ngeSteam (Science,Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) eMfolozi TVET College eNkandla.

Lo mculi uthe yena uqale waphothula iziqu zobuthishela kwiFoundation Phase e-University of Free State nyakenye, ngaphambi kokugxila emculweni lapho efike wakhonya khona. 

"Okunye engicabanga ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba ngabelane ngakho nani ukuthi u-matric ngake ngawufeyila. Kodwa lokho akwenzanga ukuthi ngiyeke. Ngaya koqala phansi kaGrade 11 kwesinye isikole futhi ngagcina ngiwuphase kahle u-matric wami."

Unxuse abafundi ukuba babekezele ngoba zikhona izinto ezizobakhuba kule ndlela asebeyithathile kodwa bangaliphonsi ithawula. UFeza waseNgwetshana, eNquthu, ugila izimanga ngengoma ayicaphune kwicwecwe eliyi-EP elisihloko sithi Inkanyezi. Ngokudayisa ezitolo, le ngoma esihloko sithi Umaqondana, ihudula izingoma ezifana nekaSam Deep ethi Shela, ekaShebeshxt ethi Rato Laka, ekaJazzworkx ethi Uvalo, ekaDJ Maphorisa ethi Abantwana Bakho nekaNkeshemba ethi Ngixolele Mntanami.

ABAPHATHI bamaqembu adlala kwiSafa KwaZulu-Natal Sasol League sebezwakalise ukushaqeka nokukhathazeka ngokuvela kwezindaba zokuphela kwesivumelwano sabaxhasi bale ligi, iSasol, neSafa phezu kokuba besakweletwa izishaqane zemali yile nhlangano ephethe ibhola.

NgoLwesithathu, abeSasol bakhiphe isitatimende esiqinisekisa ukuphela kwesivumelwano sabo neSafa sokuxhasa iSasol League neqembu lesizwe iBanyana Banyana ebesesidonse iminyaka engu-16.

Nokho, kulesi sitatimende abeSasol bakuvezile ukuthi nakuba sesiphelile isivumelwano sabo neSafa ngoJuni 30, kodwa basalinde ukuzwa uhlangothi lwayo ngemibandela yokuvuselela inkontileka. 

Kwenzeka lokhu nje ngoMgqibelo odlule, abadlali beBanyana bashaye itoyitoyi benqaba ukujima besanda kufika eMorocco, besekhempini yabo yokulungiselela ukuqala komqhudelwano weWomen’s Africa Cup of Nations (Wafcon) oqala namuhla usongwe ngoJulayi 26, kuleliya lizwe. 

Usihlalo futhi ongumqeqeshi weSunflower WFC, uSiyabonga Malinga, uthe bakhathezeke kakhulu ngokuphela kwesivumelwano seSasol neSafa ngenxa yamagalelo ale nkampani ekuthuthukiseni ibhola labesifazane kuleli kusukela yaqala ukuxhasa le ligi yebhola labesifazane ngo-2009.

“Kubuhlungu kakhulu ukuvela kwalezi zindaba zokuphela kwesivumelwano seSasol neSafa ngoba lokhu kusho ukuthi sizodonsa kanzima ngempela ngaphandle kwabaxhasi kule ligi yethu. 

"ISasol yenze omkhulu umehluko ekukhuleni kwebhola labesifazane lapha eNingizimu Afrika, lithuthuke kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nesikhathi esedlule,” kusho uMalinga, osengumakadebona ekuphathweni kwebhola labesifazane KwaZulu-Natal.

“Nokho, iSafa kufanele izinuke amakhwapha ngalokhu okwenzekayo manje. Kumasizini amabili edlule asiyitholi imali yesibonelelo sezindleko zokuhamba nemali yemihlomulo etholwa ngamaqembu ayisishiyagalombili aqede ephezulu kwi-log. 

"Kumanje sikweleta omashonisa nezimoto ezisithwalela abadlali uma siya emidlalweni, asazi ukuthi kumele senzenjani,” kuqhuba uMalinga.

UWeisy Mothoalo oyimenenja yeNewcastle Chess, naye ukhala esifanayo ngosizi ababhekene nalo. 

“Kunje nje, yingoba imali okufanele ize emaqenjini iyajikeleza kwiSafa, bese ifika kithina isincozuliwe. Ngenyanga edlule nje sinikwe (yiSafa) o-R10 000 esingatshelwanga ukuthi abani, ekubeni kusenemali eningi kabi esisakweletwa yona. 

"Namanje asikayitholi imali yangesizini edlule. Uma ngisusa lo R10 000 esinikwe wona ngoJuni, iSafa isikweleta u-R32 000 wemali yesibonelelo sezindleko zokuhamba, bese kuzoba u-R30 000 wokuqeda kwethu endaweni yesibili kumaPlay-Offs esifundazwe,” kusho uMothoalo. 

Ethintwa yiSolezwe oyisikhulu esiphezulu kwiSafa, uLydia Monyepao, akatholakalanga ocingweni, wathunyelelwa nemibuzo nge-email okushaye isikhathi sokuloba engakaphenduli.

EMVA kwamaholidi kaKhisimusi noNcibijane, lapho obekujatshulwa khona kudliwa ukudla okunhlobonhlobo, oncamnce futhi kuphuzwa nokulala - kujwayelekile ukuthi abantu baqale unyaka omusha bezizwa bekhathele, bequnjelwe futhi bengenamdlandla.

Umzimba wakho usuke usebenza kanzima uzama ukukhuculula udoti nalokho ongasakudingi ngaphakathi kuwona usebenzisa isibindi, izinso uzama nokugaya ukudla - kodwa emva kwesiphithiphithi samaholidi lokho kungaba nzinyanga futhi kudinge ukuthi kwenziwe ngenye indlela nangokwedlulele ukuze kufezeke kahle.

Lokho kushiwo wuMnuz Murray Hewlett, isikhulu esiphezulu sesikhungo sezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, ngenkathi exwayisa futhi ecebisa abantu ngokumele bakwenze ukuzihlanza nokukhuculula konke ukungcola okungasadingeki emzimbeni manje, ukusiza ukuthi umzimba ubuyelwe amandla, bakwazi ukumelana nonyaka wonke.

U-Hewlett uthe lokhu akudingi ukuthi uze uzixine ngokudla ngendlela ethize kuphela noma ukuzihlukumeza ngokudla noma ukungadli izinhlobo zokudla okuthile, kuphela nje kudinga ukuthi unike umzimba wakho ikhefu, futhi uwuvumele ukuthi ubuyise amandla aselahlekile.

Amanye amathiphu angakusebenzela ukwenza lokho:

1. Phuza amanzi kakhulu ukhuculule ukungcola egazini: Emva kwesikhathi eside uzibusisa ngeziphuzo nokudla okunosawoti, ukuphelelwa ngamanzi emzimbeni kuvame ukuba ngenye yezinkinga ezihluphayo ngalesi sikhathi. Ngakho kuhle ukuthi uqinise kakhulu emanzini manje ukusiza ukuthi izinso zakho zikwazi ukukhiphela ukungcola ngaphandle, ngakho zibekele okungenani umgomo wezingilazi eziyisithupha kuya kweziyisishiyagalombili zamanzi njalo ngosuku, bese uyedlulela kulokho uma uwumuntu ozivocavocayo noma uba nesikhathi eside uselangeni. Ungaqhubekela futhi kulokho ngokuthi njalo ekuseni uqale ngokuphuza amanzi afudumele, uwafake ulamula, okusiza ukuthi ube nomdlandla, uzizwe unamandla futhi kusiza nangokwenza ukuthi uhlelo lokugaya ukudla emzimbeni luhambe kahle.

2. Buyela ekudleni okunempilo nokunika amandla: NgoDisemba abantu basuke bezifuqa ngezicoficofi zokudla okumnandi kepha okungenayo impilo edingwa wumzimba, ngakho manje yisikhathi esihle sokugxila ekudleni okunempilo okuzonika umzimba wakho amandla owadingayo. Gcwalisa ipuleti lakho ngezithelo, imifino nokunye okudla okunempilo.

3. Beka eqhulwini ukulala ngokwanele: Sonke siyazi ukuthi ngezikhathi zenjabulo siba sincane isikhathi sokuphumula ngoba kusuke kumatasa futhi kuphithizela, okwenza ukuthi abantu baqale unyaka omusha bekhathele. Ngakho zama ukuthi ulale okungenani amahora ayisikhombisa kuya kwayisishiyagalolunye ukuze uphumule ngokwanele, futhi uchilize konke okungase kube yisithiyo ekulaleni kwakho njengokuthi ufake umakhalekhukhwini wakho ku-silent noma uwucishe ukuze ungaphazamiseki uma ulele. 

4. Nyakazisa umzimba wakho: Uma ukade uzihlalele ngalama holidi ungenzi lutho olutheni, kungaba yisikhathi esihle manje ukuqala futhi ujwayeze umzimba wakho ukuwunyakazisa, Ungaqala kancane ngokuthi uhambe nje welule izinyawo noma imizuzu ewu-30, uzelule usekhaya noma endlini yakho uze wejwayele.

5. Yehlisa ezikanjini zikaFaro naseziphuzweni ezine-caffeine: Nika umzimba wakho ithuba lokuthi ubuyelwe ngamandla ngokuhlaba ikhefu otshwaleni, uzame nokushintsha kancane iziphuzo ojwayele ukuziphuza ikakhulu lezo ezine-caffeine - bese uqinisa kakhulu emanzini ahloliwe anempilo, uwafake no-cucumber.

6. Hlela isikhathi nodokotela: Ukuhlale, uhlale ubonane nodokotela ukuhlola ukuthi konke kusahamba kahle yini emzimbeni wakho kungasiza ukuthi kusheshe kutholakale inkinga uma ikhona emzimbeni wakho, bese uyasizakala. 

AMAVA eminyaka ewu-25 ewuthisha ahlwanyele imbewu yomqondo webhizinisi eliwusizo ezinganeni kuNkk Noxolo Nokwe, ohlangane nendodakazi yakhe uNkk Lelethu Hlongwa - bavula isikole esiyinkulisa iFuture Harvest, esiwusizo lwesisekelo semfundo ezinganeni.

UNkk Nokwe, ozinze ePinetown, ngaleli bhizinisi aliqale ngo-2017 uthe wayesefuna inselelo entsha ngenkathi enquma ukwesula emsebenzini wakhe wokuba wuthisha, kodwa yasala insila yokuthanda ukufundisa nokucija izingane.

“Yilapho engabona khona ukuthi isekhona indlela engingasebenzisa ubizo lwami ngayo ukuze ngiqhubeke ngiqinisekise ukuthi izingane zikhula zinekusasa eliqhakazile.Ngaleli bhizinisi eliyisisekelo semfundo kodado ngiqinisekisa ukuthi bakhula bekhaliphile," kusho yena.

“Lokho sikwenza ngokuthi zonke izingane ezincane ezibhalisa esikoleni sethu zithole ulwazi olumqoka lokufunda ngokuqonda bese futhi sigxila kakhulu ekuzicijeni ngesiNgisi ukusiza ukuthi kube lula uma seziqhubeka nemfundo ngoba zizobe sezikwazi ukukhuluma, ukufunda nokunye okweyamene nakho okuzokwenza zihluke kwezinye,” kusho uNkk Nokwe.

Eqhuba, uthe okunye okumphushe ukuqala iFuture Harvest wukuthi esewuthisha oqashiwe wayeqaphela ukuthi izingane eziningi ziba nenkinga yokungakwazi ukufunda ngokuqonda, ezinye zihluleka wukukhuluma - okukhomba ukuthi kusuke kukhona okushodile noma kwangahamba kahle endleleni ezifundiswe ngayo zisencane.

“Siqala kusuka enganeni ewusana olunezinyanga ezintathu kuya ezinganeni ezineminyaka emihlanu kuya kweyisithupha ngoba okwamanje sisagcina kuGrade R, kodwa sigculisekile kakhulu ngomehluko esiwenzayo emphakathini ngezingane ezidlula ezandleni zethu,” usho kanje.

UNkk Hlongwa uthe uqale ukuba kuleli bhizinisi ngokugcwele ngo-2020 ngenxa yokuthi kule minyaka emithathu yokuqala lisaqala wayematasa nomsebenzi wakhe ayeqashwe kuwona, okuthe ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi wabona kumqoka ukulekelela unina ngokugcwele kulona ukuze lithuthuke futhi libe yilokhu abakufisayo ngalo.

Uthe ngonyaka babiza kusuka ku-R850, R900 no-R950 ingane ngayinye, kuncike ekutheni ineminyaka emingaki nokuthi isuke izofunda isikhathi esingakanani enkulisa yabo, kanti bavame ukuthi bamukele izingane ezingaphezu kuka-250 ukuzofunda kubona njalo ngonyaka.

“Manje sesiqashe abasebenzi abawu-14 ebhizinisi lethu, futhi siyaqhubeka nokudlondlobala yize kungelula ngenxa yokuthi kukhulu kakhulu ukuncintisana phakathi kwethu nabanye abenza umsebenzi ofana nowethu. Nanokuthi akulula ukusebenza ngezingane ezincane ngoba ayifani indlela ezenza izinto ngayo nezikhuliswe ngayo. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi sihlale sinesineke ukuze kungabi bikho okusiqhatha namakhasimende ethu,” kusho uNkk Hlongwa.

Basho ngazwi linye ukuthi manje babheke ukuqhubeka bakhulise ibhizinisi labo, ligcine selikwazi ukwamukela inqwaba yezingane ukuzofunda, kuze kugcine sekunyukele nakwamanye amabanga angaphezu kokuba yinkulisa noGrade R kuphela. 

UKUTHATHA isinqumo “esinzima” sokubuyela esikoleni emva kweminyaka ewu-12 ashiya phansi isikole engakawuphothuli u-matric okokuqala, kuthele izithelo ezinhle nezibonakalayo kuNksz Samkelisiwe Xulu, ephasa ngamalengiso ku-matric wakhe awuphothule nyakenye.

Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe, uNksz Xulu (32) waseDoringkop, KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal, udalule ukuthi u-matric wakhe wawenza okokuqala ngo-2012 esafunda ngakubo eShekembula High, kepha wawushiya phakathi exinwa wukugula okweyamane nezinkinga zokwesintu.

“Bengigula kakhulu futhi ngiphazamiseka ekufundeni kwami. Ngagcina ngishiya phansi isikole ngaboMashi ngalowo nyaka kwangabe kusaba lula ukuthi ngibuyele esikoleni ngokushesha. Bengilokhu ngiphila ngokubamba amatotho ezindaweni ezihlukene, ukuzama ukuziphilisa nokuzimela nokweseka umndeni wami,” usho kanje.

Eqhuba, uthe impilo abeyiphila ibingamgculisi njengoba ebehlale ethola imisebenzi engamjabulisi emalini kepha ibe imgqilaza emzimbeni nasemqondweni, waze wabona kufanele ukuthi abuyele esikoleni ukuzama ukucaba ikusasa eliqhakazile ngemfundo.

Uthe wabona isikhangiso sesikole iSinenhlanhla Secondary, esiseShakaskraal, khona KwaDukuza esasidinga abafundi, wanquma ukufaka isicelo sokufunda uGrade 11 khona, nangempela bamamukela - kwaba wukuqhubeka kohambo lwakhe lwemfundo.

“Ngizibambe zaqina kusuka lapho, ngangabe ngisabheka emuva. Ngazitshela ukuthi akusekho lutho namuntu okuzophazamisa imfundo yami, njengoba manje sengivuna engikutshalile - ngiphasa ngamalengiso izifundo eziyisithupha, engithemba ukuthi lokho kuzovula iminyango yamathuba angcono,” kusho uNksz Xulu.

Izifundo aziphase ngamalengiso yisiNgisi, isiZulu, Life Orientation, Dramatic Arts, History ne-Tourism bese kuba yiMathematical Literacy ayiphase ngo-level 6 (70+%).

“Konke lokhu ngithemba ukuthi kuzokhuthaza nabanye abeza ngemva kwami babone ukuthi imfundo ayikhulelwa nokuthi ukungaphumeleli u-matric wakho okokuqala akusho ukuphela komhlaba, kepha lisuke lisekhona ithuba lokufeza okunye ozifisela kona uma uzozitshela ukuthi uzophokophelela ukuphumelela ngemfundo yakho,” kusho yena.

Uthe manje usebheke ukuqhubeka nemfundo yakhe, enze izifundo zobumeli e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, ngenhloso yokusebenzisa azokufunda kuzona ukulungisa izimo nezinkinga ezihlukene ezibhekana nomphakathi nsuku zonke.

“Kuyangikhathaza ukubona kwanda izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabantu besifazane kujike kungabi ndaba zalutho, engithemba nengikholwa wukuthi kuningi engingakwenza ukuzama ukukulungisa ngisebenzisa imfundo yami,” kusho uNksz Xulu.
