Usho njalo umeluleki wezezimali obuye abe yinhloko yophiko lwezokumaketha nokuhwebelana iMomentum Advice, uNkk Cebile Zibi, ngenkathi ecebisa abantu ngokumele bakwenze noma bakugweme ukuqinisekisa ukuthi baqala unyaka ngonyawo oluhle uma kukhulunywa ngemali yabo.

UNkk Zibi uthe lesi yisikhathi esihle impela sokuqala uhlelo lwakho lokulondoloza imali, ngokuthi usebenzise ingcindezi obhekene nayo ngalesi sikhathi ukuthatha izinqumo ezinqala nezmqoka futhi ezizokwenza ukuthi imali yakho ilondolozeke unyaka wonke.

“Ngaphambi kokuthi uze uzibekele inqwaba yemigomo okungenzeka igcine ikwehlula, qala ngokuqonda isigaba sempilo okusona manje, bese wenza uhla lwezidingo ezimqoka nongeke ukwazi ukuzibalekela njengemali yezindleko zokufunda kwezingane zakho, imali yokugibela ukuya esikoleni nasemsebenzini, eyokudla nokunye okumqoka.

“Lokho kukusiza ngokuthi kucace futhi kube sobala kuwena ukuthi yini okumele uqale ngokuyikhokhela ngokushesha ingakapheli le nyanga, bese kuthi imali esala lapho usungayisebenzisa kokunye okungaphuthumi. Okunye okumqoka wukuqikelela ukuthi kuba khona noma okuncane okubekayo, ungabe usushaya uvala yonke imali,” kucebisa uNkk Zibi.

Eqhuba, uthe okunye okusiza kakhulu ngalesi sikhathi wukuqhathanisa amanani ezinto ofuna ukuzithenga, bese uthenga lokho okungamanani onamandla okuwakhokha ngoba kusuke kumele uqinisekise ukuthi wonga lelo nalelo senti lemali yakho ongakwazi ukuyonga ngalesi sikhathi.

“Zijwayeze ukupheka ekhaya, udle ukudla kwesipuni - ukuze kugwemeke ukumosha imali ngokudla okusheshayo okuthenga ezitolo noma ezindaweni zokudlela. Okunye futhi okungakusiza wukubuyekeza zonke izinto ozikhokhela zinyanga zonke, bese uhoxisa lokho obona kungenasidingo kangako okwamanje uze usimame ngokuphelele,” kusho uNkk Zibi.

Uthe okunye abantu okumele bakukhuthalele wukuhlale bexhumana nabeluleki bezezimali, kube wumkhuba wabo abawenzayo nje kungonakele lutho, ukusiza ukuthi bathole amasu nezindlela ezingabasiza ukubeka nokonga imali yabo.

“Ukwelulekwa ukuthi imali yakho uyisebenzisa kanjani kusiza ngokuthi uvuleke amehlo ngezinto okungenzeka ukuthi ubungazinakile ezishaya zivale imali yakho, bese kukusiza futhi ngokuthi ube nohlelo oluqondile lokuthi imali yakho uyilondoloza kanjani,” usho kanje.

UKUSEBENZISA izinkundla zokuxhumana ukuxoxa nokwazisa abantu ngezinselelo zokuzohlala edolobheni ube udabuka emakhaya yicebo elaqala sakudlala, kepha eseliqalile ukuthela izithelo ezinhle kuNksz Cebisile Mthembu, osezakhele ugazi nodumo ngelikaMaMvelase ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

UNksz Mthembu (24) usho njalo exoxa neSolezwe ngokungenisa kwakhe ngamavidiyo awenza, bese ewafaka emakhasini akhe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, osekumakhele abalandeli abangaphezu kuka-177 000 kwiFacebook, kwiTikTok bangaphezu kuka-770 000 nama-like angaphezu kuka-37 million.

Le ntokazi edabuka eMpongosi, eNkandla, idalule ukuthi kuze kufika kulesi sigaba nje, kwaqala ngokuthi izenzele amavidiyo ichaza ukuthi kube njani ngenkathi ifika edolobheni, isuka endaweni yasemakhaya, ebivame ukuwenza incokola yenza amahlaya ngalezo zinselelo.

“Ngiwumuntu okhulele emakhaya, futhi obengazi lutho olutheni ngempilo yasedolobheni. Kuthe sengifika eThekwini ngizofunda, ngaqala kanjalo ukwenza lawo mavidiyo abelandisa abantu ukuthi ngibhekane kanjani nezinselelo ezinjalo ikakhulu ngoba ngiwumuntu osemusha. Kube nzima ukuthi ngisheshe ngijwayele impilo nendlela okwenzeka ngayo izinto lapha edolobheni,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.

Uthe ukubona ukuthi kumsebenzela kanjani futhi kangakanani ukufaka amavidiyo, aqale ukuwenza ngabo-2021, kwenza waqhubeka nawo kusuka ngabo-2023 - esengeza nangalawo aveza ukuthi usuke ekuphi futhi enzani ngezikhathi ezithile ukujabulisa abalandeli bakhe.

“Manje sekuwumlando ukuthi into engaqala ngiyenza sakudlala kanjalo, isithela izithelo njengoba sekuke kwenzeke  ukuthi ngithintwe ngabantu nezinkampani ezithile bengimema ukuze ngibe semicimbini, ezinhlelweni ezithile nasemikhankasweni abayenzayo - bese bengikhokhela ngokuthi ngikufake emakhasini ami ezinkundla zokuxhumana ukuze kubonwe ngabantu,” usho kanje.

Uthe kuyenzeka enze imali eko-R3 500 kuya phezulu ngalowo msebenzi, okungenye yezindlela ezimsebenzela ukuziphilisa njengoba okwamanje engakawutholi umsebenzi wobuthishela asanda kuphothula iziqu zawo e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, okuyiyona nto ayevele eyizele eThekwini.

"Sengibheke ukuqhubeka nalo msebenzi wamavidiyo nezithombe engikwenzayo ngoba kuyangisebenzela. Ngibona futhi kungeke kushayisane nowobuthishela uma kugcina kuvela ithuba lokuwenza nawo ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi,” kusho uNksz Mthembu.

Uma usungaphakathi e-Beaver Creek Coffee Farm ukwazi ukubona ubunjalo bembewu yekhofi,  kuqhubekele ekutheni uma usuvuna izinhlamvu zalo uqhubeka kanjani nomsebenzi olandela lapho wokulivubela, kube wukuthi selisesimeni esihle sokulithaka bese ulidayisele abalithandayo.

Engxoxweni nomphathi wale ndawo uMnuz Dix Foster, kuhlaluke ukuthi ikhofi limqoka  kangakanani emnothweni wezwe nasemazweni ehlukene, ikakhulu awase-Afrika ngoba yilapho livutshelwa kakhulu khona.

UFoster uchaze le ndawo ngokuthi ikwezihamba phambili ngezinga lomkhiqizo wekhofi emhlabeni jikelele, futhi wakubeka ngokusobala nangokucacile ukuthi iwusizo kangakanani ebantwini abathanda ukuliphuza, abafisa ukwazi kabanzi ngalo nalabo abanentshisekelo yokuhweba ngalo.

“Uma usukule ndawo uthola isithombe esicacile sobumqoka bale mboni emnothweni wezwe lethu, nokuthi kungani ikwezihamba phambili kwezomnotho nokuhwebelana, futhi kuthi uma usuqede ukusivakashela uhambe usukuqonda cishe ngokupholele ukuthi umkhiqizo wekhofi waqala kanjani e-Ethiopia ngeminyaka yawo-1950, kuze kube kufinyelela kowesibili wona owaqalwa eCongo ngeminyaka yawo-1970, njengoba sekulapho esikhona manje lapho ikhofi seligcwele umhlaba wonke,” kusho yena.

UKUQAPHELA konke okwakwenziwa wuyise, akhule ekhonze ukutshala nokulima kwabo, kwenze wakhula ebona ubuhle bokuba nokudla ozikhiqizele khona, futhi waqaphela nokuthi lokho kusiza  kanganani uma sekubhoke isikhathi esinzima sendlala.

Yilokho okwenze ukuthi kube lula kuNksz Noluthando Zungu ukuqala ibhizinisi lezolimo, alixube nokufuya izinkukhu zamaqanda nezenyama i-Amandlenkosi Farms, eseliqalile ukuthi lithele izithelo ezibonakalayo empilweni yakhe nasemphakathini akhele kuwona.

UNksz Zungu uzinze eNyandezulu, ePort Shepstone, ngaleli bhizinisi aliqale kunzima ezweni ngo-2020 ngenkathi kubhoka igciwane iCovid-19, okwaba yisimo esenza ukuthi abantu abaningi bahlushwe yindlala.

Uthe wamfikela kanjalo umcabango waleli bhizinisi, aliqambe ngegama lendodakazi yakhe eneminyaka emihlanu u-Amandlenkosi, ngenhloso yokwenza umehluko emphakathini futhi asize abantu jikelele ukuthola ukudla okunempilo kalula nangokushesha.

“Ngikhule ekhaya ubaba ekhonze kakhulu ukulima, nami ngafunda okuningi kuyena ngalokho. Lokhu kwenze ukuthi kube lula ukuziqalela elami ibhizinisi ngoba sengibona ukuthi kwase kushube kangakanani ezweni ngaleso sikhathi, abantu bedinga ukudla okunempilo.

“Ngiqale lapho kancane, kancane, ngase ngisizwa nawukuzihlupha ngolwazi lwemfundo yokuphatha ibhizinisi. Manje ngigabe ngezicucu zezamabhizinisi zaseCedara College of Agriculture nasohlelweni lokuqeqesha osomabhizinisi olwenziwa yi-Esayidi Business Incubator, okungihlomise ngolwazi olungisize kakhulu,” kulanda uNksz Zungu.

Eqhuba, uthe leli bhizinisi selidlondlobale kakhulu manje njengoba umkhiqizo wakhe wezinkukhu zenyama nezamaqanda, kanjalo namaveji okuyiklabishi, ispinashi notamatisi akudayisa kulona - sekuthengwa nakwezinye izindawo koThekwini, Mbizana, kanjalo nangabezindawo zokudlela ezihlukene ezakhele iPort Shepstone namaphethelo.

Kanti nangaphezu kwalokho, uNksz Zungu usanda kuhlabana ngendondo yeTop Achiever emncintiswaneni wosomabhizinisi iThe Next Billionaire Business Awards, lapho akhale wemuka khona nesamba sika-R50 000.

“Nokho akulula konke njengoba abanye abantu becabanga; kudingeka ukuthi usebenze kanzima nangokuzikhandla, futhi uhlale uqikelele ukuthi yonke imicikilisho yokuphatha ibhizinisi ihamba ngendlela efanele. Okunye okubalulekile ukuhlonipha ibhizinisi lakho namakhasimende akho ahlale eseqhulwini kuwena ukuze konke kuzohamba ngendlela efanele,” usho kanje.

I-Amandlenkosi Farms inabasebenzi abahlanu abaqashwe ngokugcwele nabayisikhombisa abayitoho, kanti umkhiqizo wamaqanda ubiza u-R2 iqanda ngalinye no-R75 amaqanda awu-30, kube wu-R65 kuya phezulu inkukhu ngayinye, no-R10 kuya phezulu kumaveji abo. 

UKHULISWE abazali ababeshisekela ukusimama emabhizinisini futhi benebhizinisi lokungcwaba, lokho kwenza naye wakhuthalela ukufunda nokwenza okuningi kwezamabhizinisi ukuze azimele futhi enze umehluko nokuhle emphakathini awusebenzelayo.

Lwaqala futhi lwakhula kanjalo uthando lwebhizinisi kuNksz Aphiwe Khambule, umphathi wenkampani yokungcwaba i-21st Century Funeral Services, athathe amatomu kuyona eqhubeka emsebenzini owenziwe ngabazali bakhe kusukela beliqala ibhizinisi ngo-1999.

Elandisa Isolezwe ngalokho, uNksz Khambule odabuka KwaMashu, kodwa osezinze eHillcrest, entshonalanga yeTheku, uthe ukubona abazali bakhe bezikhandla ngomsebenzi webhizinisi kwamkhuthaza ukuthi aqale abalekelele kusuka ngo-2010 eba yi-receptionist, ngenhloso yokwakhela kulokho afunde okuningi ngokuphatha nokuhola ngobuqotho ebhizinisini.

"Nokho ngike ngama kancane kulona i sengigxila emfundweni njengoba ngineziqu zomkhakha wobuntatheli iBachelor of Arts in Journalism and International Relations  nezePost Graduate Diploma in Media and Business Management kokubili kwaseRhodes University.

"Ngisuke lapho ngayosebenza kwenye inkampani yezindaba eseKapa, ngahlala khona iminyaka emihlanu ngenza imisebenzi ehlukene eqondene nokubhala. Ngasula kuyona ngoba sengifuna ukugxila ebhizinisini lasekhaya, engiqale ukubamba amatomu kulona ngabo-2019, kuze kuzoba yimanje njengoba ngisayibambile ishisa injalo," kusho uNksz Khambule.

Uthe akubanga lula neze njengoba kwathi esanda kuphatha nje, kwabhoka iCorona okwenza ukuthi ibhizinisi livivinywe kancane, nokwamsiza kwamqinisa ukukhakhayi ngokushesha kwezokuphatha.

"Yilapho futhi engiqaphele khona ukuthi kulo mkhakha kugcwele abantu abadala, okwenza ukuthi uma usemusha ubuye ubukeleke phansi, kube sengathi umsebenzi wakho awuwazi kahle, kube kungenjalo. Nokuthi singabaholi bamabhizinisi alo mkhakha sinomkhuba omubi wokuthanda ukuncintisana sodwa, okwenza  kugcine kuza ngemuva ubumqoka bokuthi siphathe kahle amakhasimende ethu ngoba singebe yilutho ngaphandle kwawo," usho kanje.

Uthe nokho uyaziqhenya ngomsebenzi asewenzile enkampanini yakubo kule minyaka emihlanu kuya kweyisithupha manje ephethe. Uveze ukuthi wakhe ubudlelwano nezinkampani zokuthutha zamabhasi nezamabhanoyi, ukwenza kube lula ukugoduka elungeni lomndeni eliyisikhasimende labo uma lishonelwe libe lihlala kude nekhaya.

"Ngale kwalokho, sesiqashe abasebenzi abawu-16 ngokugcwele, futhi sitholakala ezindaweni ezehlukene eThekwini, Mlaza, Pinetown, Mbilo, Mpangeni naseNtuzuma okwenza kube lula emakhasimendeni ethu. Ngisanda kuhlomula ngendondo kasomabhizinisi wonyaka ovelele kuma-37th Business Partners Limited, okufakazela ubuhle bomsebenzi engiwenzayo nengibambisene nabo enkampanini," kulanda uNksz Khambule. 

Mayelana nezinhlelo zengomuso, uthe usebenzela ukuthi inkampani yabo igcine isiqashe abasebenzi abangaphezu kuka-500, ibe namagatsha amaningi ezweni lonke, bese isiza nasenkingeni yokushoda kwezindawo zokungcwabela emadolobheni nasemalokishini. 

IZINDAWO zokubhukuda kubalwa nama-swimming pool ngenye yezindlela ezijabulisa abantu ngalesi sikhathi samaholidi kaDisemba nokuthwasa kwehlobo, kodwa futhi kukhona nobungozi okuhambisana nakho.

Leso yisexwayo esikhishwe ngabenhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni i-World Health Organization, lapho beveze khona ukuthi ukuminza kwabasuke bebhukuda ngenye yezizathu ezihamba phambili eziholela ekutheni izingane zife, okufakazelwa wukuthi njalo ngonyaka kushona abantu abangaphezu kwa-300 000 ngenxa yokuminza, ingxenye yabo okuyizingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemihlanu okuyizona ezisengcupheni kakhulu.

Isikhulu esiphezulu sesikhungo sezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, uMnuz Murray Hewlett, sithe enye ingozi enkulu yalokhu wukuthi kweminye imizi bano-swimming pool emagcekeni, okuba yingozi ngokuthi kwesinye isikhathi uyaminza ubukade ungaqondile, okungaba ngokuthi ushelele ungene emanzini ngenxa yokukhathala nokujabula kuze kweqe.

"Iqiniso wukuthi lezi zigameko zenzeka mihla yonke, futhi kuvame ukuthi kungabi bikho muntu owexwayisa abantu ngazo, yingakho kusemqoka ukuthi kwaziswe abazali ngobumqoka bokunakekela izingane zabo, nokuqikelela ukuphepha kwezingane zabo kulokho," kuxwayisa uHewlett.

Kungani kumqoka ukuthola usizo lokuqala ngokushesha?

Usizo lokuqala lumqoka kakhulu esimweni esinjena, kanti futhi kuyasiza ukwazi okumele ukwenze ngaphambi kokuthi kufike abantu abaqeqeshelwe ukukusiza. Okunye kwalokhu ongakwenza wukuthi uzame ukusiza umntwana wakho angaphelelwa wumoya ongakwenza ngokumpitshiza esiswini nasesifubeni ukuze kuphume amanzi angene ngaphakathi kuyena.

Okunye okusemqoka okumele ukwenze ngalesi sikhathi wukuthi uzame ukuthi wonke umuntu ehlise umoya uma kusanelesi simo, bese uqikelela ukuthi nawe awubeki impilo yakho engcupheni lapho uzama ukusiza umntwana wakho.

Uma ubona ukuthi umntwana wakho akalamukeli usizo omnika lona, noma enenkinga yokuphefumula - fonela abosizo lokuqala ngokushesha. Kulele lapho-ke ubumqoka bokuthi uhlale unezinombolo zabosizo oluphuthumayo ukuze kusheshe ezimweni ezinjena.

Uma kuphephile, zama ukukhipha umntwana wakho emanzini ngokushesha. Lokho ungakwenza usebenzisa umshanelo wakwi-swimming pool, induku noma intambo azobamba khona bese umdonsela ngaphandle ngakho; kodwa ungazami ukusiza ngokuthi ungene emanzini ube wazi ukuthi awukwazi ukubhukuda, nalapho kungaphephile ukwenza lokho.

Uma usumkhiphile emanzini, mumbhathise ithawula elomile noma ingubo ukusiza ukuthi angaguliswa wukungenwa ngamanzi kakhulu.

Uma usufonela abosizo lokuqala, qikelela ukubanika isiqiniseko sendawo ohlala kuyona esiqondile ukuze bangaduki endleleni beza kuwena.

UMSHAYELI wesifazane oseneminyaka ewu-18 eshayela amatekisi, uNksz Mbali Luthuli, usephonsele inselelo izinhlaka zezokuthutha ezweni ukuthi zifakele izibuko isimo nenhlalo yokusebenza kosomatekisi, akuchaze ngokuthi akugwinyisi mathe nhlobo.

UNksz Luthuli wasoBuka, eMpangeni, enyakatho yaKwaZulu-Natal, kodwa manje ozinze eThekwini, njengoba eshayela amatekisi asuka KwaMashu, aye edolobheni - usho njalo engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe, lapho ehlube khona udlubu ekhasini ngesimo sabo.

Uthe selokhu aqala ukwenza lo msebenzi ngo-2007, enzela ukuziphilisa futhi akwazi nokukhulisa izingane zakhe ezine, usemncane kakhulu umehluko osukhona kule mboni. Uthe zikokhu zande njalo izimo ezenza ukusebenza kwabo kungagwinyisi mathe.

"Inselelo enkulu ngomsebenzi wethu wukuthi sivuka ekuseni kakhulu nsuku zonke, size siqede ukusebenza ebusuku kakhulu. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi sihlale sikhathele ngenxa yokuthi asibi bikho isikhathi esanele sokulala siphumule ngokwanele. Kunzima kunjalo nje, uxoshwa noma yinini njengoba kuye kwenzeke ulale kungonakele lutho, uvuke ekuseni kuthiwe usuxoshiwe.

"Kwesinye isikhathi sisebenza ngisho sizizwa ukuthi asiphilile kahle, ngoba sisabele ukuthi uzothi uyalova, ubuye imoto obuyishayela isishayelwa womunye umuntu. Umsebenzi wethu yinto ongeke ukwazi ukuma ngayo. Akunasiqiniseko sokuthi uma usebenza, kusasa uzobe usekhona yini umsebenzi noma uzobe usuxoshiwe," kulanda uNksz Luthuli. 

Eqhuba, uthe bafisa ukuthi izinhlaka zezokuthutha zingenelele kulokhu ngokuthi zenze kube nemthetho ezogunyaza futhi ivikele ukusebenza kwabashayeli, kungabi lula ukuthi umane uxoshwe nje kungenasizathu, nokuzosiza ukwenza kube nemali eqondile okumele bayihole.

"Sihola imali encane kakhulu, futhi iningi lethu alizazi nokuthi lihola malini njengoba kuye kwenzeke uhole u-R500 ngesonto, kokunye uthole u-R1 000. Konke lokho kuholela ekutheni kungabi lula ukuhlela ukuthi imali yakho uyicaza kanjani ezidingweni zakho, ekubeni njalo kusamele sondle ngayo imindeni yethu, futhi sizondle nathi uqobo lwethu." kulanda yena.

Ebuzwa ngenhlalo yansuku zonke erenki, uthe akunzima kanjengoba abantu abaningi becabanga, ngenxa yokuthi babambisene yena nozakwabo ukuqhuba umsebenzi, ukwesekana uma kunesidingo, kangangokuthi baze bakhavelane uma kukhona owenze iphutha elithile kubona.

"Ngisho sekudliwa sihlala ndawonye, sithenge ukudla okunjengenhloko, inyama nokunye kwesipuni - konke esikwenza ndawonye ngoba siqonda ubunjalo bobunzima besimo esiphila nesisebenza ngaphansi kwaso, ngakho siyaye sivale ihlazo lomunye komunye," kusho yena.

Ukhale nangokuthi kuyadumaza ukuthi konke lokhu kuhlukumezeka kwenziwa ngabantu abamnyama kwabanye abamnyama, njengoba leli bhizinisi liphethwe kakhulu ngabantu bebala elinsundu.

"Kwesinye isikhathi sidelelwa noma siphathwe kabi yizingane nezihlobo zabanikazi bamatekisi bethu, kepha ungakwazi ukwenza lutho ngenxa yokuthi akunamthetho ongama ngawo ngenxa yendlela esiqashwe ngayo emsebenzini wethu," kukhononda uNksz Luthuli.

Uthe isimo sabo sidinga ukuthi uhulumeni usukume ngokushesha, kube khona izinhlelo ozenzayo zokubavikela ukuze kungabi lula ukuthi kwenzeke noma yini ethiya umsebenzi wabo.

IZIMPAWU zokulimala ekhanda ngaphakathi noma engqondweni kungaba nzima ukuthi zisheshe zibonakale ebantwini abadala, nokho futhi ukulandelela izindlela ezilula zongakwenza kungakusiza ukuthi kugwemeke lezo zinkinga.

Lokho kushiwo wuDkt Denis Mutyaba, udokotela weNetcare Unitas Hospital, ePitoli, obhekele izifo eziphazamisa ukusebenza kwengqondo, umgogodla nokunye okweyamene nakho, exwayisa abantu ngokumele bakuqaphele ukuze bagweme umthelela omubi walesi simo, nongaze udale ukuthi uphoqeleke ukuhlinzwa ukuzama ukukwelapha.

"Yingakho kumqoka ukuqaphela nokugwema izinto nezigameko ezingenza ukuthi uwe kabi phansi noma ushelele ngoba ukulimala okungenzeka lapho kungaba nomthelela omubi kakhulu nongashintsha impilo yakho yonke," kweluleka uDkt Mutyaba.

"Sekukaningi sibhekana nezimo ezinjena zabantu abasuke belimale ngaleyo ndlela, okuba wukuthi umuntu wopha ebuchosheni noma eduze nabo, okuwukulimala okuyingozi kabi, nokungaba nomthelela oyingozi kakhulu ngokuqhubeka kwesikhathi," kusho yena.

Uthe kudingeka ukuthi kuqashelwe kakhulu uma abantu abadala besebenzisa ama-anticogulant, imishanguzo evimbela ukopha, ngoba eminye yayo yenza ukuthi wophe kakhulu ngisho nasezimeni lapho ulimale kancane nje.

"Inkinga wukuthi kwesinye isikhathi kuba nzima elungwini lomndeni ukubona ukuthi uma mhlawumbe umuntu ekhubeke, wawa phansi ulimale kangakanani, nokuthi uyaludinga yini usizo lwabezempilo ikakhulu uma kungabonakali lutho olukhomba ukulimala. Kodwa okumele kwazeke wukuthi kungenzeka kungabonakali inxeba noma ubunjalo bomonakalo, kodwa kungenzeka kuye ngokuya kubonakale izimpawu zomonakalo," kuxwayisa yena.

UDkt Mutyaba udalule ukuthi izinkomba ezigqamile zalokhu zingabonakala ngokuthi umuntu abonakale sengathi udidekile nje emqondweni. Uthe: "Lokho kusho ukuthi basuke bedinga usizo lwezempilo oluphuthumayo, kanti futhi kuyasiza ukuthi basheshe bahlolwe ukuthi akonakalanga lutho yini olunganakekile. 

Ezinye izimpawu kungaba wukuthi umuntu angakwazi ukulala kahle noma angakufuni ukudla. Kwabanye kuba nobuhlungu obunganqamuki emhlane.

UDkt Mutyaba udalule nokuthi ukuhamba kweminyaka kwenza ukuthi umuntu ehlelwe yizinga elifanele lomqondo, okungenza ukuthi ube sengcupheni sokungenwa kalula yizifo.

"Yingakho kumqoka ukuqikelela ukunakekela ingqondo yethu ngokuqaphela uhlobo lokudla esikudlayo, nangokuthi sikhethe kahle uhlobo lwempilo esiyiphilayo. Laba abanesifo sikashukela kumele bawulawule ungadli amagalane, bese kuthi uma unenkinga ye-cholesterol ephezulu ufune iseluleko kwabezempilo ukusiza ukuthi wehlise amathuba okuphathwa yisifo sohlangothi," kucebisa yena.

Amathiphu ongawasebenzisa ukugwema ukuwa uma usumdala:

- Ungahlali wedwa: Lokho kungaba nzima ngoba abantu abaningi asebekhulile bathanda ukuzihlalela ngabodwana, futhi baba nenkani uma sekuyisikhathi sokuthi bahlale nomndeni wabo. Kodwa ukuhlala nabantu abakuthandayo kungakusiza ukuze unakekeleke, nokuthi usheshe usizakale uma uba senkingeni enjena.

- Qoqa omata phansi: Labo abanakekela abantu abadala abaqikelele ukususa omata phansi, noma babeke ngokucophelela nangendlela engeke ibe yingozi kubona ngoba kungenza kube lula ukuthi bakhubeke bawe phansi balimale.

- Ungadlaleli ezitebhisini: Kunzima ebantwini asebekhulile ukukhuphuka ngezitebhisi ngakho akumele kube yinto abadlalela kuyona njalo, ngoba ngenye yezinto ezingenza kube lula ukuwa ikakhulu uma kungaselula kuwena ukubhalansa nokuzimela ngokwakho.

- Akukhanye ngokuphelele endlini: Qikelela ukuthi kuhlale kukhanya zikhathi zonke endlini ehlala abantu abadala, ukusiza ukuthi kube lula ukubhalansa nokugada ukungawi.

UKUKHULA ebona unina ezabalazela ukuchumisa amabhizinisi akhe ehlukene kwenza uNkk Naledzani Mosomane waba nentshisekelo yokubona abanye osomabhizinisi bekhula futhi bechuma emabhizinisini ehlukene abawaqalayo ukusiza ukuzicabela ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Luqale lapho lwase lukhula unomphelo uthando lwakhe lwezamabhizinisi nezezimali, kangangokuthi kuthe esekhulile washisekela ukuzicebisa ngolwazi lwezifundo zezimali nezamabhizinisi ngenhloso yokubamba iqhaza ukusiza osomabhizinisi abasafufusa.

UNkk Mosomane, ozalwe eGoli, wakhulela ePolokwane nasePitoli, manje uyinhloko yophiko olubhekele ukuthuthukisa nokuxhasa amabhizinisi ehlukene lweStandard Bank Group. Uthe lolu wuhlobo lomsebenzi olwenza ahlale eziqhenya ngeqhaza abalibambayo emphakathini.

"Lokhu kusukela ekutheni umama wami wayewusomabhizinisi, enenkampani yokupheka futhi edayisa izimpahla zokugqoka nemikhiqizo ehlukene. Ngimbonile ezabalaza phambi kwami, kwaze kwafika ekutheni abe nebhizinisi lendawo yokulala, elisekhona namanje - okwenza ukuthi nami ngikhule nginentshisekelo yokubona osomabhizinisi bethuthuka," kusho uNkk Mosomane.

UNkk Mosomane uneziqu zeBachelor of Accounting Sciences neHonours in Accounting Sciences zase-University of Witwatersrand, bese kuba yiMaster's In Development Finance ayiphasa ngamalengiso e-University of Stellenbosch; ulwazi lwemfundo olumsize ukuthi afike esigabeni sokuba yiChartered Accountant ngokusemthethweni.

"Ngiqale ukusebenza ePrice Waterhouse Cooper ngo-2012 ngiwumncwaningi mabhuku wakhona, kwase kuthi ngo-2015 ngajoyina iStandard Bank ngiyi-operations manager, ngenza futhi eminye imisebenzi egcine ingifikisa kulesi sigaba esengikusona manje, nengisinikwe ngokusemthethweni ngonyaka odlule," usho kanje.

Uthe umsebenzi wakhe wansuku zonke ubandakanya ukuqhamuka namacebo nezisombululo zokusiza osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukuze bachume, bese futhi esebenzisana nezinhlaka ezahlukene ezixhasa osomabhizinisi ukufeza lowo mbono.

"Asigcini ngokukhipha usizo lwemali kuphela kosomabhizinisi, kepha sibasiza nangokuthi bathole imakethe ezokwenza ukuthi imikhiqizo yabo idayiseke ukuze esibasiza ngakho kungapheleli emoyeni," kusho yena.

"EZOLIMO zifana nobizo kimina futhi ziwumkhakha engiwenza ngingaphushwa wuthando lokufisa ukuba yisigwili, kepha yinto engifisa nengihlale ngisebenzela ukuthi ukuba khona kwami kuyona kusize nabanye abalimi abaningi abeza emva kwami ukuze bachume."

Usho kanjalo uNksz Ntombiyenkosi Mtshali, umnikazi wenkampani yezolimo iSizisizwe Organic Fresh Produce Market, elandisa ngokwenza ahlale enomdlandla wokuyibamba noma ishisa kule mboni yezolimo ayizwa ngaphakathi.

UNksz Mtshali, waseMondlo, eVryheid, uthe uthando lwale mboni yinto eyasheshe yaziveza esemncane kuyena njengoba ekhule ekhonze ukutshala izithombo zezitshalo ezehlukene kubo. Lokho kwenza ukuthi ngisho esekhulile wahamba ngalowo mgudu kwaze kwazoba yimanje.

"Yingakho kuthe ngonyaka odlule, sengingene ngaze ngagxila kulo mkhakha, ngaqala umbono wokuthi kukho konke engikwenzayo, kusizakale nabanye abalimi abeza ngemva kwami abafisa ukuchuma kule mboni. Lo msebenzi ngiwuqale ngokuthi ngenze iqoqo lapho engihlanganise khona abalimi abehlukene, ukuze ngazi futhi ngiqonde konke abashoda ngakho, ngibasize ukuze bathole amathuba angcono," kusho yena.

Eqhuba, uthe okunye okumsizile ukuze aqale lolo hlelo wukuthi bese evele egabe ngezicucu ezahlukene zale mboni nokunye okweyamene nayo okubalwa kuzona iDiploma in Medical Office Assistant yase-Intec College, isitifiketi se-Agro-Processing sase-AgriSETA, ese-Seedling Production yaseSanvatalia, ese-Marketing eKPI nese-Climate azenze online eNigeria.

"Nokho akubanga lula njengoba ngaphambi kwalokho ngike ngatshala imali eningi kule mboni kepha kunzima ukuchuma kahle,  kuke kwaba nezikhawu lapho obekuthi sengisebenze kakhulu, kube khona izimo ezingibuyisela emuva njengokushoda kwamanzi, bese kokunye kuba nenkinga yendawo engisuke ngiyiqashele ukulima, obekwenza ukuthi ngihlale ngisebenzela emuva njengenkukhu," kusho uNksz Mtshali.

Nakuba engakabi nendawo ethi yena yokusebenzela, kepha uNksz Mtshali uthe kuyamjabulisa ukuthi usesize abalimi abangaphezu kuka-60 ahlale ebalekelela ngamava akhe kule mboni ukubatholela imakethe yokuhweba ngomsebenzi wabo.

"Ngiyabahlomisa nangolwazi ezintweni okudingeka ukuthi bazenze noma bazigweme ukuze umsebenzi wabo wenzeke ngendlela efanele. Mina ngisizakala ngokuthi uma labo balimi sebevuna imikhiqizo yabo, bayiletha kimina ukuthi ngibasabalalisele yona ezitolo nasezimakethe eziningi enginobudlelwano obuhle nazo, bese kungena imali kanjalo.

Udalule ukuthi enkampanini yakhe useqashe abasebenzi abawu-20 abasiza ngokuqhuba umsebenzi wabo wansuku zonke, uveze nokuthi okuhle kakhulu asekuzuze ngaleli bhizinisi wukwakha ubudlelwano nezinhlaka zezolimo zakoJapan, Libya nase-India.

"Lokho kungisiza kakhulu ngoba uma kunemikhiqizo esilungele ukudayiswa, ngibuye ngisebenzise lobu budlelwano bethu ukuyithengisa kulawo mazwe, okusisiza kakhulu senze inzuzo enkulu kunesiyenza ngokudayisela ezweni lethu," kuchaza uNksz Mtshali.

Ucebise abantu abasha ukungawubukeli phansi lo mkhakha awuchaze ngokuthi ukuleyo mikhakha emqoka neyikusasa lokwakha umnotho nokusimama empilweni.

"Ngakho ngibakhuthaza ukuthi bangene ngobuningi kwezolimo, futhi bazimisele ngokusebenza kanzima zikhathi zonke ukuze bawubone umvuzo wokuzikhandla kwabo, ikakhulu ngoba isikhathi esiphila kusona manje sinendlala yamathuba omsebenzi, kepha ngapha kwezolimo  kunamathuba amaningi okwenza ingcebo," kucebisa yena. 

UBUHOLI belinye lamahhotela ahlonishwayo nasezakhele udumo nogazi ebantwini ngenxa yezinga lalo, iZimbali Lodge, sebumemezele ukuthi bubheke ukwenza inzuzo elinganiselwa ku-R478 billion ngaphambi kokuphela kuka-2032.

Lokho kungenxa yohlelo lwezinguquko nolokuthuthukisa leli hhotela eliseBallito, enyakatho yeTheku, oluqhubekayo kumanje nonhloso yalo wukusiza ukuthi libukeke kangcono kakhulu kunobukhazikhazi elivele liyibona kumanje.

Lolu hlelo luzokapakela kuwona wonke amagumbi ehhotela, azolungiswa ngaphandle nangaphakathi, bese kwenyusa nezinga lobukhazikhazi, ubuhle balo nokunye okuhambisana nalokho - okuzosiza nangokuthi ligqame endaweni elakhiwe kuyona.

Leli hhotela eligabe nangezindawo ezintathu zokusingatha imicimbi okuyi-Signature Suite Boardroom, Canopy Conference Room neHibiscus Room - kuzobe sekuqediwe ngazo zonke izinguquko ezenziwa kulona ngoJanuwari ngonyaka ozayo.

Imenenja yenkampani ephethe ihhotela iDream Hotels & Resorts, uMnuz Bailey Bhima, ithe inhloso yabo enkulu ngalezi zinguquko wukwenza iZimbali Lodge ibe sezingeni elizohambisana nezidingo zamakhasimende abo, nangaphezu kwakulindele nakujwayele.

"Lolu hlelo esilwenzayo nesiqhubeka nalo kumanje luzoqinsekisa ukuthi zonke izivakashi ezifika ukuzokwenza imicimbi endaweni yethu zikwenza ngempumelelo lokho nangezinga eliphezulu, bese futhi siqhubeka lapho sigcine khona ngobuntofontofo nobunyoninco esiqikelela ukukunika lelo nalelo khasimende elisuke lizongcebeleka endaweni yethu," usho kanje.

UBUHOLI benye yezindawo zokuvakasha futhi eyifagugu esizweni nehlonishwayo ezweni nasemhlabeni jikelele iSimangaliso Wetland Park, bethule ubuchwepheshe besimanje obuzosiza ukuhlola izingabunjalo lamanzi olwandle lwakuleli paki yonkana.

Lokho kushiwo yimenenja yophiko lokonga nokuhlonipha imvelo kuleli paki, uMnuz Siboniso Mbhense, ohambweni lwezinsuku ezine lwabezindaba obelusengxenyeni yaleli paki eseSt Lucia, enyakatho yeKwaZulu-Natal, lokukhombisa ngobuhle nobumqoka bale ndawo.

UMbhense udalule ukuthi inhloso yabo ngalobu buchwepheshe bezinga eliphezulu wukuthi bakwazi ukuhlola ukuthi amanzi asolwandle lwaleli paki asesimeni esifanele nesigculisayo yini, nokuthi babone uma kuba nezinguquko ezithile kulona nsuku zonke.

"Lokhu kuzosisiza ukuthi sibone ukuthi kwenzekani emanzini ngenxa yezizathu ezahlukene, kusinike isithombe esicacile ngokuthi ukungenisa kwemifula uMsunduzi noMfolozi kuba nomthelela onjani epakini lethu, futhi kuzokwenza nokuthi sibone konke okwenzekayo olwandle nasepaki lethu ebusuku ukuze siqaphe yonke into," kusho uMbhense.

Eqhuba, uthe akupheleli lapho sebezokwazi nokubona kahle ukuthi izilwane ezihlala olwandle, okungaba yizinhlanzii nezinye - zigcineke kahle yini, baphinde bakwazi ukuthi babone ukunyakaza kwazo, ukuphumela ngaphandle nokubuyela kwazo emanzini.

"Sizokwazi nokubona nokuthi ungakanani usawoti osemanzini, ophumayo nongenayo, nokuthi lokho kwenzeka ngasizathusini. Yinto ezosisiza kakhulu leyo ukuthi siqonde kahle ukuthi isimo sepaki lethu sinjani, nokuthi sazi ukuthi uma kwenzeka izinguquko ezithile zidalwa yini nokuthi azinabungozi bunii kithina uqobo," kulanda uMbhense.

Uthe konke lokhu kuyingxenye yocwaningo lwabo abahlose ukusebenzisa konke abazokuthola kulo, bese bekwazisa umphakathi ukuze wazi okumele ukwenze nokumele ukugweme ukusiza ukuvikela imvelo namagugu aleli paki .

“Sizosebezisa futhi lolo lwazi esizoluthola ekuphothuleni kwethu lolu cwaningo ukucebisa abalimi bethu abakhele ipaki ngokuthi ukusebenza kwabo bangenza kanjani ukuthi kungabi nabungozi emvelweni yethu, nokuthi baqonde ukuthi yiziphi izindlela okumele bazisebenzise ukuze amanzi asuka epaki lethu ezoba wusizo kubona,” usho kanje.

NJENGOBA sekusondele isikhathi samaholidi okuphela konyaka, abantu abaningi emhlabeni wonke jikelele bazobe bevakashela izindawo ezahlukene zokuvakasha benzela ukuthi bapholise ikhanda futhi bajabule nothandiweyo babo njengoba futhi abaningi bazobe sebevalile emsebenzini, benesikhathi sonke sokungcebeleka, bakhohlwe wokuningi.

Yingaleso sizathu uMasipala weTheku ubambisane noPhiko lwezokuVakasha eThekwini bebuthane endaweni yezokuvakasha Isithumba Adventure Park & Travel, KwaXimba, entshonalanga yeTheku - ukuzokwethula umkhankaso wezinhlelo zabo zezokuvasha zamaholidi okuphela konyaka, nokukhuthaza abantu ukuvakasha ngala maholidi.

Yilapho engithole khona ithuba lokubukisisa futhi ngicwaninge le ndawo yezokuvakasha eyakhiwe endaweni yasemakhaya futhi okubonakala ngokucacile ukuthi ayikathuthuki njengezindawo ezahlukne esizaziyo nesizijwayele ezisemalokishini nasemadolobheni.

Nokho okuhle ngeSithumba wukuthi sinothe ngokuningi okukufundisa kabanzi ngobumqoka bemikhuba, amasiko nendlela yokwenza yesintu, okwenza ukuthi uqonde ukuthi kungani izinto ezithile zazenziwa noma zenziwa ngendlela ethize yesintu.

Kule ndawo kunezindlu ezingorawondi othi uma uuzovakasha, ungeniswe kuzona bese ufundiswa kabanzi ngezinto ezahlukene zesintu okubalwa kuzona ukuthi amakhambi esintu athakwa kanjani uma kwenziwa umuthi othize wokwelapha izifo ezahlukene.

Uma usukule ndawo ucaciseleka ngokuthi kungani abantu basezindaweni zasemakhaya bekholelwa emithini nasemakhambini esintu, okunye kwakho abaphephela kukhona ngoba bekhule izinto eziningi eziyingqalasizinda emqoka zingekho eduzane nabo, okwenza ukuthi bakwazi ukuqhamuka namaqhinga okusebenzisa imvelo ukuziphilisa nje.

Khona futhi kule ndawo, uma uvakashele khona uthola nethuba lokuqwala intaba ewububanzi obungama-kilometre awu-10, okuthi uma uqhubeka nohambo lokuyiqwala, ube ucotshelelwa ngolwazi lwezinto ezimqoka zobuntu, amasiko nesintu. 

Yindawo okuthi uma ukade uyivakashele, uhambe usuvuleke amehlo ngezinto eziyimfihlakalo yemvelo nemikhuba eyahlukene eyayigilwa ngabantu kudala ukuthi babeyigila kanjani. Okunye kwalokho wukuqonda ngemfihlo yokuthi abantu bakudala babenza kanjani ukugadlana ngamakhathakhatha, ukuthi amakhambi ayethakwa kanjani uma ufuna ukushaya umuntu ngezulu nokunye okujulile okweyamene nalokho.

Inkampani ekhiqiza ukudla iTiger Brands inxusa amakhasimende kuthi abuyisele ezitolo umkhiqizo wabo wokunonga ukudla i-Benny Beef Flavored Stock Cubes kanye ne-Benny Chicken Flavored Stock Cubes, ekhiqizwe i-Culinary Division, ngenxa yokulebula okungalungile kokudla okunempilo ephaketheni.

Le nkampani ibalula izinga likasawoti eleqile kweminye yemikhiqizo kanti ithatha lesi sinyathelo kulandela ukuxhumana kayo nekhomishini kazwelonke yabathengi. Nakuba ingakazitholi izikhalo zabathengi mayelana nemikhiqizo ethintekile. Lesi sinqumo sihambisana nokuzibophezela kwaso emazingeni aphezulu kakhulu futhi esizuzisa abathengi baso.

I-Tiger Brands isebenza namakhasimende ayo ezitolo nezitolo ezinkulu ukuze isuse yonke imikhiqizo ethintekile ye-Benny Flavored Stock Cube emashalofini esitolo. Lokhu akufaki eminye imikhiqizo emakethe adayiswa ngaphansi kohlobo lwe-Benny.

Imikhiqizo eyingxenye yalokhu ihlanganisa osayizi bephakethe le-cube engu-12, 24 kanye no-48 be-Benny Flavored Stock Cubes ku-Beef kanye ne-Chicken flavour anezinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi ezibhalwe umhla ka-31 kuJulayi 2027 nanoma yiluphi usuku lwangaphambilini.

NJENGOBA esephelile amaholidi okuphela konyaka, seluqale phansi ushikishi lokufukulana ngezamabhizinisi eDurban University of Technology, ngohlelo lwayo lokuthuthukisa kufukulwe izitshudeni ezinothando nentshisekelo yezamabhizinisi i-Innobiz DUT.

Lokho kuqale ngokuthi le nyuvesi ithumele izitshudeni zayo eziyisithupha ziyoyimela embuthanweni wokucobelana ngezamabhizinisi ozoba amasonto amabili eSuranaree University of Technology, edolobheni iBangkok, eThailand.

Lezo zitshudeni oMpilwenhle Malinga weThink Waste Africa, Phindi Thokozani Buthelezi weMyco-Feeds, Mpumelelo Gwala weCreative Wrap SA, Olwethu Mncwabe weReigh Technology, Ndumiso Mngomezulu weLubelo Tech Solutions noSiyethemba Lusanda Ngema we-Isithenjwa Holdings PTY LTD.

Kulolu hlelo lwezamabhizinisi olubizwa nge-SUT Global Entrepreneurship Camp kusuke kubuthene inqwaba yosomabhizinisi abasafufusa abayizitshudeni zasemazweni omhlaba awu-10, ngenhloso yokucobelana ngolwazi lokuthuthukisa amabhizinisi.

Indikimba yanonyaka ithi Sustainable and Resillient Communities: Innovating for a Healthier Plannet and People, uqale ngoMgqibelo uze uphethwe ngoMsombuluko wangoFebhuwari 9.

Izitshudeni ezizobe zikulolu hlelo zizoba nenhlanhla yokuhlonyiswa ngolwazi lokuthi amabhizinisi azo ziwamaketha kanjani, ukuthi zenzani uma zifuna ukufaka izicelo zokuxhaswa kuwona, amasu nezindella zokubhekana nezinselelo zebhizinisi, nokuthi yimaphi amathuba okumele ziwabambe ngezandla zombili ukuze zizithuthukise.

Imenenja ye-Innobiz DUT Centre, uNksz Nontokozo Ngcobo, ithe kuyabajabulisa ukuthi balokhu beqhubeka nokusiza izitshudeni zabo ezinothando lwezamabhizinisi ukuthi zifukuleke futhi zithuthuke. Uthe eminyakeni edlule sebesize izitshudeni ezingaphezu kuka-500 ngamathuba afuze leli emazweni okubalwa kuwo iFinland, Australia, China neRussia.

“Sibheke ukuthi konke kuhambe kahle, futhi sithemba ukuthi izitshudeni zethu zizoqikelela ukucosha lonke ulwazi oluzozisiza uma sezibuyile ekhaya zizoqhubeka nezifundo zamabhizinisi, bese zenza nomehluko obonakalayo emphakathini,” kusho uNksz Ngcobo.

INKANTOLO yeSifunda eMtubatuba igwebe uVusumuzi Jetro Thabethe (45) iminyaka ewu-15 ngokubulala umuntu ethaveni.

UThabethe wayeyiphoyisa eliwu-Sergeant embuthweni we-South African Police Service (SAPS) ngesikhathi sesigameko.

Ngo-29 September 2024 ntambama, uThabethe owayengekho emsebenzini, waya ethaveni yendawo. Wafica umufi uSanele Sihlongonyane (40) ehleli etafuleni ephuza nabangani bakhe. UThabethe noSihlongonyane babazana kahle. Etafuleni likamufi kwakukhona ibhakede, nokwathi uma uThabethe efika walithatha. USihlongonyane wasukuma wamlandela efuna ibhakede lakhe. Balandelana baze bafika phandle bafika baxabana bebanga ibhakede. 

Ummangalelwa washaya umufi ngequpha kwasuka isidumo kwaliwa, wahosha isibhamu somsebenzi wadubula phansi. Umufi wambuza ukuthi kungani edubula kodwa yena waqhubeka wamdubula ebusweni. UThabethe wangena emotweni wadubula emoyeni washaya wachitha. Abantu ababekhona baphuthumisa uSihlongonyane esibhedlela kwafika kwathiwa useshonile.

Washaya imoto waya emaphoyiseni eNgwavuma wayozinikela khona washo ukuthi usedubule umuntu. UThabethe waboshwa khona lapho. Enkantolo, uMshushisi uPhumlani Thembalethu Khoza ubize ofakazi ababili abazibonela nodokotela owahlola isidumbu sikamufi. Kwabizwa nesazi sezibhamu owaqinisekisa ukuthi isibhamu esadubula yisona impela esasiphethwe wuThabethe.

UThabethe ulahlwe ngecala ngaphansi kuka-Section 51(2) of the Criminal Law Amendment Act 105 0f 1997 okuhambisna nesigwebo seminyaka ewu-15. Inkantolo ithe ummangalewa akafanelwe wukuba nemvume yokuphatha isibhamu. Ummangalelwa wayeyiphoyisa, bekufanele ahloniphe umthetho. 

USHAYELELE isipikili sokugcina ngokuhlakazwa kobuholi be-SACP KwaZulu-Natal, umhlangano oyisipesheli wamaKhomanisi obungeledlule.

Lokhu kuvezwe yisitatimende esikhishwe yile nhlangano ngoLwesine, emva kwalo mhlangano obungoJanwuari 23, 2026.

Isitatimende sithe, umhlangano obubheka ukusebenza kwale nhlangano eKZN, uvumelene ngesinyathelo seCentral Committee, sokuhambisana nesinqumo sango-Okthoba 2025 seSACP Politburo, sokuhlakaza ubuholi baseKZN.

"Lufinyelele esiphethweni udaba lokuhlakazwa kobuholi baseKZN, njengoba kwafakwa ithimba lesikhashana ukwengamela lesi sifundazwe. Okuseqhulwini kuleli thimba ukuhlelela ingqungquthela yesifundazwe lapho kuzokhethwa abaholi abasha," kusho isitatimende.

Abaholi abahlakazwa ababeholwa nguNobhala uMnuz Themba Mthembu, bayayichitha eyokuhlakazwa.

Laba baholi bakholelwa ekutheni bahlakazwa ngenxa yokungahambisani nesinqumo sokuzimela kwamaKhomanisi okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya.

INHLOKO yoKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uMajor General Lesetja Senona, iyingxenye yamaphoyisa amahlanu uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, afuna ukuthi aphenywe.

Igama likaSenona livela ohlwini lwamaphoyisa uRamaphosa aphakamise ukuthi aphenyelwe izinsolo zokusebenzisana nemigulukudu.

USenona usolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala.

URamaphosa uphakamise ukuthi amaphoyisa amahlanu aphenywe emva kokucubungula umbiko awunikwa ikhomishini ephenya izinsolo ezenziwa uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi.

Amanye amaphoyisa uRamaphosa afuna aphenywe uMajor General Richard Shibiri, Brigadier Mbangwa Nkhwashu, Brigadier Rachel Matjeng noSergeant Fannie Nkosi.

Onke la maphoyisa asolwa ngokusebenzisana nemigulukudu.

URamaphosa uyalele uNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa obambile, uSolwazi Firoz Cachalia, ukuba asungule ithimba elizophenya izinto ezivela kwikhomishini.

URamaphosa uphinde wayalela ukuba kuthathelwe izinyathelo amaphoyisa kuMasipala wase-Ekurhuleni, okukhona kuwo nesikhulu samaphoyisa kamasipala esimisiwe, uBrigadier Julius Mkhwanazi.

Kube nemibuzo igama likaNgqongqoshe wamaPhoyisa omisiwe, uMnuz Senzo Mchunu, lingaveli ohlwini lwabantu okufanele baphenywe.

Okhulumela uRamaphosa, uMnuz Vincent Magwenya, uthe uRamaphosa ufuna ukunika uMchunu ithuba lokuba ayoziphendulela phambi kwekhomishini ngaphambi kokuthi amthathele izinyathelo.

Khonamanjalo, ikhomishini eholwa iJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga iqhubekile izolo nokupheka ngebhodwe elincane uSenona.

Ikhomishini ifune ukwazi ukuthi kungani uSenona engazange ayohlolwa emshinini okwazi ukubona umuntu oqamba emva kokulahleka kwezidakamizwa zezigidi zamarandi ezazigcinwe oKlebe.

USenona utshele ikhomishini ukuthi onke amaphoyisa ayesebenza ngesikhathi oKlebe beshaqa izidakamizwa zika-R200 million, aya kohlolwa umshini. Lezi zidakamizwa zantshontshwa zigcinwe oKlebe ePort Shepstone.

USenona uthe onke amaphoyisa ahlolwa kwatholakala ukuthi awazi lutho ngokulahleka kwezidakamizwa. Ubuzwe ukuthi kungani yena engahlolwanga, wathi umphathi wakhe akashongo ukuthi kufanele naye ahlolwe.

"Angicabanganga ngaleso sikhathi ukuthi nami ngicele ukuba nami ngihlolwe. Umuntu ongiphethe uyena okwakufanele asho ukuthi angiye kohlolwa nami. Mhlawumbe kufanele engabe ngacela nami ukuthi ngihlolwe. Emhlabeni siyafunda zonke izinsuku. Kukhona isifundo engisitholile nami. Isifundo engisitholile sizongisiza kakhulu ngomuso."

USenona ubuzwe ukuthi engavuma yini uma kungase kushiwo manje ukuthi akayohlolwa, wathi akasiboni isidingo sokuthi ahlolwe manje.

"Ngabe uzama ukusho ukuthi kufanele nami ngiyohlolwa? Sesidlulile isikhathi salokho."

KUHAYIZE owomndeni eNkantolo yesiFunda yaseNtuzuma, ngesikhathi abemhambele elahlwa ngecala lokubulala umuntu ayesebenza naye, owaqala ngokusula igazi lakhe ngesigqoko sikamufi ngaphambi kokuba ambulale.

Ummangalelwa kuleli cala, uVuyani Ngubane (23) kuvela ukuthi wadubula wabulala uMnuz Xolani Stanley Mkhize (21) esigamekweni esenzeka ebhusha iCicephu eNanda, ngoJulayi 30, 2023.

Udweshu kuthiwa lwaqala ngesikathi uNgubane ephumela emnyango eqhumisa phezulu isibhamu sakubukisa amahlandla amaningana nje impela kanti uzolimala kabuhlungu esandleni.

Kuthiwa kwathi esebuyela ngaphakathi ebhusha isandla sakhe sasesivuza igazi, kwala noma esezama ukulisula ngethishu. 

Kuthiwa kwathi uma ebona ukuthi igazi liyaqhubeka nokuvuza wamane waqonda nje ngqo kumufi owayehlezi eyedwa wafika kuyena wamhlithwa isigqoko sakhe ayekade esithwele, wabe esesula ngaso igazi maqede wambuyisela.

Lokhu kuthiwa kwamnenga kakhulu umufi kodwa wabuye wehlisa umoya. Ngemuva kwesikhashana, uMkhize waphumela emnyango eyobamba ucingo lwakhe kanti uNgubane nabangani bakhe bazomlandela.

Esephandle umufi, kuthiwa omunye wabangani bakammangalelwa akachithanga sikhathi, wamphuca iselula yakhe ngemuva kwalokho uNgubane wase evele emdubula ebusweni kubuka wonke umuntu.

Umufi waphuthunyiswa emtholampilo waseNewtown C, eNanda, ngoba wayesaphefumula. Nokho kuthiwa kwafike kwamenela esefike khona.

Ngemuva kwalokho, kuthiwa uNgubane wagcwala amathafa amaphoyisa ayesezithendeni zakhe agcina embamba njengoba akhalelwa ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngoSepthemba 30, ngawo u-2023, emva kokuba kutholwe umkhondo wakhe ase enikela khona emaChobeni, eNanda.

Izolo inkantolo ikhiphe isinqumo ngaleli cala. IMantshi yesiFunda uMotala iqale ngokusola ummangalelwa ngokukhombisa okukhulu ukungazisoli ngesikhathi kuqhubeka icala. Ithe kunalokho, uvele wakhetha ukuhhubhuza akabhejane.

''Konke obukutshela inkantolo ubumane uziqambela amanga njengoba nakhu bewenzela ukuthi uphunyuke. Indlela owenze ngayo ikhombisile ukuthi awunandaba nesenzo sakho futhi akukho nokuncane nje ukuzisola onakho,'' kusho imantshi yesifunda ikhuluma ibhekise kuyena ummangalelwa.

Iqhubeka imantshi yesifunda, income kakhulu ofakazi ababili okuyibona abethula ubufakazi kuleli cala. Ikhulume nange-video eyadlalwa enkantolo lapho eyayiveza khona konke okwenzeka ngesigameko. Ithe le video yalekelela kakhulu ngoba iyona eyaveza ngokusobala ukuthi ngampela ofakazi bakhuluma okuyikho ngoba nabo bayabonakala kwi- video bekubona okwenzekayo.

Ummangalelwa ubekade ebekwe yinkantolo amacala amathathu, kuwona wonke utholwe engekho msulwa. Ubebekwe icala lokuphuca umufi iselula, elokubulala kanjalo nelokutholakala nesibhamu esingekho emthethweni futhi esixikizwe izinombolo.

Womathathu lawa macala ummangalelwa wawaphika. Ubonakale edangala ummangalelwa ngesikhathi imantshi yesifunda imtshela ukuthi iyamlahla ngecala.

''Noma ungathini nawe uyazi ukuthi ngampela unalo icala yingakho nenkantolo ikuthola unalo,'' echaza.

Imantshi uMotala ithe bekumqoka kakhulu ukuba ikhiphe isinqumo okuyisona ukuze kuzocaca ukuthi izinkantolo ziyakwazi ukwenza umsebenzi wazo.

Umndeni kammangalelwa usale udangele waphuma unxapha enkantolo, kubonakala ukuthi kulukhuni satshe ukuba ukwamukele lokhu okwenzeka enkantolo.

Ngemuva kokuba imantshi ikhiphe isinqumo, omunye wesilisa okukholakala ukuthi ungowomndeni uhlulekile ukuzibamba, wamane wahayiza kakhulu enkantolo. Kuze kwadingeka ukuba omunye ahambe naye amkhiphele ngaphandle kwenkantolo.

Omunye womndeni kamufi uzwakale ethi: ''Nakhuya, nazoke! Siyoshisa inyama namhlanje.''

Kulindeleke ukuthi uNgubane agwetshwe ngesonto elizayo.

Isigcawu ebesiholwa yijaji eselathatha umhlalaphansi, uJaji Bernard Ngoepe, siyithole ingenalo icala ebelingayilahlekisela ngomsebenzi inhloko yamajaji e-Eastern Cape uJaji Selby Mbenenge ebisolwa ngokuhlukumeza ngokocansi unobhala wenkantolo uNksz Andiswa Mengo. 

UMbenenge utholwe enecala ngokuthi waba nobudlelwano noMengo ngokumthumelela imiyalezo enocansi phakathi nangezikhathi zomsebenzi.

UMbenenge watshela isigcawu ukuthi wayezitshela ukuthi imiyalezo babethumelelana noMengo ngoba naye wayeyifuna. 

UMengo wathi ijaji lalimcela izithombe enqunu futhi eminye imiyalezo wayeyiphendula esaba ngoba engumphathi wakhe. 

Wathi kokunye uMbenenge wazama ukuthi amncele ubudoda bakhe emahhovisi amajaji asenkantolo. Isigcawu sikuchithile lokhu sathi akunasisekelo.

UBONGE izaguga ezamkhulisa umfundi waseMondlo, eVryheid izolo obe kubafundi abanikwe imali engango-R5 000, ukuthi bayoqhuba izifundo zabo ezikhungweni eziphambili zemfundo.

USinokholo Mhlungu, obefunda eSolomuzi High uveze ukuthi uyaziqhenya ngokusebenza kanzima okumenze waba kubafundi abahamba phambili ezikoleni ezakhele iZululand.

Ekhuluma neSolezwe, uthe ubonga ugogo nomkhulu abamkhulisile wakwazi ukuzimisela.

"Ngikhuliswe ngokuthi kuhle ukuhlonipha noma yikuphi lapho osuke uhamba khona, ngakho esikoleni yilapho ebengizimisele khona ngoba bengifuna ukuthi ngenze kahle. Ezifundweni zami kusuka kuGrade 10, bengizitshela ukuthi ngifuna ukwenza kahle ukuze ngihambe ngiye esikhungweni semfundo ephakeme ngiqhubeke nokufunda," kusho uSinokholo.

Uthe imali yoxhaso abayitholile izobasiza kakhulu njengoba abanye babo bentula futhi bengazi nokuthi bazoyithathaphi imali yokuyobhalisa.

"Siyabonga kuMasipala ngokusinika lolu xhaso lokuqhuba imfundo. Siyathemba ukuthi konke kuzohamba ngendlela uma sesihambile, ngiyanxusa nabanye abaku-matric ukuthi bazimisele njengoba kuthela izithelo ezinhle ekugcineni," kuchaza yena.

UMnuz Sifiso Mkhwanazi oyiMeya yaseBaqulusini uthe zingu-15 izikole eziphase kahle.

"Sibonga ukuthi kuzona zonke izindawo akukho mibhikisho esike saba nayo, ethinta ukungenami kwabafundi, okunye okusijabulisayo wukubona izingane ziphasa kahle izifundo iMaths nePhysics. Ngiyanxusa ukuthi othisha bazimisele kakhulu  baqinise kulezi zifundo, angisho ukuthi abanye othisha abenzi kahle kodwa lezi zifundo zombili yizona ezithandwa kakhulu manje futhi ezinamathuba amaningi omsebenzi," kusho uMkhwanazi.

Uthe imali abayinike abafundi ayichazi ukuthi njengoMasipala banemali kodwa bekumele bakwenze lokhu ukubonga abafundi.

Uveze ukuthi izidingo eziya emphakathini basazoqhubeka nokuzisa noma ngaphansi kwasiphi isimo.

"NGENKATHI ngisakhula umama ubesebenza emajalidini abelungu, obekwenza ukuthi njalo uma ephuma khona asiphathele ama-crayon namanye amathuluzi okudweba ukuze sizidlalele ngakho ekhaya, engazi ukuthi kuzokwenza ngibe nentshisekelo yokudweba."

Usho njalo uNksz Hlengiwe Ngubane, elandisa ngohambo lwakhe ngomkhakha asegxile kuwona we-Architecture, okuwumkhakha wezokwakha futhi ohambisana nemisebenzi ebandakanya ukudweba uhlelo lokuthi indlu yakhiwe kanjani, bese besiza abantu ngokubacebisa ngokuthi bakhe imizi ezindaweni ezinjani, nokumele bakugweme.

UNksz Ngubane, udabuka eMpophomeni, eMgungundlovu, kanti manje uzinze eThekwini ngalo msebenzi awenzayo. Manje engenye yama-lecturer aseDurban University of Technology (DUT), lapho efundisa khona isifundo salo mkhakha iConstruction Technology.

Ngale kwalokho ungomunye wabasunguli benkampani edweba amapulani ezindlu, iKhumalo's House Plan ayihola noMnuz Sthembiso Khumalo. Udalule nokuthi kumanje uvele umatasa ne-app ebizwa ngeProject X, abheke ukwenza umehluko ngayo kule ndima.

"Le app izosiza ngokuxhumanisa amakhasimende nomakhi abehlukene futhi abathenjwayo kulo mkhakha. Izokwenza ukuthi kube lula ukulandelela wonke umsebenzi abasuke bewenza ukuthi bawenza ngendlela efanele yini.Izokwenza ukuthi kube nendlela yokufaka imininingwane yalowo nalowo msebenzi osuke sewenziwe uma kwakhiwa.

"Izokwazisa ikhasimende ukuthi kungakanani okusuke kusadinga ukwenziwa andukuba kuphele wonke umsebenzi wokwakha. Izosiza nangokuthi singabi bikho isidingo sokunika umakhi imali yokuthenga impahla yokwakha, njengoba kuzoba nendlela yokuthi uthenge konke okudingekayo ngokwakho usebenzisa yona. Izosiza nangokuthi uma ufuna ukwakha, ikucebise ngokuthi indlu yakho kumele ime kanjani," kusho uNksz Ngubane.

Eqhuba, uthe lona womunye wemikhakha emqoka kakhulu newusizo ebantwini ngokubasiza ukuthi uma befuna ukwakha bahlome ngolwazi lokuthi kumele bakhe kanjani. Kungagwemeka nezingozi ezihlale ziba khona zokudilika kwezindlu zabantu ngenxa yokuthi kunezinto eziningi abasuke bengaziqaphelanga ngenkathi beqala uhlelo lokwakha izindlu.

"Wumkhakha onamathuba amaningi, futhi osimama kalula kuwona uma usungene kahle wathola nentuba yokwenza ukuthi wehluke kwabanye. Okunye okuqaphelekayo ngawo wukuthi ugcwele abesilisa, okungenye yezinto ezingikhuthaze ukungena ngigxile kuwona ngenhloso yokukhombisa ukuthi abesifazane bangangena kuwona," usho kanje.

Ebuzwa ngezinhlelo zengomuso uthe: "Ngifuna ukuqhubeka ngikhiqize intsha ezokhula ibe nolwazi olunzulu lwalo mkhakha, nokuthi amava ami alo msebenzi angisize ukuthi kuvuleke eminye iminyango eminingi namathuba amaningi okuthuthuka ngalo msebenzi. Ngifuna ukuba  wusizo ebantiwni basezindaweni zasemakhaya ngokubanikeza ulwazi lokwakha izindlu zabo ngendlela engezukuba nabungozi kubona."

UNksz Ngubane uneziqu zeBachelor of Architectural Studies, Bachelof of Architecture Honours ne-Master of Architecture kokuthathu akufundiswe e-University of KwaZulu-Natal; iCertificate in Contruction Project Management yase-University of Johannesburg; bese kuzoba yiDoctor of Philosophy in Architecture aqhubeka nayo kumanje e-DUT. 

I-KAIZER Chiefs iqinise amathuba okudlulela kuma-quarterfinal eCaf Confederation Cup ngokunqoba kwiZESCO United yaseZambia emdlalweni ka-Group D odlalwe ngeSonto ntambama, eMoses Mabhida Stadium, eThekwini.

Ngokunqoba izolo, Amakhosi anyukele endaweni yesibili kwi-log ka-Group D ngamaphuzu ayisikhombisa. Nokho konke bekuncike emdlalweni wezinkunzi zase-Egypt, i-Al Masry neZamalek esishicilele ungakapheli. Igoli leChiefs lishaywe nguGlody Lilepo esiwombeni sokuqala somdlalo.

Ukunqoba kweChiefs kushiya amathuba ayo ama-quarterfinal ezandleni zayo kwazise asalelwe yimidlalo emibili yamaqoqo ezoyidlala ne-Al Masry ePeter Mokaba Stadium, ePolokwane, ngempelasonto ezayo noweZamalek eCairo, maphakathi noFebhuwari.

Bekumele kuyiwe ekhefini iChiefs isihamba phambili ngembudlu yamagoli kodwa bekucaca ukuthi amakhokho okubhakuzisa inethi uwashiye ekhaya uFlavio Da Silva. Lo mgadli uthole inqwaba yamathuba kodwa amehlula.

IChiefs okuqale umdlalo inewini eyodwa kusukela kuqale iConfederation Cup, ibingadlalisi okweqembu elilambile yize bekusobala ukuthi umdlalo iwuphethe futhi nabo bonke abalandeli abebesenkundleni bahamba nayo.

Ngokubona ukuthi liyayishonela kulo mqhudelwano, i-ZESCO iqalile ukusuka emuva yahlasela okuwufudumezile umdlalo yize ibingeyona ingozi kangako kuBrendon Petersen obezipholele ezintini zaMakhosi.

Womabili la maqembu enze izinguquko kodwa obekusobala yizimpawu zokubambelela kweChiefs kulokhu ebisikuphethe esandleni. Imizamo yeZESCO nayo bekusobala ukuthi ayenziwa ngokungacabangi.

“Akufanele siwudedele umgqigqo wethu. Uma siphumelela ukwenza, lokho nakanjani isicoco seligi sizogoduka naso,” kusho uMoremi.

UMQEQESHI weKaizer Chiefs, uCedric Kaze, ukhwele wadilika kwabangamhloniphi, abamgxekayo nabambukela phansi yena nozakwabo, uKhalil Ben Youssef, wathi ekupheleni kwesizini inkukhu iyobe isinqunywe umlomo. .

UKaze ubekhuluma nabezindaba ngemuva komdlalo weBetway Premiership ezakhe eziwunqobe ngo 1-0 ziguqisa iLamontville Golden Arrows ngoLwesibili ebusuku eFNB Stadium, eNasrec. 

Kusukela uKaze noBen Youssef bethathe izintambo zokuqeqesha kwiChiefs ngemuva kokushiya kukaNasreddine Nabi ngoSepthemba, ikhombisa ukuvuka emaqandeni nakuba ikhona imidlalo ephunyule kuyona amaphuzu kungafanele. Amakhosi asendaweni yesithathu kwi-log yePremiership ngamaphuzu angu-27 emidalweni engu-14. Ahlukaniswe ngamabili neMamelodi Sundowns esesicongweni ngawu-29. 

IChiefs isahlulwe kanye emidlalweni engu-14 yePremiership esayidlalie, kanti ayikangenelwa yigoli emidlalweni eyishumi ukubala nowangoLwesibili.

Kumanje leli qembu laseSoweto lisesigabeni samaqoqo kwiCaf Confederation Cup.

Nokho, phezu kwalokho kusekhona abasashaya amakhala ngokulungela kukaKaze noBen Youssef ukuhola leli qembu ngokugcwele njengoba besengamabamba azoshayela umkhumbi waMakhosi kuze kuphele isizini.

“Anginawo umuzwa wokungathenjwa lapha eqenjini kodwa nginokwesekwa okukhulu kusukela kubaphathi kuya kubadlali, nabo bonke ozakwethu ethimbeni labaqeqeshi. 

Kodwa kwesinye isikhathi nginokubona sengathi kunabanye abangaphandle abazama ukwakha izinto ezingekho. Kukhombisa ukungahloniphi uma abantu bekhuluma ngesikhundla somqeqeshi ekubeni esekhona umqeqeshi osekuleso sikhundla. 

Abanye balabo baqeqeshi abathi bafuna lesi sikhundla, bathi bazowinela leli qembu izicoco kodwa uma uthi ubheka umlando wabo akukho zicoco asebeke baziwina.

Kwesinye isikhathi abantu bakhuluma ngalabo baqeqeshi bengawazi ngisho amagama abo. 

Siyayazi into esiyenzayo, sineziqu zokuqeqesha, futhi ekupheleni kwesizini ngiyafunga ngiyagomela ukuthi sizohlangana nalabo abasigxekayo futhi bonke bazobe sebexolisa ngokusigxeka kwabo,” kusho uKaze. 

UKaze ukhuluma kanjena nje, umqeqeshi uDylan Kerr, ukhulume kwi-podcast iSoccerbeat ukuthi iChiefs angayiwinisa iligi. 

Yize Amakhosi ebalwa namaqembu amathathu aphezulu kwi-log kodwa lo mqeqeshi ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi okumqoka kubona wukuhlala emshungwini wabanga isicoco kuze kuphele isizini.

“Ngesizini edlule asingenanga kwi-Top 8, ngakho okumqoka kithina kule sizini wukuthi siqhubeke nokuba phakathi kwamaqembu aphezulu kwi-log. Sizolwa kuze kuphele isizini, sibone ukuthi siphelelaphi," kusho uKaze.

UMQEQESHI weLamontville Golden Arrows, uManqoba Mngqithi, uphinde wazwakalisa ilaka lakhe ngobumqoka bokuthi kuphuthunyiswe ukwethulwa kwe-Video Assistant Referee (VAR) kwiBetway Premiership ngenxa yesivinini emidlalweni yale ligi.  

UMngqithi obedinwe egane unwabu, ubekhuluma ngemuva kokuba ezakhe ziguqiswe yiKaizer Chiefs ngo 1-0 wegoli lika-Aden McCarthy emdlalweni wePremiership ngoLwesibili eFNB Stadium, eGoli.

Lo mqeqeshi ukubeke kwacaca ukuthi bekungafanele livunye igoli likaMcCarthy ngoba beliyi-offside engatolikelwa.

“Akuwona umphumela ebesiwufuna lo, okubi nakakhulu ukudliwa ngegoli eliyi-offside. Angifuni ukusola onompempe ngalokhu kodwa ngicabanga ukuthi sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi iligi iyibheke ngelinye iso indaba yobumqoka be-VAR ngoba iqiniso wukuthi imidlalo isidlalwa ngesivinini esiphezulu kakhulu

Kunzima kakhulu konompempe ukulandela yonke iminyakazo. Ngisho nathi ezinye izinto sizibona sekudlule isikhathi sesibuka ama-video,” kusho uMngqithi ongaqali ukukhala nge-VAR.

Kubaluleke kakhulu sibe nayo i-VAR manje. Asidlaleli u-R200 lapha, sidlalela uR20 million. Ngakho njengeligi enkulu e-Afrika kumele senze kangcono. Silahlekelwa yimisebenzi singabaqeqeshi nabadlali bayahlawuliswa ngabaqeqeshi ngamaphutha.”

UPHIKO lwezokuvakasha esifundazweni, iKwaZulu-Natal Tourism and Film Authority (KZNTIFA) lwethule umkhankaso walo waminyaka yonke wendlela yalo yokwamukela nokuhlangabeza izivakashi eziphuma zingena ukuzovakasha eKZN ngala maholidi kaDisemba noNcibijane.

Lo mkhankaso ubuwenziwe ngasemgwaqeni omkhulu u-N3 egalaji likaphethiloli i-Ultra City, eMtshezi, maphakathi neKZN, ngoLwesihlanu - lapho okugcwala kakhulu khona inqwaba yabantu abasuke bedlula khona ukuphumula, wukwetha uphethiloli nokuthenga umphako kwendlela.

Lolu hlelo luyingxenye yendlela yokwamukela izivakashi eziza eKZN ngamaholidi, njengoba kulindeleke ukuthi sifinyelele ku-1.1 million isibalo sohambo lwabantu abazobe bevakasha ezindaweni ezahlukene kulesi sifundazwe, nabangangaphezu kwa-34 000 abazobe besuka emazweni ehlukene emhlabeni jikelele. 

Inhloko yophiko lokuxhumana nezobudlelwano eKZNTIFA uNksz Pinky Radebe uthe lokhu abakwenzile kuyingxenye yezindlela abazisebenzisa ukwamukela izivakashi zabo, nokukhombisa ukuthi bakujabulela kangakanani ukuthutheleka kwazo ukuzovakasha eKZN.

“Lokho sikwenziswa nawukuthi ukucwaninga kwethu kukhomba ukuthi uDisemba noJanuwari yisona sikhathi esimatasa kakhulu kwezokuvakasha, okufakazelwa nawukuqagula kwethu okukhomba ukuthi kusuka ngoJanuwari kuya kuJuni wangonyaka ozayo kubhekwe uukuthi kube nohambo lwabantu abavakasha eKZN olufinyelela ku-4.3 million, kube yizivakashi zasemazweni omhlaba eziwu-387 155 - lokho okuzosiza ukuthi kungene imali elinganiselwa kuR13.4 billion emnothweni wethu,” kusho uNkk Radebe.

Eqhuba, uNkk Radebe uthe nakuba bekuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi iTheku yilona dolobha eliqengeleza phambili ngezokuvakasha, kepha kusemqoka nokuthi abantu bakhuthale ukuvakashela nezinye izindawo ukubona okwehlukile nabangakwejwayele.

“Yiqiniso ukuthi iTheku lihamba phambili, kepha futhi nezinye izindawo ezisenhla nesifundazwe, ezimaphakathi naso, neziseningizimu zikhombisa ukukhula kakhulu, okudinga ukuthi kuqhubeke ukuthi ziqhakanjiswe ukuze ubonakale kahle umehluko eziza nawo,” usho kanje.

Bayenze yehluka kwamanye amaCountryman ngokuyihlobisa kwibhonethi nakwi-grille. Baphinde bafaka amarimu angu-18 inch ahlukile emasondweni angama all-terrain.

Uma uthanda uyakwazi ukuyithwalisa ibhokisi lezimpahla okhakhayini okanye okokufaka ibhayisikili.

Ngaphakathi Inomata abamelana nanoma yikuphi ukungcola.

Amakhasimende azokhetha phakathi kwezimbili iCountryman C neCountryman S.

ICountryman C inenjini engu-1.5 litre kaphethroli eyi-three cylinder. Inamandla angu-115kW ne-torque engu-230Nm.

Kwabafuna amandla athe xaxa, kuneCountryman S enenjini engu-2.0 litre eyi-four cylinder. Wonke amandla angu-150kW ne-torque engu-300Nm angena kuwo wonke amasondo.

I-Automobile Association (AA) isizwakalise ukukhathazeka ngezinga lokuphepha kweToyota Corolla Cross kulandela ukuthola kwayo izinkanyezi ezimbili ngesikhathi kuhlolwa indlela evikela ngayo abagibeli abadala uma iba sengozini.

I-Corolla Cross, eyakhiwa eProspecton, eThekwini, ibihlolwa ngaphansi komkhankaso weGlobal NCAP i #SaferCarsForAfrica.

Ithole izinkanyezi ezintathu ngokuvikela izingane.

I-AA ithe iCorolla Cross inama-airbag omshayeli nomgibeli ngaphambili, eyaseceleni emzimbeni, eyasedolweni ohlangothini lomshayeli ne-Electronic Stability Control (ESC). Ithe kodwa ayinakho okokuvikela ikhanda nokuyinto ebalulekile ezimotweni zakamuva.

Izinhlobo ezibiza kancane zeCorolla Cross azinawo ama-curtain airbag njengezibiza imali ethe xaxa.

Ngokwemithetho yakamuva yeGlobal NCAP, zonke izinhlobo zezimoto kumele zibe nawo ama-curtain airbag ukuze zithole amaphuzu hhayi ukuthi umnikazi awathole uma ethanda noma kwezikhethekile.

Isikhulu seGlobal NCAP, uRichard Woods, sithe izinkampani ezifana neToyota ziyakwazi ukwakha izimoto eziphephile ngakho abathengi base-Afrika kumele bathole okokuphepha okufanayo nokutholwa ngabakwezinye izingxenye zomhlaba.

Uthe kuseqhulwini kubo ukuthi baveze lokhu kungafani okubonakalayo.

Isikhulu sakwa-AA, uBobby Ramagwede, sithe le miphumela iyakhathaza.

“Asikho ngempela isizathu sokuthi kungani kungabi khona okokuvikela ikhanda ohlangothini kwintandokazi iToyota Corolla Cross. Lokhu kuyaphinda kuveza umkhuba oqhubekayo wokuthi izimoto ezidayiswa e-Afrika azikho ezingeni lokuphepha njengezakwezinye izindawo. Abashayeli baseNingizimu Afrika bafanelwe okungcono kakhulu ngoba iCorolla Cross yakhiwa lapha futhi yakhiwe efemini yakwaToyota eProspecton KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uRamagwede.

IToyota South Africa Motors ithe iyazi ngesitatimende se-AA mayelana nemiphumela yokuhlolwa kweCorolla Cross.

URefilwe Ramatlhodi Ndhlovu oyiCorporate Communications Manager, uthe iCorolla Cross ihambisana nayo yonke imigomo yakuleli yezokuphepha futhi iyayedlula.

“ICorolla Cross inezinto eziningi zokuphepha ezihlanganisa ama-airbag omshayeli, umgibeli, ohlangothini nasedolweni kumshayeli kanjalo nama-curtain airbag kwiXR neGR-S.”

Uthe iphinde ibe nokunye okubalwa kukho iVehicle Stability Control, ABS, Brake Assist ne-Electronic Brakeforce Distribution kuzo zonke izinhlobo.

Uthe imiphumela yeGlobal NCAP iqondane nesikhathi lapho bebesabhunga ngokuthi ama-curtain airbag kumele atholakale kuzo zonke izinhlobo zeCorolla Cross edayisa kuleli.

Wumbala omesha kahle ne-grille ngaphambili abayishinshile futhi emnyama, i-spoiler esimnyama, yikubhampa ngezansi ohlukile nalapho kuhlala khona ama-fog lamps nakhona okumnyama.

Amarimu angu-18-inch nawo mahle amnyama amesha amakhava ezibuko, isitebhisi sokugibela nama-roof rails.

Amawindi angemuva adimile abagibeli ngeke ubabone. Ngemuva bayifake i-diffuser emnyama ephelelisa ubuhle bayo.

KwaToyota benze isiqiniseko sokuthi awukhohlwa ukuthi yi-GR-S ngoba amabheji bawafake yonke indawo kusuka ngaphambili, ezinhlangothini kuze kuyoshaya ngemuva.

Vula isicabha ubingelelwa yingaphakathi elimnyama sucu elidle ngezitishi ezibomvu nokuyenza ibe-sporty. Okunye okuyenza sporty ngama-pedal shifters emuva kwesiteringi nama-pedal ezinyaweni okucwebezelayo.

Izihlalo zihlanganise isikhumba ne-suede.

Kukancane nakhona ukukhohlwa ukuthi yiGR-S ngoba iqoshwe ezindaweni eziningi.

Ngaphambilini yilapho ikuceba khona ukuthi isikhathi sesihambile ngoba inomgxusha wegiya kanjalo ne-handbrake. Igiya ngiyakuthanda ukuthi uyakwazi ukulikhiya linganyakazi nokuqinisa ezokuphepha.

Inakho kodwa okubalulekile njenge-touchscreen infotainment system odlala kuyo umsakazo ngezipikha zeJBL.

Uxhuma kuyo iselula nge-Apple CarPlay. Imbobo yokushaja ngaphambili iyodwa futhi ayikho indawo yokushaja ngaphandle kwentambo nokungezinye zezinto eziveza khona belu ubudala.

Zikhona kodwa ezimbili ngemuva kanjalo nembobo ye-twin plug.

Ngemuva isikhala sikahle futhi kulula nokulalisa izihlalo abagibeli abaya kwezokugcina bangene kalula.

Izihlalo zokugcina nokuzigoqa kulula kodwa kuyasithatha isikhala ukuthi azilali mba phansi, kunalokho zivaleka zime ezinhlangothini.

Ngesikhathi sengiyisusa okokuqala engikuqaphelile wukusinda kwesiteringi. Ngeke uze uyifanise ne-MU-X khona esithambile.

Amandla yinto enawo njengoba inenjini engu-2.8 litre turbo kadizili eno-gearbox oyi-6 speed auto. Asenyusiwe angu-165kW ne-torque engu-550Nm.

Iyasukuma impela isheshe ingene ejubaneni. Angiphathi khona uma uke wayifaka kuSport, iyayicela indlela. Amanye ama-drive modes akhona u-Eco uma ufuna ukonga no-Norm. Kudizili ibidla amalitha angu-9.0 ngo-100km.

Njengoba i-suspension beyishintshile nje, ngiyizwe ibambelela kangcono emakhoneni nasobhuqwini.

Etiyeleni iMU-X ngayizwa ithe ukuba ntofontofo kangcono.

Obhuqwini inakho konke okudingayo njengokuthi uyenze idonse ngawo womane amasondo, diff lock ne-hill descent control. Amathuba okushayisa mancane futhi ngoba inamakhamera aveza wonke umzimba ngaphandle.

Iphinde ibe nezinsiza zomshayeli emgwaqweni njengokuthi ikubuyise emzileni uma uphuma noma ikwenza ngamandla kancane njengoba ivele ibhrike kwamanye amasondo ukuze izojika. Okunye enakho yi-Adaptive Cruise Control.

E-Australia kubikwe ukuthi ngeke isadayisa iFortuner ngoba ayithengwa, kunalokho kudayisa kakhulu izimbangi njengeMU-X neMitsubishi Pajero Sport.

IDOLOBHA iTheku ngelinye lamadolobha adlisayo KwaZulu-Natal nasezweni lonke ngobumnandi nezindawo ezahlukene zokuvakasha ezinobukhazikhazi obudida unwabu, nobumnandi nje obenza ukuthi ukhohlwe yizinsizi nokukuhluphayo.

Yingakho enye yezinkampani zamahhotela aseThekwini iSouthern Sun nophiko lwezokuvakasha eThekwini, iDurban Tourism, beqale uhlelo lokuqhakambisa izindawo zokuvakasha ezahlukene eThekwini namaphethelo, lapho bememe khona abezindaba ukuzokhangisa ngobuhle obungajatshulelwa ngabantu ngamaholidi kaDisemba.

Kulokhu kuqale ngokwehlukile nongeke ukulindele ukuthi ungakuthola eThekwini, njengoba lolu hambo luqale eDoonside Beach, eKingsburgh, eningizimu yeTheku, lapho ongathi uma uvakashele khona ushaywe wumoya opholile wolwandle, futhi ujabulele nokuhamba ngehhashi, litotobe nawe esihlabathini solwandle, ukhohlwe yizinsizi.

Enye yezindlela leyo ehlukile umuntu angazijabulisa ngayo uma ezoshaywa wumoya eThekwini, ngokuthi uqhele kancane enkabeni yedolobha; wenzele nokuthi ushintshe umoya, ujabulele ulwandle oluqhelile kancane edolobheni, kodwa futhi kube mnandi ngokufanayo.

Enye futhi indawo yokuvakasha enganakekile kepha enezinto eziningi ongazithokozela ebonakale  kulolu hambo yi-HighStakes, eseCato Ridge, entshonalanga yeTheku okuthi uma uvakashele kuyona ujabulele imidlalo ehlukene ehlakaza umqondo okukhona kuyona i-quad biking, lapho uthubeleza ngesithuthuthu, unqamule emahlathini, uqwale nentaba.

Kule ndawo kukhona nomdlalo obizwa nge-zip line, lapho uhamba emoyeni uxhunyelwe entanjeni, uhlakaze umqondo nje ukhohlwe yizinto eziningi. Khona lapho futhi ungenza  neminye imidlalo ongayithokozela o-paint ball shooting, clay pigeon shooting ne-archery - imidlalo yobumnandi ongeke uzitshele ukuthi ungayithola eThekwini.

Konke lokhu kusiza ngokuthi uhlakaze umqondo, ukwazi ukucabanga izinto ezihlukile, ubone ubuhle nobubanzi bomhlaba, futhi ubone nokuthi imvelo ijule kangakanani, okungakusiza ukuthi ubuye usucabanga ngenye indlela, futhi usunamacebo amasha okumelana nempilo.

Mhlawumbe-ke usungathi uma kuwukuthi ubulele enkabeni yedolobha futhi ungafuni ukuhamba ibanga elide, kodwa usafisa ukuthola nokujabulela ubumnandi - uvele uthi shwi eMojos Carwash & Shisanyama, eseMayville, okuyibangana eliyimizuzu ewu-15 uma usuka edolobheni. Lapho uzofike uzwe futhi ubone ubumnandi obehlukene baselokishini, obuxutshwe nobukhazikhazi, isitayela nempatho okutholakala ngaphakathi kule ndawo.

ZIGAYA ngomunye umhlathi izinto ecaleni lokubulawa kwekhansela elibhekene neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, njengoba selidluliselwe enkantolo yesifunda futhi kulindeleke ukuthi inkabi eboshwe nenkosi ivume icala.

Inkosi noChonco baboshwe kanye noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala kuleli cala. Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, owayeyinduna yenkosi, osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso.

UMHOLI we-ANC, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, uyamaniswa nemoto eyathengela ukudla izinkabi ezabulala ufakazi ecaleni lokubulala ayebhekene nalo. Icala lokubulala lagcina lihoxiswa emva kokubulawa kukafakazi. 

Kuvele ukuthi imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi okuya ngasethunjini ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo ufakazi woMbuso, uMnuz Martin Sithole, yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba komunye umholi we-ANC oqavile esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka.

Lokhu kuhlaluke eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu izolo, ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala lokubulawa kukaSithole nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Buthanani Shange.

USithole wabulawa ngo-2019.

UMahlaba oyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uke waba wumphathiswa wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, waba wumphathiswa wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko, waba umgcinimafa we-ANC esifundazweni.

Ngesikhathi eboshelwa icala lokubulala uNgobeni ngo-2019, wayeyimeya kaMasipala waseNewcastle, wayephinde abe usihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka.

USithole wayengufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengumholi we-ANC Youth League esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Wandile Ngubeni.

Ukubulawa kukaSithole kwaholela ekuhoxisweni kwecala lokubulala elalibhekene noMahlaba.

Imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi ukudla ngeyekhansela elisethimbeni lesikhashana elihola i-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Ally Khoza.

Abalisa abathathu, uMnuz Philani Thwala, Phakama Radebe noMmeli Nxumalo, babhekene necala lokubulala uSithole noShange.

Umshushisi omkhulu, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uvezele inkantolo izithombe ezikhombisa imoto eyayitshelekwe nguuMahlaba ishayelwa uThwala ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo uSithole.

Imoto yafike yathenga ukudla egaraji eliseNewcastle, ebusuku. I-slip sokudla okwathengwa yile moto satholakala endlini okwakulele kuyo izinkabi ezabulala uSithole.

UKhoza utshele inkantolo ukuthi imoto yakhe ewuhlobo lweveni yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba ngesikhathi okwabulawa ngaso uSithole, wathi uMahlaba waboleka imoto yakhe ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungawo u-2019.

"Wathi angimboleke imoto yami ngoba iphakeme, wanginika eyakhe mina ngasebenzisa yona."

UKhoza uthe uMahlaba akazange ambuyisele imoto yakhe nangemva kokuthi esethenge elakhe iveni.

Uthe kunalokho, imoto yakhe wayeke ayibone ishayelwa uRadebe kanye nabanye.

UKhoza uthe akakaze anikeze uThwala igunya lokuthi ashayele imoto, wathi futhi wayengamazi nokumazi.

Enye futhi indawo yokuvakasha enganakekile kepha enezinto eziningi ongazithokozela ebonakale  kulolu hambo yi-HighStakes, eseCato Ridge, entshonalanga yeTheku okuthi uma uvakashele kuyona ujabulele imidlalo ehlukene ehlakaza umqondo okukhona kuyona i-quad biking, lapho uthubeleza ngesithuthuthu, unqamule emahlathini, uqwale nentaba.

Kule ndawo kukhona nomdlalo obizwa nge-zip line, lapho uhamba emoyeni uxhunyelwe entanjeni, uhlakaze umqondo nje ukhohlwe yizinto eziningi. Khona lapho futhi ungenza  neminye imidlalo ongayithokozela o-paint ball shooting, clay pigeon shooting ne-archery - imidlalo yobumnandi ongeke uzitshele ukuthi ungayithola eThekwini.

Uma uwumuntu okhonze ezemvelo nokubuka izilwane zasendle ungadlula nasePhezulu Safari Park, lapho uzothola khona ithuba lokunqamula ehlathini noma singathi endaweni eyisiqiwi lapho kugcwele khona izilwane okukhona kuzona izinyamazane, amadube, izindlulamithi nezinye eziningi.

IBANDLA lamaNazaretha, eBuhleni, seliyichithe ngazo zombili indaba yezinsizwa zebandla ezikhangisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana izipho eziphezulu ezizithengela izintombi ezizikhetha ngosuku lokugcina lomhlangano kaJanuwari.

Njalo uma kuphela umhlangano kaJanuwari kuleli bandla izinsizwa ziya endaweni yaseSipholi lapho zikhetha khona izintombi ezifuna ukwakha imizi nazo.

Muva nje kulo mcimbi kushiyana umshefezo njengoba insizwa ikhipha amagwevu, ukukhombisa uthando enalo ngentokazi eyikhethile nezipho esuke iziphethe.

Kulo nyaka izinga libonakale linyuka kakhulu njengoba kukhona insizwa yaseMtubatuba, uSambane Zikhali, ephe uNosipho Biyela isipho semoto, ngesikhathi iqeda "kumxhawula".

Yize lesi sipho engasilethanga eBuhleni, kodwa izithombe besegaraji emnika imoto nomakhalekhukhwini i-i Phone 17, kushiye okukhulu ukwehlukana ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

Abanye bamncomile uSambane ngokunyusa izinga lezipho ekhombisa uthando kunkosikazi wakhe wakusasa.

Abanye bakhale ngokuthi lokhu akwenzayo kuzofaka incindezi ezinsizweni ezingenawo amandla alingana nawakhe, okungazenza ziphelelwe nawuthando lokuganwa.

Okhulumela ibandla lamaNazaretha aseBuhleni, uMnuz Thokozani Mncwabe, exoxa neSolezwe  uqale wancoma ubuhle bomhlangano walo nyaka ohambe kahle wathi bayabonga ukuhamba baze babuye kungenzekanga okubi.

Ube eseyichitha wathi ayilungile into eyenziwa yizinsizwa kuleli bandla njengoba konke sezikwenza ngehaba nokufuna ukubukwa.

"Sesifikile isikhathi sokuthi abefundisi bahlangane kukhulunywe ukuthi uma owesilisa eyocela intombi yini okumele iphathwe, ukuze kuvinjwe indaba yezinto ezifana nalezi esizibonayo manje. Umyalelo webandla ngokucelwa awuhambisani nalokhu osekwenzeka. Phambi kwamehlo eNkosi siyalingana, ezinye izinsizwa zizophelelwa amandla uma sezibona abantu benza kanjena. Akuwona wonke umuntu oyisigwili. Akunqatshiwe ukuthi uthengele umuntu wakho isipho esikhulu kodwa musa ukwenza emehlweni omphakathi," kusho uMncwabe.

Uthe eSipholi lapho kukhethwa khona izintokazi kuningi osekwenzeka khona okumele bakubheke ngamanye amehlo.

"Ayilungiswe indaba yaseSipholi. Sekwenzeke konke lokho sithanda nokubonga iNkosi uNyazilwezulu ngezinkomo azihlabela amaNazaretha eKhenana naseBuhleni ewabonga, nathi siyabonga kulo ngakho konke. Sibonge noMfundisi uNzama waseKhenana, izinsizwa zoBubambo ezazilungisa umgwaqo, zasilekelela ngokudla namatende ngesikhathi kuqala uhambo, abakwenzile iNkosi ibabusise," kuchaza yena.

Uthe njengamaNazaretha nakulo nyaka bayakhuthaza ukuthi kuphathwe kahle abesifazane, kuphele ngokudlwengulwa kwabo nokudliwa kwezidakamizwa.

UKHOLELWA ukuthi uyilingise ngendlela akade eyicabanga indawo kaNolwandle Biyela, umlingisi waseVryheid, uNosipho Pehlo, ngesonto eledlule, okuphele indawo yakhe kusizini yesibili yomdlalo i-Outlaws.

“Uma bekungathiwa nginikwa enye indawo kuthiwa angiyilingise kulo mdlalo bengingeke ngiyijabulele njengalena engiyitholile. Ngiyalibonga ithuba enginikwe lona ababhali bomdlalo njengoba ukuba kulo mdlalo kungenze ngakhula njengomlingisi futhi kwangivezela amathalente ahlukene nami enginawo njengeciko,” kusho uNosipho.

Uthe kuningi muva nje azokukhumbula kulo mdlalo, naye obekumethusa njengokuba la kuqoshwa khona izindawo ezinezimpi nokuyinto abengakaze abe kuyo ngaphambilini.

“Ukuba sendaweni enjalo uma siqopha kuthinte izinto izinto ezijulile kimi. Ngelinye ilanga saqeda ukuqopha ngaya la ngihlala khona ngangiqhaqhazela, ngikhala nami angazanga ukuthi yini eyadala lokho kodwa ngagcina ngibonile ukuthi umqondo uyakwazi ukuthwala konke obekwenzeka, umzimba wase uthwala ubunzima kungakho ngafikelwa isimo esifana nalesi. Ekulingiseni ngibonile ukuthi akumele nje ugxile ekukhumbuleni okumele ukukhulume nakukhamera kodwa umlingisi osuke unguye kumele umthwale agcine esenguwena,” kusho uNosipho.

Uthe kube umdlalo wokuqala lona kuye omkhulu ukubonakala kuwo njengoba esanda kungena ekulingiseni nafunde okuningi ngisho kozakwabo abadala akade ebambisene nabo.

Uveze ukuthi usizakale kakhulu ngokwazi ukusebenza nabanye abantu kanye nokubambisana nabo.

“Kuningi engikuthathile engiya nakho komunye umdlalo engizoba yingxenye yawo ukuya phambili. Mina njengoba indawo yami isiphelile ngiyabakhuthaza ababukeli ukuthi abaqhubeke bawubuke umdlalo ukuze bezobona ukuthi kugcina kwenzakaleni phakathi kukaBandile noTlali. UNolwandle uqedile okwakhe,” kusho yena.

AKUCACI ukuthi uzobuya nini ohlelweni lwasekuseni iThe Uprising, umsakazi weGagasi FM, uMinnie Ntuli osakaza lolu hlelo ngokubambisana noFelix Hlophe.

Lokhu kulandela isinqumo sakhe sokukhetha ukuma emsakazweni njengoba eke waba sematheni ‘ngobubhoklolo’ nangokuhlohloloza uLondie London ngomunwe ebusweni, ohlelweni iThe Real Housewives of Durban (RHOD) okuyinto eyacasula abaningi.

UMinnie sekuphele isikhathi esingaphezu kwamasonto amabili engenzwakali kulo msakazo.

Isolezwe libuze umthombo walo ongaphakathi kulo msakazo ukuthi izikhulu zakhona zithini ngokumbuyisela emsebenzini.

“Ngabe ngiqamba amanga indaba yakhe nje ayikaziwa ukuthi uzobuya nini emsakazweni. Kodwa uma kukhona engikuzwayo ngizokutshela, nakanjani bazosazisa uma ebuya,” kusho umthombo.

Omunye umthombo uveze ukuthi uMinnie usafuna usizo ngenxa yokuthi wagxekwa ngesenzo sakhe.

“Kuyoba yinhlanhla ebuyile emsakazweni, leya nto yambangela amahloni ngenxa yokuthi abanye bambona njengebhoklolo. Ukubuya azobhekana nozakwabo nabalaleli ababemgxeka ezinkundleni zokuxhumana,yikhona engibona sengathi ngeke kusaba lula. Ngokuzwa ngabasondelene naye uyasaba naye manje ukubuya ngoba akazi ukuthi uzohlangana nesimo esinjani uma esesemoyeni,” kuchaza umthombo.

Uveze ukuthi okunye okuzwile wukuthi umndeni wakhe wameseka kuvela lesi sehlo futhi bazama ukuthi bamfunele usizo ukuze abe wumuntu ongcono angaphinde azifake esimeni esinje.

UMinnie kwashaqeka abaningi kuvela isigameko esingakhonjiswanga kusaqhubeka uhlelo esagxekwa kakhulu.

Esitatimendeni asikhipha uMinnie wathi uyaxolisa kwanabo ohlelweni.

Waveza ukuthi ubathintile ngasese exolisa futhi uzimisele nangokukhuluma nabo ubuso nobuso. Wathi yize umsebenzi wakhe kwiRHOD ungahlangene noweGagasi kodwa yena nesiteshi bavumelene ngokuthi amukele imiphumela yezenzo zakhe.

Esitatimendeni esakhishwa yiGagasi, baveza ukuthi sabashaqisa lesi senzo futhi baphoxekile ngabakubone kwenziwa wumsakazi wabo.

“Yize iThe Real Housewives of Durban izimele futhi ingahlangene neGagasi FM, siyazi ukuthi ukuziphatha kukaMinnie ohlelweni kunomthelela egameni lethu nasemphakathini esiwusebenzelayo,” kusho iGagasi.

Lathi kumasizini adlule kuke kwabonakala abanye abasohlelweni bexabana beze becishe babambane ngezandla.

“Okusinikeza ithemba kulokhu wukuthi ukubuyisana kuyenzeka futhi nobudlelwano bulungiseke,” kwasho iGagasi.

Bathi njengesiteshi abahambisani nobubhoklolo nokungahloniphi.

IBIPHUMA ingena ezinkantolo izolo inkabi eboshwe neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma ecaleni lokubulawa kowayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu.

Umsocongi, uThabo Chonco, okuthiwa wakha itulo lokuqeda ngoNdlovu esejele, uvele ezinkantolo ezimbili izolo lapho ebebhekene namacala amathathu okubulala.

UChonco uqale wavela kafishane eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho ebebhekene necala lokubulala abantu abangu-10.

Kuleli cala uChonco usolwa ngokuba ungqondongqondo ecaleni lokubulawa kwabantu bakwaMemela.

Abantu bakwaMemela babulawa ngo-2023, elokishini eMbali, eMgungundlovu.

Leli cala lihlehliselwe ikusasa.

Uphinde wadlulela eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu, lapho ebhekene khona necala lokubulala uNdlovu kanye nelinye lokubulala owayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba eMpophomeni, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.

Amacala amabili abhekene noChonco abequlwa eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, adluliselwe kweyesifunda ngeledlule.

Ngesikhathi evele eHowick, uChonco wakuveza ukuthi ufuna ukulivuma icala lokubulala uNdlovu.

Bekungokokuqala ukuba avele enkantolo yesifunda. Amacala ahlehliselwe uFebhuwari 20.

UChonco usanda kugwetshwa odilikajele abahlanu ngecala lokuqotha abantu eBulwer.

Waphinde wagwetshwa iminyaka engu-15 ebhadla ejele ngecala lokubamba inkunzi.

Izolo uChonco ufike enkantolo ekinatelwe ngozankosi kanye namaketango elinye ebeliboshelwe okhalweni. Ubekakwe ojele abebehlome bephelele.

Inkosi nayo ivele kafishane enkantolo yesifunda izolo.

Amacala ayo ahlehliselwe uFebhuwari 20.

Inkosi ibhekene namacala amathathu. Imangalelwe noChonco ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu kanye nelokubulawa kukaNtombela/Ndlovu.

Inkosi iphinde ibhekane necala lokubulala owayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma.

Inkosi yanqatshelwa ibheyili ecaleni lokubulawa kukaNdlovu, isihlale ezikhindini isikhathi esingaphezu kwezinyanga eziyisithupha.

Bekugcwele phama enkantolo izolo, abantu befuna ukuzozibonela ukuqhubeka kwecala.

Abantu abebesenkantolo abomndeni wakwaNdlovu, abakwaZuma kanye namalungu eDA.

Abanye abasolwa ababoshwe kanye nenkosi abazange babonakale enkantolo izolo.
