KULINDELEKE ukuthi siqale maduze isiphithiphithi edolobheni iTheku kwabakhonze ubumnandi njengoba seziqalile izinhlelo zokujabulisa abantu ngobumnandi obehlukene, okulindeleke ukuthi kuqale ngenyanga ezayo - nokuzobandakanya idili lomculo elibandakanya nezihlabani zabaculi baphesheya kwezilwandle abangaconsi phansi.

Lokho kudalulwe yiMeya kaMasipala weTheku, uMnuz Cyril Xaba, ethula inkulumo yosuku emcimbini wakhe wokwethula umbiko wezibalo zokuvakasha zamaholidi kaKhisimusi noNcibijane, obuse-Octavia Boutique Hotel, eNanda, enyakatho yeTheku ngoLwesine.

IMeya idalule ukuthi iTheku seliqalile livivela umcimbi wedili lomculo wesihlabani somculo saseMelika u-Anton Hamilton, ozoba se-ICC, eThekwini ngoFebhuwari 28. 

Kulo mcimbi kulindeleke ukuthi u-Anthony, wodumo lwezingoma ezithi Charlene, i-Cool ne-Best of Me, abhulelwe amazolo womculi wakuleli zwe ongaconsi phansi kubalandeli uSjava.

Emva kwalowo mcimbi, kuzoba khona omunye wesihlabani somculi waseCanada uBryan Adams, ozoba ngoMashi 28 no-29 khona futhi e-ICC, eThekwini.

Ngaphambi kwalokho, kuzokhumbuleka futhi ukuthi ngonyaka odlule kwamenyezelwa ukuthi umcimbi wezindondo zomculo ama-Metro FM Awards,uza lana eThekwini e-ICC ngo-Ephreli 25. 

Kuzothi ngoJuni 4 kube nomunye umcimbi wedili lomculo weqembu le-band yase-England i-UB40 ezobe ihambisana no-Ali Campbell.

“Yonke le micimbi izosiza ngokugqamisa idolobha lethu ngokwenza izinto ezinhle, ikhulise umnotho wezokuvakasha bese futhi isiza ukufukula osomabhizinisi bakithi. Ngale kwalokho, sizolokhu siqhubeka sibamba iqhaza emicimbini nasezinhlelweni ezehlukene okuzosiza ukuthuthukisa iTheku, kulethe imali yabatshalimali bese futhi kuqinisa ubudlelwano bethu nezinhlaka ezahlukene zamazwe omhlaba,” kusho uXaba.

Ngale kwalokho, iTheku lizoqhubeka futhi libe nemicimbi elaziwa ngayo yaminyaka yonke okubalwa kuyona iDurban Tourism Business Awards - okuzovulwa imingenelo yawo ngenyanga ezayo, kube yiDusi Canoe Marathon, Durban International Marathon ngoMeyi, Comrades Marathon ngoJuni, iHollywoodbets Durban ngoJulayi neDurban International Film Festival ngoJulayi.

UKUTHATHA isinqumo “esinzima” sokubuyela esikoleni emva kweminyaka ewu-12 ashiya phansi isikole engakawuphothuli u-matric okokuqala, kuthele izithelo ezinhle nezibonakalayo kuNksz Samkelisiwe Xulu, ephasa ngamalengiso ku-matric wakhe awuphothule nyakenye.

Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe, uNksz Xulu (32) waseDoringkop, KwaDukuza, KwaZulu-Natal, udalule ukuthi u-matric wakhe wawenza okokuqala ngo-2012 esafunda ngakubo eShekembula High, kepha wawushiya phakathi exinwa wukugula okweyamane nezinkinga zokwesintu.

“Bengigula kakhulu futhi ngiphazamiseka ekufundeni kwami. Ngagcina ngishiya phansi isikole ngaboMashi ngalowo nyaka kwangabe kusaba lula ukuthi ngibuyele esikoleni ngokushesha. Bengilokhu ngiphila ngokubamba amatotho ezindaweni ezihlukene, ukuzama ukuziphilisa nokuzimela nokweseka umndeni wami,” usho kanje.

Eqhuba, uthe impilo abeyiphila ibingamgculisi njengoba ebehlale ethola imisebenzi engamjabulisi emalini kepha ibe imgqilaza emzimbeni nasemqondweni, waze wabona kufanele ukuthi abuyele esikoleni ukuzama ukucaba ikusasa eliqhakazile ngemfundo.

Uthe wabona isikhangiso sesikole iSinenhlanhla Secondary, esiseShakaskraal, khona KwaDukuza esasidinga abafundi, wanquma ukufaka isicelo sokufunda uGrade 11 khona, nangempela bamamukela - kwaba wukuqhubeka kohambo lwakhe lwemfundo.

“Ngizibambe zaqina kusuka lapho, ngangabe ngisabheka emuva. Ngazitshela ukuthi akusekho lutho namuntu okuzophazamisa imfundo yami, njengoba manje sengivuna engikutshalile - ngiphasa ngamalengiso izifundo eziyisithupha, engithemba ukuthi lokho kuzovula iminyango yamathuba angcono,” kusho uNksz Xulu.

Izifundo aziphase ngamalengiso yisiNgisi, isiZulu, Life Orientation, Dramatic Arts, History ne-Tourism bese kuba yiMathematical Literacy ayiphase ngo-level 6 (70+%).

“Konke lokhu ngithemba ukuthi kuzokhuthaza nabanye abeza ngemva kwami babone ukuthi imfundo ayikhulelwa nokuthi ukungaphumeleli u-matric wakho okokuqala akusho ukuphela komhlaba, kepha lisuke lisekhona ithuba lokufeza okunye ozifisela kona uma uzozitshela ukuthi uzophokophelela ukuphumelela ngemfundo yakho,” kusho yena.

Uthe manje usebheke ukuqhubeka nemfundo yakhe, enze izifundo zobumeli e-University of KwaZulu-Natal, ngenhloso yokusebenzisa azokufunda kuzona ukulungisa izimo nezinkinga ezihlukene ezibhekana nomphakathi nsuku zonke.

“Kuyangikhathaza ukubona kwanda izigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane nabantu besifazane kujike kungabi ndaba zalutho, engithemba nengikholwa wukuthi kuningi engingakwenza ukuzama ukukulungisa ngisebenzisa imfundo yami,” kusho uNksz Xulu.

'NJENGOBA ngiwuthisha ngiyibona nsuku zonke inkinga yezingane ezingenawo umdlandla wokufunda izincwadi, yingakho ngihlale ngisebenzela ukwenza okuthile ukuzama ukuqeda leso sihlava esibi emphakathini, ukuze kubuye isiko lokufunda nokubhala ebantwini abasha.'

Usho njalo uNksz Ntombenhle Dlamini, elandisa ngencwadi yakhe entsha yeqoqo lezindaba ezimfishane esihloko sithi Kwathiwa Yidliso, ezoqala ukutholakala ngoDisemba 22. Uyichaze ngokuthi ingenye yezindlela zakhe zokuqhuba umbono wokuhlenga ulwimi lwesiZulu.

UNksz Dlamini waseMhlabashane, eHighflats, kodwa osezinze eManzimtoti ngokusebenza, uthe uqale ukubhala le ncwadi ngoMashi nonyaka, waze waqeda ngoJulayi, kwase kuqala uhlelo lokuyihluza kusuka ngo-Agasti kuze kube yimanje.

“Ididiyele izindaba ezimfishane eziwu-20 ezinemiyalezo ehlukene futhi ezixwayisa kakhulu ngezinto abantu abayaye bazenze bengaboni ukuthi zingabafaka enkingeni. Futhi iveza nokuthi ukungalaleli nokukholwa ngokubona kuba nomvuzo omubi nobuhlungu kangakanani. Zikhona nezihluba udlubu ekhasini ngezenkolo nokunye okunjalo,” kusho uNksz Dlamini.

Eqhuba, uthe le ncwadi izobiza u-R200 kuyena uqobo, kanti usebenze kuyona nomunye wababhali bezincwadi uSizwe Ngidi, omlekelele ngokuyihluza ukuze iphumele ebantwini isisezingeni elifanele.

“Kule ncwadi kukhona nendaba ezofundisa abantu ngobumqoka bokuzihlupha ngolwazi lwezempilo, bese ibaxwayisa ngengozi yokuzidela nokubambalela kokukodwa abakholwa wukuthi yikhona okusiza ekuguquleni okuthile ngoba ngenye yezinto egcina yenza ukuthi umuntu adlule emhlabeni kungafanele ngoba engasukumanga kusenesikhathi,” usho kanje.

UNksz Dlamini onamava eminyaka ewu-15 ewuthisha, udalule nokuthi ngale kokuthanda ukuhlenga ulwimi isiZulu nokuqhutshwa wuthando lokubhala nokufunda kepha ufisa nokuthi adlondlobale aze afike esigabeni sokubhala imidlalo ezokhonjiswa kwithelevishini.

Le ncwadi yakhe ingeyesine njengoba eminyakeni edlule ebhale wakhipha izincwadi ezintathu okungethi Zinoju Zulu yezinkondlo yango-2021, kube ngeyezindaba ezimfishane ethi Kujiyile KwaMhlaba yango-2023, nenoveli yanyakenye ethi Akabange Esambona.

Ngalezi zincwadi usewole imiklomelo eyahlukene okubalwa kuyona ukuphuma phambili kwi-UJ Main Prize for Creative Writing in isiZulu ngo-2022, kube yindondo yeBest Author kwiZizamele Mbokodo Awards nyakenye, indawo yesithathu emncintiswaneni wezinkondlo othi Usiba Writers Guild, kwase futhi kuqokwa incwadi yakhe yezinkondlo ngaboMnyango wezeMfundo eGauteng, ukuthi ifundwe ezikoleni ezahlukene zakhona. 

ABANTU abaningi bacabanga ukuthi ukuba nenkinga yokushoda kwezakhi zokudla okunempilo nezibalulekile emzimbeni kwenzeka kuphela uma kungekho ukudla okwanele, kanti akunjalo njengoba lesi simo senzeka ngisho ukudla kukhona kodwa kuwukuthi lokho kudla akunazo izakhi ezinempilo nezidingwa kakhulu wumzimba ukuze uphile kahle.

Kungakhathalekile ukuthi lokhu kungenxa yobubha, ukukhetha ukudla okungenampilo noma ukuncika kakhulu ekudleni osekuthakwe ngezithako ezenza kube yingozi emzimbeni, kepha lesi simo singaqhubeka sithiye abantu abadala nabancane.

Lokhu kushiwo ngabesikhungo sezempilo esizimele i-Affinity Health, bexwayisa abantu ngobungozi bokushalazela ukudla okunempiilo, okudala ukuthi umzimba ungondleki ngendlela efanele phecelezi i-malnutrition.

Inhlangano yezempilo emhlabeni i-World Health Organization (WHO) isanda kubika ukuthi lesi simo sikwezihamba phambili emhlabeni ngokukhinyabeza impilo yabantu, futhi kuvela nokuthi siyisizathu sokushona kwezingane ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemihlanu emhlabeni jikelele - sinjalo nje siholela nasekutheni kube lula ukuthi umuntu aphathwe yisifo sikashukela, isifo senhliziyo, nokuthi akhuluphale ngokweqile.

UMA uvakashele kunoma yiliphi ibhishi noma kwi-swimming pool okusenkabeni yedolobha iTheku uhlale uzofica kukhona abasebenzi abayaluzayo kuze kushone ilanga nsuku zonke beqikelela ukuthi wonke umuntu ovakashele lezi zindawo uphephile,akulimali muntu - okungaba ngokuminza emanzini noma ukulimazana ngezinto ezithile kujatshulwa.

Obhekele ukuthi lowo msebenzi wenzeka ngendlela efanele nguNksz Zola Ndlovu, oyi-Aquatic Safety Manager kaMasipala weTheku, okusho ukuthi kusemahlombe akhe ukuqikelela ukuthi abasebenzi benza umsebenzi ngendlela efanele ukuze kuvikeleke izivakashi.

Engxoxweni ekhethekile neSolezwe ngomsebenzi awenzayo, uNksz Ndlovu udalule nokuthi okunye okumqoka okuhambisana nomsebenzi wakhe wukuqinisekisa ukuthi amanzi abantu ababhukuda kuwona asesimeni esifanele nesilungele ukuthi babhukude kuwona.

"Ngisebenzisana nabasebenzi bami abangaphezu kuka-197, okudingeka ngihlale ngiqikelela ukuthi akukho okuphazamisa umsebenzi wabo. Nakuba isikhathi esiningi ngiba sehhovisi lami - kepha ngihlale, ngihlale ngiyozibonela mathupha ukuthi umsebenzi bawenza ngendlela efanele nabafundiswe ngayo yini. Kungumsebenzi wami futhi ukuqhamuka namacebo okugwema izinkinga, nokubheka ukuthi iyiphi ingozi engase yenzeke emsebenzini wabo ukuze igwemeke kusenesikhathi," kusho uNksz Ndlovu.

Uthe lona wumsebenzi ongenamicilikisho yesikhathi eside njengoba udinga ukuthi uma usuphothule u-matric, wenze izifundo zeFirst Aid nSafety ukuze ube nolwazi lokuthi umsiza kanjani umuntu osuke edinga usizo oluphuthumayo, bese futhi uba nesicucu esizofakazela ukuthi uzokwazi ukuba semanzini ngaphandle kwenkinga uma kunezimo ezidinga lokho.

"Wumsebenzi ongakwazi ukuwenza emva kokuqeqeshwa izinyanga ezimbili kuya kwezintathu nje kuphela. Okumqoka wukuzibophezela ukufunda imithetho yakhona nendlela yokwenza izinto ukuze usebenze kahle," usho kanje.

Ebuzwa ngokwenza umsebenzi wakhe ube lula isikhathi esiningi, uNksz Ndlovu uthe usizwa wukuthi ugabe ngamava nangemfundo. Uneziqu i-Bachelor's Degree in Sports Science, Honour's in Recreation Management neMaster's in Business Administration (MBA) kokuthathu akwenze e-University of KwaZulu-Natal; bese kuba yisitifiketi seFacilities Management asithole e-University of Cape Town.

 "Ngiqale ukusebenza ophikweni lwezemidlalo eKZN ngo-2006 kuya ku-2009 ngiyiSports Promotions Officer. Ngisuke lapho sengiyosebenza kumasipala emsebenzini ofanayo kwaze kwaba wu-2012. Emva kwalokho ngakhushulelwa esikhundleni sokuba yiSenior Sports Officer, okuwumsebenzi engiwenze ngaze nganikwa lumsebenzi engiwenza manje," kusho yena.

Ukhale ngokuthi inselelo enkulu emsebenzini wabo wukuthi basebenza ngabantu, okuthi kwesinye isikhathi benze umsebenzi wabo ube nzima ngokufika emabhishi bedle mawala kwezikaFaro, okwenza kube nzima ukubalawula.

"Bakhona nabafika behlome ngezikhali eziyingozi, okuthi uma sekunezingxabano bafune ukulimazana. Lokhu kwenza ukuthi impilo yabasebenzi ibe sengcupheni ngoba kusuke sekudingeka ukuthi balamule ukuze kube nokuthula. 

"Okunye-ke uma uwumholi wesifazane njengami kuba khona lokho kubukeleka phansi kwabanye abantu ngoba benenkoleloze yokuthi ngeke ukwazi ukwenza izinto ezithile ngenxa yobulili bakho. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi usebenze ngokuzikhandla ngokuphindiwe ukuze umsebenzi wakho ucace futhi udlondlobale kuwona nsuku zonke."

Laba akuqali ukuthi benze ingoma ngokuhlanganyela njengoba benengoma ethi Romeo & Juliet eyashisa izikhotha.

Kodwa okwamanje ngizosho ngingangabazi ukuthi sisazoke sime ukusebenza ndawonye, esinye sezizathu esenze saphinde sakhipha izingoma ingoba besibona ngathi kukhona esikukweleta abalandeli bethu. Yisigcino sethu lesi okwamanje, sinika abantu umphako abazobambelela kuwo kuze kube sithatha isinqumo sokuphinde sisebenze sobabili futhi,” kusho yena.

Kungani kumele ngilalele iziyalo zakho?" kubhoka ngolaka uMaphorisa. Nabantu abaningi bavele bachema noMaphorisa, bagxeka uNota ngokunqwaha nemali yakhe ekubeni asebenza.

ZIGAYA ngomunye umhlathi izinto ecaleni lokubulawa kwekhansela elibhekene neNkosi Simphiwe Erick Zuma, njengoba selidluliselwe enkantolo yesifunda futhi kulindeleke ukuthi inkabi eboshwe nenkosi ivume icala.

Inkabi eboshwe nenkosi, uMnuz Thabo Mathonsi Chonco, kulindeleke ukuthi ilivume icala lokusoconga owayeyikhansela le-DA kuMasipala waseMngeni, uMnuz Nhlalayenza Ndlovu, uma isivela eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu, ngoMsombuluko. 

Icala lokubulawa kukaNdlovu lisuswe eNkantolo yeMantshi eHowick, labe selidluliselwa eNkantolo yesiFunda eMgungundlovu. 

Inkosi noChonco baboshwe kanye noMnuz Thobani Masobho Hlongwa noKhayelihle Shabalala kuleli cala. Omunye umsolwa, uMnuz Zwelithini Buthelezi, owayeyinduna yenkosi, osephenduke ufakazi woMbuso. 

UChonco kuthiwa uyena owahlela itulo lokusoconga uNdlovu nokuyitulo okuthiwa walicija esejele. Kuvele ukuthi uChonco uzolivuma icala. Isolezwe lithole ukuthi uChonco ngeke alifake igama lenkosi uma esevuma icala.

Umthombo osondelene nophenyo, uthe uChonco uzokhomba uButhelezi njengomuntu okuwuye owabathuma ukuba basoconge uNdlovu.

Ummeli kaChonco, uMnuz Khanyile, uthe uzophawula kahle ngoMsombuluko uma uChonco esevelile enkantolo. UChonco usanda kulahlwa yicala lokusoconga umndeni waseBulwer.

INkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu igwebe uChonco odilikajele abahlanu.

UChonco uphinde abhekane necala lokuqothwa kwamalungu omndeni wakwaMemela eMbali, eMgungundlovu.

Umholi we-DA KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Francois Rodgers, uthe kubaqinisa idolo ukudluliselwa kwecala enkantolo yesifunda.

"Lokhu kuyakhombisa ukuthi leli icala elibucayi, ingakho lisusiwe enkantolo yemantshi layiswa enkantolo yesifunda."

URodgers uthe bafuna ukuzwa ukuthi uChonco uzothini uma esevuma icala.

"Sifuna ukubona ukuthi uMbuso uzobusebenzisa kanjani ubufakazi bukaChonco. Into eyinkinga ngomuntu osuke evume icala ukuthi kusuke kusangenzeka ukuthi anqabe ukufakaza uma sekuqulwa icala."

URodgers uthe kuyabakhathaza ukushaya ngolonwabu kwaleli cala.

"Sizoqhubeka nokuqapha ukuqulwa kwecala. Amalungu omphakathi nomndeni wakwaNdlovu akufanele uvumele leli cala ukuba liphelele emoyeni."

Inkosi ilokhu yahlala ejele ngoJulayi, njengoba sachithwa isicelo sebheyili kanti ibibukeka idangele ngesikhathi ivele enkantolo izolo.

Ibhekene necala lokubulawa kowayengundunankulu wesizwe sakwaNxamalala, uMnuz Qalokunye Zuma nelokubulawa kowayelwa nokudayiswa komhlaba kamasipala, uMnuz Xolani Ntombela/Ndlovu.

UMHOLI we-ANC, uDkt Ntuthuko Mahlaba, uyamaniswa nemoto eyathengela ukudla izinkabi ezabulala ufakazi ecaleni lokubulala ayebhekene nalo. Icala lokubulala lagcina lihoxiswa emva kokubulawa kukafakazi. 

Kuvele ukuthi imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi okuya ngasethunjini ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo ufakazi woMbuso, uMnuz Martin Sithole, yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba komunye umholi we-ANC oqavile esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka.

Lokhu kuhlaluke eNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu izolo, ngesikhathi kulalelwe icala lokubulawa kukaSithole nomngani wakhe, uMnuz Buthanani Shange.

USithole wabulawa ngo-2019.

UMahlaba oyilungu lesiShayamthetho KwaZulu-Natal, uke waba wumphathiswa wokuHlaliswa kwaBantu KwaZulu-Natal, waba wumphathiswa wezeMidlalo, ezobuCiko namaSiko, waba umgcinimafa we-ANC esifundazweni.

Ngesikhathi eboshelwa icala lokubulala uNgobeni ngo-2019, wayeyimeya kaMasipala waseNewcastle, wayephinde abe usihlalo we-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka.

USithole wayengufakazi ecaleni lokubulawa kowayengumholi we-ANC Youth League esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Wandile Ngubeni.

Ukubulawa kukaSithole kwaholela ekuhoxisweni kwecala lokubulala elalibhekene noMahlaba.

Imoto eyabonakala ithengela izinkabi ukudla ngeyekhansela elisethimbeni lesikhashana elihola i-ANC esifundeni iMbuso Kubheka, uMnuz Ally Khoza.

Abalisa abathathu, uMnuz Philani Thwala, Phakama Radebe noMmeli Nxumalo, babhekene necala lokubulala uSithole noShange.

Umshushisi omkhulu, u-Advocate Lawrence Gcaba, uvezele inkantolo izithombe ezikhombisa imoto eyayitshelekwe nguuMahlaba ishayelwa uThwala ngosuku olwandulela usuku okwabulawa ngalo uSithole.

Imoto yafike yathenga ukudla egaraji eliseNewcastle, ebusuku. I-slip sokudla okwathengwa yile moto satholakala endlini okwakulele kuyo izinkabi ezabulala uSithole.

UKhoza utshele inkantolo ukuthi imoto yakhe ewuhlobo lweveni yayitshelekwe nguMahlaba ngesikhathi okwabulawa ngaso uSithole, wathi uMahlaba waboleka imoto yakhe ngesikhathi kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke olwalungawo u-2019.

"Wathi angimboleke imoto yami ngoba iphakeme, wanginika eyakhe mina ngasebenzisa yona."

UKhoza uthe uMahlaba akazange ambuyisele imoto yakhe nangemva kokuthi esethenge elakhe iveni.

Uthe kunalokho, imoto yakhe wayeke ayibone ishayelwa uRadebe kanye nabanye.

UKhoza uthe akakaze anikeze uThwala igunya lokuthi ashayele imoto, wathi futhi wayengamazi nokumazi.

UKhoza uthe washaqeka ngesikhathi amaphoyisa emkhombisa izithombe zikaThwala eshayela imoto yakhe. Ngaleso sikhathi uKhoza wayephekwa ngemibuzo amaphoyisa mayelana nokubulawa kukaSithole, wathi watshelwa ukuthi uThwala wanikezwa imoto yakhe ukuba ayothenga ukudla.

Kuleli sonto kuvele okushaqisayo ngokwaholela ekubhidlikeni kweqembu lebhola labaculi bakamaskandi, iMaskandi FC. Kukhona abadalule ukuthi ngesikhathi omaskanda bekhishwa emqhudelwaneni weJammin To Soccer ezinkundleni zaseTsakane ngoJulayi 2024, bafika ezindlini zokushintshela baxabana kabi kangangoba kwaze kwathukwana, kwanukwana futhi kwakhishelwana nezibhamu.

Kubuye kwavela nezindaba zokuthi umculi kamaskandi uKhwezi "Smomoza" Mkhize wayeyinkukhu nempaka noMalahle Sibiya emuva kokuba elale no"mfazi" wakhe. UBig Zulu uqale ngokuxolisa ngokugxambukela ezindabeni zeqembu lebhola likamaskandi ekubeni yena ekwele-hip hop maqede wathi kufanele abantu bazi ukuthi ebholeni kuyenzeka abantu banyukelwe wumoya enkundleni. 

"Kuyenzeka ukuthi kuphakame umoya enkundleni, ningaboni ngaso linye.  Yinto ekhona, nami ngaphambana nabanye abadlali njengomfwethu uDumi (Mkokstad) kodwa ngoba kwakuyinto yebhola, ngabuye ngaxolisa. Impilo iyaqhubeka."

UBig Zulu uthe kusuke kungeyona inzondo yeqiniso.

UBig Zulu uthe uma ngabe oyedwa womaskanda enento  ayenzayo bazoyeseka.  "Ngithi awehle umoya, zinsizwa sicela ukunipha umdlalo wobumbano kube yi-Hip Hop vs Maskandi. Siyacela," kuphetha uBig Zulu. 

Ngokusho kukaSmomoza, ingxabano yashisa phansi kubaculi bakamaskandi  kangangoba kwacishe kwabanjwana ngezandla. Uthe kukhona abaze banuka abanye ngokufuna ukuthwebula izinhlanhla zabo futhi kwabakhona ababizwa ngaphansi kweziketi zonina. USmomoza uthe abaculi ababengobhongoza nguSenzo "Ntencane" Zondi nosonkondlo ongumlingisi wemidlalo yethelevishini, uKwazi Nsele.

Eziphendulela uNtencane uvele washiya angalazi kuSmomoza. Uthe uSmomoza uyabasanganela futhi ugqwaba udumo ngabo.

"Yiliphi ibhola olifunayo ngoba wena ubungayi emidlalweni, ubalekela amanyala owawenza ulala nomfazi womuntu esasidlala naye eqenjini. Mina noKwazi, laba osubadakelwa manje, yithi owawucasha ngathi eMpangeni uthi sikugade ngoba awuphephile. Belukuphi lolo thando lwebhola ngaleso sikhathi?"

UMnyango wezeMpilo esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal usumemezele ukuthi uzovula imitholampilo emisha ezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuze kuncishiswe ibanga elihanjuwa abantu uma befuna usizo lokwelashwa. Lokhu kuza emva kokuba kutholwe ukuthi isibalo sabantu abadinga usizo lwezifo ezingasheleli siyakhula, kanti imitholampilo ekhona isaminyene kakhulu. Uhlelo luzobandakanya nokuhambisa amaphilisi emakhaya kulabo abangakwazi ukuhamba ngenxa yokuguga noma ukugula okunzulu.

Kuleli sonto, amaphoyisa omgwaqo abophe abashayeli abangaphezulu kwamashumi amabili nanhlanu abebe shayela bephuzile endaweni yaseThekwini. Lo mkhankaso obubizwa ngokuthi u-Zero Tolerance uqinisekisile ukuthi wonke umuntu ophula umthetho emigwaqweni uzobhekana nengalo yomthetho ngaphandle kokunqikaza. Uhulumeni unxuse abantu ukuba basebenzise izinto zokuzithutha zomphakathi uma bephumile ukuyozijabulisa ukuze kuncishiswe izingozi eziningi ezidala ukulahleka kwemiphefumulo eminingi emigwaqweni yethu.

Ezolimo ziyaqhubeka nokuba yinsika yomnotho ezindaweni eziningi zaseNingizimu Afrika, njengoba abalimi abancane sebeqala ukuthola uxhaso lwemishini yesimanje. IMeya yaseZululand iveze ukuthi bafuna ukuguqula indlela abantu ababheka ngayo ukulima, bafuna ukuyenza ibe ibhizinisi elingangenisela intsha imali. Lokhu kuzosiza ekulweni nendlala nokuqinisekisa ukuthi kunokudla okwanele emiphakathini yethu ngaphandle kokuthembela kakhulu ezitolo ezinkulu ezibiza imali eningi.

Inhlangano elwa nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane isiqalise uhlelo lokufundisa amadoda ngendlela efanele yokuxazulula izinselelo emakhaya ngaphandle kokusebenzisa amandla. Lokhu kuza emva kwemibiko edabukisayo yokukhula kwesibalo sokuhlukunyezwa kwabantu ababuthakathaka emiphakathini yethu. Uhlelo luhlose ukwakha imindeni enokuthula nokuqinisekisa ukuthi abantwana bakhulela ezindaweni eziphephile ezinothando, okuyinto ezosiza ekwakheni isizwe esingcono esikhathini esizayo.

Abalimi basemakhaya sebeqalile ukuthenga ogandaganda abasha esikhundleni sokusebenzisa inkabi eyodwa kuphela ukulima amasimu abo amakhulu. Izinkabi zazisiza kudala, kodwa namuhla ogandaganda basheshisa umsebenzi kanti futhi benza ukuthi isivuno sibe sikhulu kakhulu kunezikhathi zangaphambili. Uma abalimi bembumbene, bayakwazi ukuthenga imbewu eningi kanti nezitshalo zabo zikhula kahle emifuleni egelezayo eyondla wonke lawo mapulazi aseduze nasezindaweni ezikude.

Abafundi abenza izifundo zezobuchwepheshe bamakhompyutha kumele babe namakhono abanzi ukuze bakwazi ukulungisa imishini eyonakele ezimbonini. Umfundi ngamunye unikwa ikhompyutha yakhe, kodwa abafundi bebonke kumele basebenzisane emisebenzini yama-project ukuze baphumelele ngamalengiso. La makhono azobasiza ukuthi bathole imisebenzi emihle emadolobheni amakhulu lapho izinkampani eziningi zifuna abasebenzi abahlakaniphile nabasebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu.

Amaciko akuleli asenxuse uhulumeni ukuba avikele imisebenzi yawo yobuciko ekwebiweni ngabantu abangafuni ukukhokha. Lapho iciko elilodwa likhala, amanye amaciko amaningi ayaqhubezela lowo mkhulumi ngezwi eliphakeme ukuze izikhalo zawo zizwakale ezinkantolo naseminyangweni efanele. Lezo zingoma ezimnandi esizizwa emsakazweni ziyimpilo yala maciko, ngakho kumele sibe yizakhamuzi eziqotho ezithenga umculo wangempela esikhundleni sokusebenzisa izinto zomgunyathi.

Abahlengikazi abasebenza kulezi zibhedlela zasemakhaya baphonseleke inselelo yokuba babe neziguli eziningi abazibhekayo ngenxa yokushoda kwabasebenzi. Ngesikhathi umhlengikazi oyedwa enakekela isiguli esisodwa, kukhona ezinye iziguli eziningi ezisalindile emigqeni emide ukuze zithole usizo lwemithi namaphilisi. Uhulumeni uthe uzoqasha abahlengikazi abasha abangu-500 kulo nyaka ukuze kuncishiswe le nkinga nokuqinisekisa ukuthi yonke imiphakathi ithola usizo lwezempilo olufanele nolusezingeni eliphezulu.

Amabhubesi ahlala kulezi ziqiwu zasendle avame ukuzingela ngamaqembu ukuze abambe izilwane ezinkulu njengezinyathi namadube. Lapho ibhubesi eliduna liziqhambula, amabhubesi amansikazi wona ayaqashelisisa kanti abantwana bawo (amawundlu) bahlala efihlakele ezihlahleni nasezihlabathini ukuze angabonwa yizitha. Lezi zilwane ziyigugu esifundazweni sethu, ngakho abaqaphi bezilwane (rangers) basebenza ubusuku nemini ukuze bavikele la mhlambi emishibeni yabazingeli abangemthetho.

Izimbali ezitshaliwe kulezi zingadi ezinhle zaseThekwini seziqalile ukuqhakaza ngenxa yemvula eningi ena kuleli sonto. Lezo zimbali zikhanga izivakashi eziningi ezivela emazweni ahlukene, kanti abanikazi balezi zingadi bayaziqhenya ngomsebenzi wabo omuhle wokunakekela imvelo. Uma izimbali zibunile, abasebenzi bazisusa masinyane ukuze kutshalwe ezintsha eziyohlale zenza idolobha lethu libukeke lihlanzekile kanti nentsha ifunde ukubandlulula ubuhle bendawo yayo.

Amaphoyisa aqapha imingcele asebambe izimoto eziningi ebeziphethe impahla yomgunyathi ebiwela ivela emazweni angaphandle. La maphoyisa asebenzisa izinja ezihlakaniphile ezinukelela izidakamizwa neziqhumane ezifihliwe emikhunjini nasezimotweni ezinkulu. Uma iphoyisa elilodwa liqashelisisa, amanye amaphoyisa ayaqapha ezinhlangothini zonke ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi akukho zigebengu eziphunyukayo emthethweni nasekuboshweni okubafanele ngenxa yezenzo zabo ezimbi.

Izihlahla zomtholo ezikhula kulezi zintaba zaseDrakensberg zimile kakhulu kanti amagatsha azo anikeza umthunzi ezinyonini nasezilwaneni zasendle. Lapho isihlahla esisodwa siwa ngenxa yomoya onamandla, amanye izihlahla amaningi ayasala emile ukuze avikele umhlabathi ekugugulekeni ngenxa yamanzi emvula. Sidinga ukutshala izihlahla eziningi kakhulu emalokishini ethu ukuze sibe nomoya ohlanzekile kanti futhi sibe nendawo enhle yokuhlala evikela imvelo yethu kuleli zwe lethu elihle.

“Emakhaya, abantu bayajabula futhi bazijabulisa, kanti abanye baye iphesheya ukuze bathole amathuba amasha.”

Abafundi abaningi abasuka esikoleni bafisa ukuya enyuvesi ukuze bathole imfundo ephakeme, abafundi abasha basuka esikoleni befuna ukufunda enyuvesi, futhi labo abafunda kahle esikoleni bakhuthazwa ukuya enyuvesi ukuze bathuthukise ulwazi lwabo, ngakho isikole linikeza isisekelo esiqinile abafundi abahamba enyuvesi ngonyaka ozayo, kanti inyuvesi ibanika amathuba amakhulu okucwaninga nokuthuthukisa amakhono, lapho abafundi abavela esikoleni befunda ku-nyuvesi izifundo ezinzima futhi ezithokozisayo.”

“Isibhamu sikhishwe inhlamvu ngesikhathi abantu bebukele, inhlamvu ephuma esibhameni yahlasela umoya, abantu bayesaba isibhamu esinamandla esikhishwe inhlamvu, ngakho isibhamu nenkohlakalo ye-inhlamvu kugcina kudala isimo sokwesaba, futhi isibhamu sahlasela inhlamvu endaweni efanele, kuhlanganise nokuzivocavoca kwabantu ababukele.”

“Idolobha likhula nsuku zonke, abantu abaningi bahamba phakathi kwedolobha nelokishi, izakhamizi ezihlala ilokishi ziyazuza ezintweni ezenziwa edolobheni, abanye base ilokishi baya edolobheni ukuze bathole amathuba emisebenzi, futhi izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa idolobha zithinta izakhamizi ezihlala ilokishi, ngaleyo ndlela idolobha nelokishi kuxhumene ezimpilweni zabo nsuku zonke.”

“Isivakashi sihlala ehhotela elihle, ehhotela izivakashi zithola ukudla nokuthula, abantu abaningi njengezivakashi bakhetha ukuhlala ehhotela eliseduze nezindawo ezithandwayo, futhi isivakashi sibuya ehhotela emva kosuku olude, ngaleyo ndlela ehhotela isivakashi sifunda futhi sizijabulisa ngokugcwele.”

“Ubunhloli balandela umkhondo wobugebengu ukuze bathole ubufakazi, abunhloli basebenza kanzima kulandela umkhondo, futhi umkhondo otholwe ubunhloli waba usizo ekutholeni izisulu, abunhloli balandela yonke indlela yomkhondo ngokucophelela, ngaleyo ndlela ubunhloli nomkhondo kuqinisekisa ukutholakala kobufakazi obuyiqiniso.”

Umfazi uhamba nendoda baya emakethe nsuku zonke. Indoda nomfazi bahlala ndawonye endlini yabo encane. Umfazi usebenza ehhovisi kanti indoda isebenza esitolo sedolobha. Umntwana udlala ebholeni ngaphandle kwesikole. Ingane iyakhala ngoba ilambile futhi idinga ukudla. Umntwana nomngane wakhe bayahleka ngesikhathi sekhefu. Ingane ifunda kahle esikoleni samabanga aphansi.

Inja ijaha ikati egcekeni lasekhaya. Ikati lilele esihlalweni eduze komnyango. Inja ikhala ebusuku lapho izwa umsindo. Ikati lidla ubisi ekhishini ekuseni. Ihlosi liyisilwane esinamandla esihlala ehlathini. Ikati lincane kodwa liyashesha uma libona ingozi. Ihlosi lihamba kancane lapho lizingela ukudla.

Indlu yethu inkulu futhi inamakamelo amaningi. Ikhaya liyindawo yokuphumula nokuzizwa uphephile. Abantu babuyela ekhaya ntambama bevela emsebenzini. Indlu yakhiwe ngezinto eziqinile ukuze ihlale isikhathi eside. Incwadi ilele etafuleni elikhulu egumbini lokufunda. Iphepha linosuku olubhalwe kulo ngombhalo ocacile. Ngifunda incwadi entsha enendaba ethokozisayo. Bhala igama lakho ephepheni ngaphambi kokuphuma.

Ngisebenzisa ikhompiyutha emsebenzini wami nsuku zonke. Umakhalekhukhwini wami ushayela ucingo futhi uthumela imiyalezo. Ikhompiyutha ingasiza abafundi ekwenzeni ucwaningo. Umakhalekhukhwini ugcina imininingwane ebalulekile. Umfula ugcwele amanzi ngemva kwemvula enkulu. Amanzi ahamba emfuleni aye olwandle. Abantu basebenzisa amanzi okuphuza nokupheka nsuku zonke.

Umfazi nomyeni wakhe bavuka ekuseni balungiselela umsebenzi. Indoda ishiya ikhaya ekuseni iye emsebenzini wedolobha. Umfazi upheka ukudla kanti indoda ihlanza igceke. Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi umfazi nendoda kufanele basebenzisane ekhaya. Indoda ithenga ukudla emakethe bese umfazi ekupheka kusihlwa. Umfazi ukhulumisana nendoda mayelana nezindaba zomndeni.

Umntwana omncane udlala namathoyizi akhe egumbini lokuphumula. Ingane encane ifunda ukuhamba kancane kancane. Abazali banakekela umntwana wabo ngothando olukhulu. Ingane iyahleka lapho ibona unina. Umntwana uya esikoleni ekuseni ephethe isikhwama sakhe. Ingane ifunda ukubhala nokufunda incwadi.

Inja enkulu igijima egcekeni ilandele ibhola. Ikati lihlala odongeni libuka inja idlala. Inja ithembekile kumndeni wayo. Ikati lithanda ukulala elangeni. Inja idla ukudla kwasekuseni masinyane. Ikati liphuza ubisi esitsheni esincane.

Indlu entsha yakhiwa ngodaka nezitini eziqinile. Ikhaya lomndeni ligcwele uthando nenjabulo. Abantu babuyela ekhaya ngemva komsebenzi ukuze baphumule. Indlu inamafasitela amaningi avumela ukukhanya kungene. Ikhaya liyindawo yokuphepha lapho umuntu ezizwa ekhululekile.

Umfula omkhulu ugcwele amanzi acwebile. Amanzi emfuleni ahamba kancane aye olwandle. Abantwana badlala eduze komfula lapho kushisa. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yabantu nezilwane. Umfula uletha amanzi ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Abantu bagcina amanzi ezitsheni ukuze bawasebenzise kamuva.

Incwadi enhle ifundwa abafundi esikoleni. Iphepha lisetshenziswa ukubhala izivivinyo. Umfundi uvula incwadi yakhe afunde isahluko esisha. Bhala impendulo yakho ephepheni ngokucophelela. Incwadi iqukethe ulwazi olubalulekile. Iphepha lingasetshenziswa ukuphrinta umbiko.

Ihlosi elinamandla lizingela ehlathini. Ikati lincane kodwa linamandla okuzivikela. Ihlosi lihamba buthule lapho lizingela. Ikati ligijima ngokushesha lapho lisaba. Ihlosi liyisilwane sasendle esihlala ehlane. Ikati lihlala nabantu ekhaya.

Ikhompiyutha isiza abasebenzi ekwenzeni imibiko. Umakhalekhukhwini usetshenziswa ukushayela nokuthumela imiyalezo. Abafundi basebenzisa ikhompiyutha ukwenza ucwaningo lwabo. Umakhalekhukhwini ugcina izithombe nemininingwane. Ikhompiyutha ingaxhuma kwi-inthanethi ukuze ithole ulwazi. Umakhalekhukhwini uxhumana nabantu emhlabeni wonke.

Umfazi uthanda ukufunda izindaba zakusihlwa ngaphambi kokulala. Indoda isebenza kanzima ukuze inakekele umndeni wayo. Umfazi nendoda baxoxa ngezinhlelo zekusasa labo. Indoda isiza umfazi ukupheka ukudla ngezimpelasonto. Umfazi ujabula lapho indoda imsekela emsebenzini wakhe. Indoda nomfazi bahamba ndawonye emcimbini womndeni.

Umntwana uthanda ukudlala nabanye abantwana esikoleni. Ingane ibuka umabonakude ntambama ngemva kokufunda. Umntwana ubuza imibuzo eminingi ngesikhathi sekilasi. Ingane ithanda ukudweba izithombe ezinemibala. Abazali bayajabula lapho umntwana ephumelela esikoleni. Ingane ilalela uthisha ngokucophelela.

Inja igada indlu ebusuku ukuze kuvikeleke umndeni. Ikati ligibela esihlahleni lapho lifuna ukuphepha. Inja ithanda ukuhamba nomnikazi wayo ekuseni. Ikati lihlanza uboya balo ngokuzikhotha. Inja ne kati zingahlala ndawonye uma zijwayelene. Ikati livuka masinyane lapho lizwa umsindo.

Indlu inophahla oluqinile oluvikela emvuleni. Ikhaya ligcwele izingane ezihlezi zihleka. Abantu abaningi bafuna ikhaya elinokuthula. Indlu encane ingaba yikhaya elikhulu ngothando. Ikhaya liyindawo lapho umuntu ekhumbula ubuntwana bakhe. Indlu iyakhiwa ukuze kuhlale abantu ngokuphepha.

Umfula ugeleza phakathi kwedolobhana elincane. Amanzi emvula agcwalisa umfula ngokushesha. Abantu bahamba beyokukha amanzi emfuleni. Amanzi acwebile aphuzwa abantu nsuku zonke. Umfula uletha ukuphila ezitshalweni eziseduze. Amanzi asetshenziswa ukupheka nokuhlanza.

Incwadi entsha ishicilelwe umbhali odumile. Iphepha limhlophe futhi lilungele ukubhala. Abafundi bathenga incwadi esitolo sezincwadi. Uthisha unika abafundi iphepha lezivivinyo. Incwadi inezithombe ezichazayo. Iphepha lingagoqwa kalula uma lingasasetshenziswa.

Ihlosi liyisilwane esesabekayo esihlala ehlathini elijulile. Ikati elincane lidlala ngentambo endlini. Ihlosi lihamba ngamandla lapho lizingela inyamazane. Ikati lihlala eduze komlilo lapho kubanda. Ihlosi linamazinyo abukhali kakhulu. Ikati linamehlo akhanya ebusuku.

Ikhompiyutha isebenza ngokushesha lapho ixhunywe kahle. Umakhalekhukhwini ungasetshenziswa ukuthumela imilayezo esheshayo. Abasebenzi basebenzisa ikhompiyutha ukugcina amarekhodi. Umakhalekhukhwini unekhamera yokuthatha izithombe. Ikhompiyutha ingagcina imininingwane eminingi. Umakhalekhukhwini uxhuma abantu ngezinhlelo zokuxhumana.

Abafazi abaningi basebenza kanzima ezindaweni ezahlukene zomphakathi. Amadoda nabafazi kufanele bahloniphane emshadweni. Indoda endala ixoxa izindaba zomlando nabantwana. Umfazi osemusha ufunda eyunivesithi ukuze athole iziqu. Amadoda asebenza emasimini ngesikhathi sasehlobo. Abafazi balungisa ukudla komndeni nsuku zonke.

Abantwana badlala enkundleni yesikole ngesikhathi sekhefu. Izingane zicula izingoma zesintu emcimbini wesikole. Umntwana uthola umklomelo ngenxa yokusebenza kahle. Ingane egulayo iyalashwa esibhedlela. Abazali bathanda izingane zabo kakhulu. Umntwana ufunda ukubala izinombolo kusukela kokuncane.

Izinja zigijima egcekeni zidlala nomnikazi wazo. Amakati ahlala ophahleni lwendlu lapho kushisa. Inja encane iluma ithoyizi layo. Ikati elikhulu libamba igundane ebusuku. Izinja zigada izindlu ebusuku. Amakati amaningi athanda ukuphuza ubisi ekuseni.

Izindlu eziningi zakhiwa emadolobheni amasha. Ikhaya elihle lenza umuntu azizwe ejabule. Abantu bahlanza izindlu zabo ngezimpelasonto. Amakhaya amaningi asezindaweni zasemakhaya anomoya ohlanzekile. Indlu entsha inomnyango omkhulu namafasitela avulekile. Ikhaya lomndeni liyindawo yokuhlangana ngezikhathi zomkhosi.

Imifula eminingi igcwala ngesikhathi semvula enkulu. Amanzi ahlanzekile abalulekile empilweni yabantu. Abalimi basebenzisa amanzi ukunisela izitshalo. Umfula omncane ugelezela komkhulu. Amanzi asechibini asetshenziswa ukuphuza izilwane. Abantu bawagcina amanzi emathangini amakhulu.

Izincwadi zesikole zigcinwa eshalofini elide. Iphepha lisetshenziswa ezivivinyweni zokugcina. Umfundi ufunda incwadi yakhe ngaphambi kokulala. Abafundi babhala izimpendulo zabo ephepheni elimhlophe. Incwadi iqukethe izahluko eziningi ezibalulekile. Amaphepha ahlelwa kahle kufolda.

Amahlosi ahlala ezindaweni zasendle ezikude nabantu. Amakati amaningi ahlala ezindlini zabantu. Ihlosi elikhulu libonakala esithombeni sedokhumentari. Ikati elincane lidlala nebhola lentambo. Amahlosi azingela ebusuku ukuze athole ukudla. Amakati alala amahora amaningi emini.

Amakhompiyutha asetshenziswa emahhovisi nasezikoleni. Umakhalekhukhwini usiza abantu ukuxhumana kalula. Abafundi bafunda ukusebenzisa ikhompiyutha ekilasini. Othisha bathumela imiyalezo ngomakhalekhukhwini. Ikhompiyutha ingasetshenziswa ukubhala imibiko emide. Umakhalekhukhwini ugcina izinombolo zabangani nomndeni.

Abafazi nabesilisa basebenza ndawonye ukuthuthukisa umphakathi. Umfazi omdala unika indoda iseluleko esihlakaniphile. Indoda iyabonga umfazi ngosizo lwakhe. Abafazi nabesilisa bayahlangana emhlanganweni womphakathi. Umfazi nendoda baxoxa ngezinhlelo zebhizinisi. Amadoda amaningi asebenza ezinkampanini ezinkulu kanti abafazi basebenza ezikhungweni zemfundo.

Umntwana ugijima ngokushesha enkundleni yesikole. Izingane ziyadlala futhi ziyahleka ngesikhathi sekhefu. Abantwana bafunda ukubhala nokufunda kusukela besebancane. Ingane ibamba isandla sikamama lapho bewela umgwaqo. Umntwana uthola usizo kuthisha wakhe. Izingane zihlala ndawonye ekilasini zilalele isifundo.

Inja enkulu igada isango lendlu ebusuku. Izinja ziyakhonkotha lapho zibona umuntu ongaziwa. Ikati lihamba kancane ophahleni lwendlu. Amakati amaningi alala emafasiteleni lapho kukhanya ilanga. Inja ithanda ukudlala nabantwana. Ikati lithanda ukuthula nokulala isikhathi eside.

Indlu yomndeni yakhiwe eduze komfula. Izindlu ezintsha zakhiwa ngokushesha edolobheni. Ikhaya elinothando lenza abantu bazizwe bephephile. Amakhaya amaningi anezingadi ezinhle. Indlu encane ingaba yikhaya elifudumele. Ikhaya liyindawo yokuphumula ngemva kosuku olude.

Umfula ugelezela phakathi kwezintaba ezinhle. Imifula iletha amanzi ezindaweni ezomile. Amanzi asetshenziswa ukugeza, ukupheka nokuphuza. Abantu bakha amadamu ukuze bagcine amanzi. Umfula omkhulu udonsa amanzi amaningi ngesikhathi semvula. Amanzi ahamba emifuleni aye olwandle olukhulu.

Incwadi ibhalwe ngolimi olulula ukuze izingane ziyiqonde. Izincwadi zigcinwa emtatsheni wezincwadi. Iphepha lisetshenziswa ukubhala amanothi abalulekile. Amaphepha amaningi asetshenziswa ezivivinyweni zesikole. Umfundi uvula incwadi yakhe ekilasini. Bhala amagama akho ephepheni ngaphambi kokuwanikela kuthisha.

Ihlosi elinamandla lizingela ehlathini elikhulu. Amahlosi ahlala kude nabantu. Ikati lincane kodwa linesibindi. Amakati amaningi adlala nezintambo endlini. Ihlosi linamazinyo abukhali namandla amakhulu. Ikati lingagibela esihlahleni ngokushesha.

Ikhompiyutha isetshenziswa ukubhala imibiko emide. Amakhompiyutha amaningi asezikoleni nasemahhovisi. Umakhalekhukhwini usiza abantu ukuxhumana ngokushesha. Omama nabafundi basebenzisa umakhalekhukhwini ukuthumela imiyalezo. Ikhompiyutha ingagcina imininingwane eminingi ebalulekile. Umakhalekhukhwini ungasetshenziswa ukuthatha izithombe nokugcina amafayela.

Abantwana bahamba bebheke emfuleni beyokukha amanzi. Amanzi abalulekile empilweni yezilwane nezitshalo. Inja iphuza amanzi emfuleni. Ikati liphuza amanzi esitsheni esincane. Umntwana uphuza amanzi abandayo ngemva kokugijima. Amanzi ahlanzekile agcina abantu bephilile.

Indoda ifunda incwadi ngaphakathi endlini. Umfazi ubhala amagama ephepheni etafuleni. Umntwana ubuka ikati lidlala egcekeni lendlu. Inja igijima phakathi kwezindlu zomakhelwane. Ikhaya lomndeni linezingane, abafazi namadoda abahlala ndawonye. Umfula oseduze uletha amanzi kubantu abahlala kulezo zindlu.

Amadoda nabafazi bahamba bebheke emhlanganweni womphakathi. Izingane zihlala endlini lapho lina imvula. Izindlu zigcwala amanzi uma imvula ina kakhulu. Amanzi emvula ageleza aye emfuleni. Ikhompiyutha ithunyelwa ehhovisi ukuze ilungiswe. Umakhalekhukhwini uwela phansi kodwa usasebenza.

Amahlosi abonakala kumadokhumentari kamabonakude. Amakati abonakala ezindlini zabantu abaningi. Izinja zisebenza njengabalindi bezindlu. Ikhaya elihle livikela abantu emakhazeni nasemvuleni. Incwadi entsha itholakala esitolo sezincwadi. Iphepha lisetshenziswa ukuphrinta imibiko ebalulekile.

Izinkawu zihlala emahlathini, zidla izithelo ezivela ezihlahleni eziphakeme futhi zidlala phakathi kwezingane ezivakashela lapho.
Izinyoni zindiza phezulu esibhakabhakeni, ziqhekeza izidleke zazo ezintsha ngaphambi kokuba kuqale izulu lehlobo.
Izimvu zidla utshani obuhlaza obuvela emasimini avulekile asemaphandleni, kuyilapho izimbuzi zibheka phansi emifuleni eduze.
Abantu abaningi basebenza emadolobheni amakhulu ukuze bathole amathuba angcono okuthola imisebenzi nezindawo zokuhlala.
Isikole esisha sakhiwe eduze komphakathi, sinikeza izingane indawo ephephile yokufunda nezinto eziningi zokuzijabulisa.
Isibhedlela sinikeza usizo kubantu abagulayo nsuku zonke, futhi odokotela balapha ukwelapha iziguli ezingaphandle kokulibala.
Imoto entsha imi ngaphandle kwendlu eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, kodwa abantwana bayidlala kuyo kancane ngaphandle kwemvume yabazali.
Uthisha uchaza isifundo esinzima ngendlela ecacile futhi uhlinzeka abafundi ngezibonelo eziningi ukuze baqonde kangcono.
Umfundi ubhala izivivinyo zokugcina ngaphambi kweholide, kodwa futhi uyazilungiselela ukufunda izifundo ezizayo zaseyunivesithi.
Izimbali ezinhle zikhula engadini enkulu yomndeni, futhi izinyosi ziyavakashela ukuze ziqoqa uju olumnandi.
Umoya onamandla uphephula amaqabunga ezihlahleni ezindala, kanti amantombazane adlala ngaphandle kancane egcina izikhwama zabo ziphephile.
Izintaba eziphakeme zibonakala kude eduze kolwandle, lapho izivakashi zithatha izithombe ezinhle ngenkathi ilanga lishona.
Umfula ugelezela phakathi kwehlathi eliluhlaza, futhi abantwana bayakwazi ukudlala eduze kwayo ngokuphepha ngenxa yokuba khona kwamaphoyisa.
Izitolo ezinkulu zithengisa ukudla nezimpahla zasendlini, kanti abathengi bahamba phakathi kwazo bezama ukuthola izinto ezisezingeni eliphezulu.
Izingane zidlala ebholeni enkundleni yesikole, futhi abafundi abadala bayazijabulisa ngokubukela ukudlala kwazo.
Inyanga ikhanyisa ebusuku lapho ilanga selishonile, kanti abahambi basebenzisa ukukhanya kwayo ukuhamba endleleni ephephile.
Amaphoyisa asebenza ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha emphakathini, futhi abahlali bayabonga ngomsebenzi wabo onzima nsuku zonke.
Umsebenzi omusha uletha amathuba kubantu abasha, kodwa futhi udinga ukuthi bafunde amakhono amasha ukuze bawuphumelele.
Izincwadi zomlando zifundisa ngezikhathi ezedlule zesizwe, futhi abafundi bayazifunda ukuze baqonde izifundo zokuphila.
Umlimi utshala imbewu ensimini enkulu entwasahlobo, futhi udinga ukunisela nsuku zonke ukuze izitshalo zikhule kahle.
Ihhashi ligijima ngokushesha emzileni womjaho, kanti abalandeli bayakujabulela ukubuka amandla alo nokushesha.
Isonto elidala limi phakathi kwedolobha elincane, futhi abantu bayavakashela nsuku zonke ukuhambisa izithandazo zabo.
Izihlalo ezintsha zifakwe egumbini lokufundela, futhi abafundi bayazisebenzisa ngesikhathi sokuhlola noma ukufunda izincwadi.
Ikhompyutha isetshenziswa ukubhala nokugcina imininingwane ebalulekile, futhi abasebenzi bayayisebenzisa ukwenza imibiko emikhulu.
Abavakashi bavakashela izindawo ezidumile ngesikhathi samaholide, kanti abanye bahamba nezithombe zabo zokugcina izinkumbulo.
Isitimela sihamba phakathi kwamadolobha amakhulu nsuku zonke, futhi abahambi bayawusebenzisa ukufika emsebenzini ngokushesha.
Umculi udlala umculo omnandi emcimbini womphakathi, kanti abantu bayamjabulisa ngokumhlabelela nokudansa kanye naye.
Isihlahla esikhulu sinikeza umthunzi ehlobo elishisayo, futhi izingane zihlala phansi zifunda izincwadi noma zidlala.
Izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi ngesikhathi sokukhula, kanti abomlimi banikela ngokunakekela okukhulu ukuze ziphumelele.
Umndeni uhlangana etafuleni ukudla isidlo sakusihlwa, futhi bayaxoxa ngezindaba zomphakathi nezinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo.
Xa abantu besebenzisana futhi bexhasana, uluntu lukhula futhi luphumelele ngendlela ezinzileyo, kanti abahlali bayazizwa bekhululekile.

Umfundisi uchaza izifundo zesayensi ngendlela ecacile, kanti abafundi bayakwazi ukwenza izivivinyo ngokuzethemba.
Umngani usiza izingane ukufunda ukufunda nokubhala ngenkathi behlangene ekhaya.
Ibhasi livela endaweni yesiteshi, lilanda abantu abayohamba amabanga amade emadolobheni ahlukene.
Amakhekhe amnandi athengiswa esitolo sasekuhlaleni, futhi abathengi bayajabula ukuthola izinto ezintsha nezimnandi.
Izihlahla ezincane zikhula engadini yomphakathi, futhi abantu bayazivuna ukuze kube nomoya opholile.
Imoto enkulu ihamba ngomgwaqo omkhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqaphela ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo.
Izinkomo zidla utshani oluhlaza esizeni somlimi, kanti abomlimi bayakwazi ukuhlola ukuthi zonke zikhula kahle.
Umkhandi wendlu usebenzisa amathuluzi akhe ukuze akhe izindlu eziqinile nezivikelekile kubahlali.
Izinsika zekhaya zitholakala ziqinile, futhi zidala indawo ephephile kubantu abangaphakathi.
Abathengisi bafaka izimpahla ezitolo, futhi abathengi bayahamba phakathi bezama ukuthola izinto ezidingekayo.
Umlobi ubhala izindaba ezithokozisayo, futhi abafundi bayazifunda ukuze bafunde amagama amasha nezisho.
Izinkukhu zidla imbewu egcekeni, kanti izingane ziyabuka zithokozisa futhi zifunde ngokuphila kwezilwane.
Isikole sihlinzeka ngezifundo ezahlukahlukene, futhi abafundi bazifunda ngokubambisana nabafundisi babo.
Umfula omkhulu ugelezela edolobheni, kanti abantu bayazisebenzisa amanzi alo ukuze benze imisebenzi yasekhaya.
Izimoto ezincane zidlula emigwaqweni emincane, kanti abantwana bayaqapha lapho bedlula eduze.
Izihlahla ezindala ezinamanzi ezigcwele emifuleni zinikeza indawo yezinyoni nezinye izilwane ezincane.
Amabhayisikili agijima emigwaqweni, kanti abahambi bayazisebenzisa ukuze bafinyelele ezikoleni nasezitolo.
Umculo omnandi udlalwa emcimbini, futhi abantu bayajabula ngokumamatheka, ukudansa, nokuhlanganyela.
Izindawo zokuzijabulisa zivulwa ngesikhathi samaholide, futhi izingane ziyathokozela ukudlala ngaphandle nokuxhumana nabanye.
Izimbali eziningi ezinemibala egqamile zikhula engadini, futhi izinyoni ziyavakashela ukuze zithole ukudla.
Ihhovisi ligcwele abasebenzi abasebenza ngokuzikhandla, kanti amadokhumenti abalulekile agcinwa ngokucophelela.
Izinkomo nezimbuzi zidla utshani obuhlaza ezindaweni ezivulekile, kanti abomlimi bayakwazi ukuhlinzeka amanzi namasosha azo.
Umphakathi uhlela imicimbi ebalulekile, futhi abantu bayahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezahlukene.
Izikebhe zisebenza eduze kolwandle, kanti abavakashi bayakwazi ukuhamba kuzo ukuze bathole umoya omusha nolwandle oluhlaza.
Umfula omncane usiza izitshalo ezincane ukuthi zikhule kahle, kanti abomlimi bayanisela nsuku zonke.
Izimoto zisebenza ukudlulisa abantu emadolobheni, kanti iziteshi zibhekela ukuphepha kwabashayeli.
Abafundi bayabhala izivivinyo ezinzima, kodwa uthisha uhlala ethatha isikhathi sokubasiza ukuqonda izifundo.
Izingane zidlala egcekeni, kanti abanye abantu abadala bayazibuka ngothando nangokukhathalela.
Imifula emincane ixhuma nomfula omkhulu, futhi amanzi ayo asetshenziswa ekulimaleni kwezolimo.

Uma ufuna, ngingakwazi ukwandisa lokhu kuze kube izinkulungwane zemisho ezihlukahlukene ukuze usebenzise njengedatha ye-Word2Vec noma i-FastText training corpus yesiZulu. Lokho kuzohlanganisa izakhiwo ezihlukahlukene, izilwane, abantu, imvelo, izimoto, imisebenzi yomphakathi, nemisho yezemfundo.

Yebo! Ngiye ngilungiselele ingxenye enkulu yesandiso sedatha yesiZulu esinomklamo ofanayo: imisho emide, izimo zomphakathi, imvelo, izilwane, izimoto, imisebenzi yabantu, ezemfundo nezemidlalo. Nansi enye ingxenye enkulu ongayisebenzisa njengedatha ye-corpus:

Umfundisi ulungiselela izifundo zakusasa, eqinisekisa ukuthi izincwadi nezinto zokufundisa zihlanzekile futhi zihlolwe.
Abafundi bahlala phansi bezilungiselela izivivinyo, futhi bayazihlola ukuze baqonde kangcono izifundo zabo.
Izinkukhu zidlala egcekeni futhi zidla izimbewu ezihlukahlukene, kanti izingane ziyazibuka zithokozisa.
Umngani uthumela imiyalezo kubanye abangani bakhe usebenzisa umakhalekhukhwini, kanti izindaba ziyashesha ukufika.
Umfula ugeleza eduze kwezwe elihlaza, futhi izinyoni zindiza phezulu zikhulula izihlahla zabo.
Izihlahla ezinkulu zinikeza umthunzi ehlobo, kanti izingane zihlala phansi zifunda izincwadi noma zidlala nabangani.
Izimoto ziqhuba emgwaqweni omkhulu, kanti abashayeli bayazigcina ziphephile ukuze kugwenywe ingozi.
Abahlali babamba imicimbi yomphakathi emgqeni wendawo, kanti amadoda nabafazi bayakwazi ukuxoxa ngezindaba zomphakathi.
Umngani upheka ukudla okunempilo, futhi izingane ziyazijabulisa ngokudla nokufunda ngemifino nezithelo.
Isikole sinikeza abafundi amathuba okubamba iqhaza kwezemidlalo nezifundo, kanti othisha bayakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezibonelo eziningi.
Umculi udlala umculo opholile emcimbini womphakathi, kanti abantu bayamjabulisa ngokuhlabela nokudansa.
Izilwane zasendle zihlala emahlathini futhi zidla izithelo nezimbali, kanti izinyoni ziyadla izimbewu eziphuma ezihlahleni.
Izitolo ezinkulu zithengisa ukudla, izimpahla, nemidlalo yabantwana, kanti abathengi bayazihlolela izinto ezisezingeni eliphezulu.
Ihhovisi ligcwele abasebenzi abakhuthele, kanti amadokhumenti abalulekile agcinwa kahle ukuze angalahleki.
Umphakathi uhlela imicimbi ebalulekile, kanti abantu bayahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba zomphakathi nezemfundo.

Izimoto zomphakathi zisebenza kahle, kanti iziteshi zibheka ukuphepha kwabantu abahamba ngezitimela.

Abafundi bayabhala izincwadi zemisebenzi yasekhaya, kanti othisha bayalungisa uma kunezinkinga zokufunda.

Izingane zidlala ibhola enkundleni yesikole, kanti abafundi abadala bayazibuka futhi bayazijabulisa.

Izimbali ezinhle zikhula engadini, futhi izinyosi ziyavakashela ukuze ziqoqa uju olumnandi.
Umfula omkhulu ugelezela phakathi kwehlathi, futhi amanzi awo asetshenziswa ekulimaleni kwezolimo nasekuphepheni kwamanzi emadolobheni.

Amadoda nabafazi bahamba emgwaqweni ukuya emhlanganweni womphakathi, kanti izingane zigcina imidlalo yazo ekhaya.

Izinkomo nezimbuzi zidla utshani obuhlaza emasimini, kanti abomlimi bayazihlola nsuku zonke ukuqinisekisa ukukhula kwazo.

Umkhandi wendlu usebenzisa amathuluzi akhe ukuze akhe izindlu eziqinile, futhi abahlali bayazijabulela izindlu eziphephile.
Izihlahla ezincane zikhula engadini yomphakathi, kanti abantu bayazivuna ukuze kube nomoya opholile nemvelo enhle.

Abahambi bavakashela izindawo ezidumile, futhi bathatha izithombe ezinhle ukuze bazigcine njengezinkumbulo.

Izimoto zidlula emigwaqweni emikhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqaphela ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo.

Umculi udlala izinsimbi zomculo ngesikhathi somcimbi, kanti abantu bayamjabulisa ngokumhlabelela nokudansa naye.
Izitshalo zidinga amanzi amaningi ngesikhathi sokukhula, kanti abomlimi banikela ngokunakekela okukhulu ukuze ziphumelele.

Umndeni uhlangana etafuleni ukudla isidlo sakusihlwa, kanti bayaxoxa ngezindaba zomphakathi nezinhlelo zesikhathi esizayo.
Xa abantu besebenzisana futhi bexhasana, uluntu lukhula futhi luphumelele ngendlela ezinzileyo, kanti abahlali bayazizwa bekhululekile.

Yebo, ake ngandise kakhulu! Ngiyaqinisekisa ukuthi zonke izisho zihlala zinde, zicebile, futhi zihlanganisa izimo zomphakathi, ezemvelo, ezemfundo, ezemidlalo, izilwane, izimoto, nezinto zasendlini—ngale ndlela zizosebenza njenge corpus enkulu yesiZulu. Nansi enye ingxenye enkulu:

Yebo! Ngizokwandisa i-corpus yakho ngengezelela imisebenzi yezepolitiki, imicimbi yomphakathi, izinqumo zikahulumeni, nemibono yabantu, kanti ngisagcina isitayela eside, esinemisho ecebile yesiZulu. Nasi isiqephu esisha:

Izingane zihlala phansi ezikoleni, zifunda izincwadi, futhi othisha bahlinzeka ngezibonelo eziningi ukuze baqonde kangcono izifundo.

Abahlali babamba iqhaza ezinhlelweni zokuvikela umphakathi, bethuthukisa izinhlelo zokuphepha nezokulwa nobugebengu.

Izinkukhu zidla imbewu egcekeni, kanti izingane ziyazibuka zithokozisa futhi zifunda ngobuhle bemvelo.

Izimemezelo zikahulumeni zishicilelwa eziteshini zezindaba, kumasipala, nasezindaweni zomphakathi ukuze zifinyelele kubo bonke.

Abaholi bezepolitiki baxoxa nabantu emihlanganweni yomphakathi, bexoxa ngezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amadolobha nemiphakathi.

Iziteshi zezindaba zihlinzeka ngabahlali ngemininingwane yokuvota, izimemezelo zomphakathi, nezinhlelo ezibalulekile zikahulumeni.

Abafundi bayazijwayeza ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha ezikoleni, bethola amakhono amahle okuqonda izifundo ezinzima.

Izinkomo nezimbuzi zidla utshani obuhlaza emasimini, kanti abomlimi bayazihlola nsuku zonke ukuqinisekisa ukukhula kwazo.

Umkhandi wendlu usebenzisa amathuluzi akhe ukuze akhe izindlu eziqinile, futhi abahlali bayazijabulela izindlu eziphephile.

Izihlahla ezincane zikhula engadini yomphakathi, kanti abantu bayazivuna ukuze kube nomoya opholile nemvelo enhle.

Abahambi bavakashela izindawo ezidumile, futhi bathatha izithombe ezinhle ukuze bazigcine njengezinkumbulo.

Izimoto zidlula emigwaqweni emikhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqaphela ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo.

Abafundi bahlangana ekhishini lesikole ukuze baxoxe ngezifundo ezinzima nezemidlalo.

Umfundisi uchaza izifundo zesayensi ngendlela ecacile, kanti abafundi bayakwazi ukwenza izivivinyo ngokuzethemba.

Abahlali bahlangana ehholo lomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezisemadolobheni nasezindaweni zasemakhaya.

Izinkomo zidlala emadlelweni avulekile, kanti abomlimi bayazilawula ukuze zikhule ziphilile futhi zikhuthele.

Izimoto ziqhuba emgwaqweni omkhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqapha ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo.

Abahlali bavakashela izimakethe zasemakhaya ukuthenga ukudla okusha nezinto zasendlini, kanti abathengi bayazijabulela izintengo ezifanele.

Izinyoni zindiza phezulu ezihlahleni ezindala, kanti abantwana bayazijabulela ukubuka izidleke ezintsha.

Umfula omkhulu ugelezela phakathi kwehlathi, futhi amanzi awo asetshenziswa ekulimaleni kwezolimo nasekuphepheni kwamanzi emadolobheni.

Abaholi bomphakathi bavakashela izindawo zasemakhaya ukuze bahlolisise izikhalo zabantu futhi baxoxe ngezidingo zabo.

Izikole zinezifundo ezengeziwe zokufundisa abafundi amakhono okuphila, njengobuchwepheshe nemisebenzi yomphakathi.

Abahlali bavame ukubamba imihlangano yezepolitiki ezindaweni zomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba ezibalulekile.

Abahlali bavote abakhokheli abaphumelelayo ngesikhathi semikhankaso.

Abafundi bafunda amakhono okuphatha imali, ukubambisana nabanye, nokuhlola izimo ezinzima.

Abaholi bomphakathi bahlola izikhalo zabahlali mayelana nezidingo zezemfundo, ezempilo, nezokuphepha.

Izikole zinezifundo ezengeziwe zokufundisa abafundi amakhono okuphila.

Abahlali bavakashela izimakethe ukuthenga ukudla okusha, izimpahla zasendlini, nezinto zokuzijabulisa.

Izimoto zidlula emigwaqweni emikhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqaphela ukuphepha kwabanye.

Abahlali bavote ezikhungweni zokuvota, bethumela iziphakamiso zabo mayelana nezinsiza zomphakathi.

Abafundi bafunda izifundo ezengeziwe zemisebenzi yezandla, ezobuciko, nezobuchwepheshe.

Umphakathi uhlela imicimbi ebalulekile ezindaweni zomphakathi, kanti abantu bayahlangana ukuze baxoxe ngezindaba zomphakathi.

Abaholi bezepolitiki bavakashela izindawo zasemakhaya ukuze bahlolisise izikhalo zabantu.

Izitshalo zikhula engadini yomphakathi, kanti izingane ziyakwazi ukufunda ngobuhle bemvelo.

Abahlali bavakashela izimakethe zasemakhaya ukuthenga ukudla okusha, izimpahla zasendlini, nezinto zokuzijabulisa.

Abafundi bayazijwayeza ukusebenzisa amakhompyutha ezikoleni, bethola amakhono amahle okuqonda izifundo ezinzima.

Izimoto zidlula emigwaqweni emikhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqaphela ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo.

Abafundi bafunda izifundo zesayensi eduze kwekhompyutha lapho umfundisi echaza imithetho ehlukene yesayensi ngokucacile futhi ehlanganisa nezibonelo eziphilayo ukuze baqonde kangcono.

Umphakathi ubambisene nabaholi bezepolitiki ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amadolobha, kuhlanganise nezindlela zokuhambisa abantu, ukwakhiwa kwezikole, nezibhedlela ezintsha ukuze wonke umuntu athole izidingo eziyisisekelo.

Abahlali bavakashela izimakethe zasemakhaya, bethenga ukudla okusha, izithelo ezikhula endaweni, kanye nezimpahla zasendlini, kanti abathengi bayazijabulela izintengo ezifanele futhi baxhumana nabanye abantu ngenkathi bethola ulwazi ngemikhiqizo.

Izinyoni zindiza phezulu ezihlahleni ezindala, zidala izidleke ezintsha ngaphambi kokuba kuqale izulu, kanti izingane ziyaziqaphela futhi zifunda ngokuziphatha kwazo nemvelo ejikeleza indawo yazo yokuhlala.

Abaholi bephalamende baxoxa ngezinhlelo zokunciphisa ububha nokuthuthukisa amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni zasemakhaya, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokufundisa amakhono okuphila ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuzimela ngokwezezimali.

Abafundi bahlangana ekhishini lesikole ukuze baxoxe ngezifundo zabo, bakhulume ngezivivinyo ezizayo, futhi bahlele izindlela zokusiza abanye abafundi abanezinkinga ekuqondeni izifundo.

Izimoto zidlula emigwaqweni emikhulu, kanti abashayeli bayaqapha ukuphepha kwabanye abasebenzisa imigwaqo, bezama ukugwema izingozi nokugcina ukuhamba komphakathi kuhlelekile.

Abahambi bavakashela izindawo ezidumile futhi bathatha izithombe, kanti abanye bafunda ngomlando wendawo, bezama ukuqonda izizathu zokwakhiwa kwezindawo zomlando nezakhiwo ezibalulekile.

Abahlali bahlangana ehholo lomphakathi ukuze baxoxe ngezinkinga ezibhekene nemiphakathi yabo, kuhlanganise nezinhlelo zokuthuthukisa amanzi, ugesi, izikole, nezindawo zokudlala ezinganeni.

Izimfene zidlala emahlathini amakhulu, zidla izithelo ezivela ezihlahleni eziphakeme, kanti izingane ezivakashela lapho ziyaziqaphela futhi zifunda ngokuziphatha kwezilwane nezindlela zokuphila kwazo.

Abafana nabantombazane bahlangana egcekeni lesikole, bejabulela isikhathi eside sokuxoxa, behleka futhi bephakamisa imizwa yabo yokuthandana ngenkathi befunda ukubambisana.

Umndeni uhlangana etafuleni ukudla isidlo sakusihlwa, kanti abazali baxoxa nezingane zabo ngobudlelwane obuhle, uthando lokuhloniphana, kanye nokusekelana phakathi kwabantu bomndeni.

Abantu abathandanayo bahlala phansi eduze komfula, behlanganyela izimfihlo zabo, bethinta izandla futhi bekhuluma ngezinto ezenza inhliziyo yabo ijabule.

Umfundi uthi uthando lomngane wakhe lwenza kube lula ukujwayela izifundo ezinzima, futhi lokhu kumnikeza ugqozi lokufunda nokuphumelela esikoleni.

Abashadile bahlela umshado wabo, behlanganyela izindaba zothando lwabo nomndeni nabangane, kanti izinyembezi zobumnandi nezokujabula ziyavela ezingalweni zabo.

Abangani abakhulu baxoxa ebusuku ngothando lwabo lwangempela, bephakamisa izeluleko mayelana nokwethembana, ukuhloniphana, kanye nokusekela omunye nomunye ezikhathini ezinzima.

Umfana uthumela izimbali kumfazi wakhe, ekhuluma ngenhliziyo yakhe, ezwakalisa uthando nobuqotho obungenakulinganiswa phakathi kwabantu abathandanayo.

Abazali bafundisa izingane zabo ukubaluleka kothando, ukubekezelelana, kanye nokuhlalisana kahle nabanye, kanti izingane ziyazijabulela izindaba zomndeni nezemvelo ezinezifundo zokuphila.

Abathandanayo bahamba ebusuku egcekeni elikhanyiswe izibani, behamba izinyathelo ezihambisana nenhliziyo yabo, baxoxa ngezinto ezibalulekile ebudlelwaneni babo.

Umfana nomfazi wakhe bahlangana esidlangalaleni, behleka, behlanganyela iziphuzo ezibandayo, futhi bexoxa ngezinto ezenza uthando lwabo luhlale luqinile.

Abangani abathandanayo basebenzisa isikhathi sabo sokuphumula ukwenza izinto ezinhle ndawonye, bethokozisa inhliziyo yabo futhi beqinisa ubudlelwane babo.

Umfazi uhlanganisa umndeni wakhe nabangani bakhe emcimbini wokuzalwa, ekhuluma ngothando olungenakulinganiswa abanolona kubo bonke abantu abaseduze kwakhe.

Abashadile bavakasha eholidini, behamba ngezindlela ezinhle zemvelo, behlanganyela izinto abazithandayo, futhi bejabulela izikhathi ezijabulisayo zothando lwabo.

Umfundi uthandana nomngane wakhe omkhulu, behlanganyela izincwadi, izikhathi zokufunda, futhi baxoxa ngezinto ezijulile ezibenza baqonde uthando nobungani.

Abantu abathandanayo bathumela izithombe, izincwadi, nemiyalezo ebhalwe ngenhliziyo yabo, bekhombisa uthando nobuqotho kubangani babo futhi beqinisa ubudlelwano babo.

Umfana uxoxa nomfazi wakhe ngothando, izifiso, nezinhlelo zempilo yabo, kanti izingane zabo zibuka futhi zifunda ukubaluleka kothando olungapheli.

Abangani abathandanayo baxoxa ngezikhathi zobunzima, bexoxa ngendlela yokuxazulula izingxabano, futhi beqinisa ukwethembana phakathi kwabo.

Abashadile bafunda ukubambisana emsebenzini wasekhaya, bephendula izingane zabo futhi beqhuba izimpilo zabo ngokuthula nothando.

Abathandanayo bayahamba emahlathini, bezijabulisa, behamba izinyathelo ezide futhi bekhuluma ngezinto ezenza uthando lwabo luhlale luqinile.

Umfana uthanda ukufunda izincwadi nabangani bakhe, futhi uthando lwakhe lwezemfundo lwenza kube lula ukuthi aqonde izifundo zesayensi nezibalo.

Abazali baxoxa nezingane zabo ngobudlelwane obuhle, uthando lokuhloniphana, kanye nokusekelana phakathi kwabantu bomndeni ngenkathi behlanganyela ukudla okuhle futhi bejabulela izikhathi zomndeni.

Umfazi ubuka umfana wakhe edlala egcekeni, ethanda indlela aphatha ngayo abangane bakhe futhi ebona ukuthi uthando lokusiza abanye luyakhula kuye nsuku zonke.

Abashadile bahamba eduze komfula, behamba ngezandla, bekhuluma ngezifiso zabo zempilo futhi bexoxa ngezindlela zokugcina ubudlelwano babo buqinile nanoma yiziphi izingxabano eziphakeme.

Abangani abakhulu baxoxa ebusuku ngothando lwabo lwangempela, bekhuluma ngezinto ezenza inhliziyo yabo ijabule futhi bethuthukisa ukwethembana okukhulu phakathi kwabo.

Umfundi uthumela incwadi kumngane wakhe eklasini, echaza imizwa yakhe yokuthanda kanye nokubonga ngokusekelwa okufanele enkonzweni yokufunda.

Abafundi bafunda izifundo zokuziphatha ezinhle ezikoleni, bexoxa ngomusa, uthando, nokusekelana kwabanye ngenkathi bethola ukuqonda okukhulu kwezinto ezenza ubudlelwane bube buhle.

Ubaba uhlola indlela izingane zakhe eziphatha ngayo ngesikhathi sokudlala, efundisa ukubambisana, ukuzijabulisa, nokuhlalisana ngendlela efanele.

Umzali uhlangana nabangani bezingane bakhe, bexoxa ngezindlela zokufunda, ukuzijabulisa, nokuphatha izikhathi zabo ngendlela ephumelelayo.

Umama ufundisa izingane zakhe ukuhlela ukudla, ukusebenza ndawonye, nokusebenzisa isikhathi sabo ngendlela ephumelelayo.

Ubaba uhlanganyela nabantwana bakhe emidlalweni yasekhaya, bexoxa ngezindlela zokubambisana, ukusekelana, nokuphila ngendlela enobuqotho.

Izinyoni zindiza phezulu ezihlahleni eziphakeme, ziqhuba izigcawu zazo, futhi abantwana babukela ngokuthokozisa amehlo.

Umfula ogijima phakathi kwamahlathi ulethela amanzi emasimini, futhi izilwane zasendle ziyaphuza kulo ngesikhathi sasehlobo.

Amahlathi amakhulu agcwele izihlahla ezindala nezitshalo ezincane, kanti izinyoni ezimhlophe ziyakha izidleke zazo ngaphakathi emahlathini.

Izimbali ezinemibala ehlukahlukene zikhula ogwadule oluhlaza, futhi izinyosi ziyavakashela ukuze ziqoqa uju olumnandi.

Izintaba eziphakeme zibonakala kude, futhi amanzi omfula ogijima phakathi kwezintaba akhanyisa emini ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga.

Izimvu zidlala emasimini avulekile, kanti izimbuzi zibheka phansi emifuleni eduze kwezihlahla ezinkulu.

Umoya onamandla uphephula amaqabunga ezihlahleni, kanti izingane zidlala ngaphandle zigqoke izingubo ezifudumele.

Izinyoni ezinemibala ehlukene zindiza phezu komfula, zigcina izidleke zazo emagatsheni aphakeme.

Izihlahla eziminyene zenza umthunzi omuhle ehlobo, futhi abantu bavakashela emahlathini ukujabulela ukuphumula nokuphefumula umoya omusha.

Amahlathi agcwele izilwane zasendle ezifana nezinkawu, izinyoni, nezimvubu, futhi abavakashi babukela ngokuthokozisa amehlo.

Umfula ogijima kancane phakathi kwezihlahla unikeza indawo yokudlala yezingane ezindaweni zasemakhaya.

Izintaba ezimhlophe ziphakamisa amafu, futhi izivakashi zithatha izithombe ngesikhathi ilanga lishona emfuleni.

Izitshalo zasendle zikhula ngaphezu kweminyaka eminingi, kanti abomlimi bazilondoloza ukuze kuhlale kukhona amanzi kanye nomhlabathi ocebile.

Izinyoni ezincane ziyacina imiphongolo yazo emagatsheni, ziqapha umoya futhi zifunda ukukhomba ukudla.

Umfundisi uchaza izindaba ezivela eBhayibhelini, ezibheka ubulungiswa, uthando, nomusa, kanti abafundi bayazilalela ngokuzimisela.

Abefundisi abasha bahlangana nabadala bexoxa ngezindlela zokuhlela imisebenzi yesonto futhi baxoxa ngezinhlelo zokuxhasa abakhulekeli.

Izingane zihlala endaweni yokufundela yesonto lapho zifunda khona izindaba zeBhayibheli, ziqeqesha imikhuba yokuthandaza, nokuzindla.

Abakhulekeli bavakashela isonto elidala, bethokozisa inhliziyo yabo ngokubukela umculo wekhwaya futhi bejabulela ukuphumula emoyeni opholile.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukulalela izimfundiso zenkolo kuyakhulisa ubuntu, kubeka ingqondo nokuziphatha ngendlela efanele.

Abantu abasha bahlanganyela emhlanganweni womphakathi wesonto, befunda ukubambisana, ukuthandaza, nokuhlonipha abantu abadala.

Umfundisi uhlela ukufundisa abakhulekeli abasafunda ngendlela yokuxhumana nomphakathi ngendlela enobuqotho.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wokukhuleka, befunda izifundo zokuphila, ububele, nokusebenza ndawonye.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi uthando nomusa kubaluleke kakhulu ekuphileni komuntu, futhi abantu bafunda ukuzenzela izenzo ezinhle nsuku zonke.

Abakhulekeli abasha bavakashela ibandla elikhulu, bejabulela umculo, bethandaza, futhi bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthuthukisa ukholo lwabo.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukukhulekela ngokuzimisela, ukuxhumana nabanye, nokubambisana kubalulekile empilweni yomphakathi.

Abefundisi bahlanganyela emhlanganweni wokuhlela izinsuku zomkhosi, bexoxa ngezindlela zokusekela abakhulekeli abasha nabadala.

Abakhulekeli babamba iqhaza ekuseni nasemini emicimbini yesonto, befunda izimfundiso ezihlobene nokuphila komphakathi, ubuntu, kanye nothando.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokuzindla nsuku zonke, ukufunda izindaba zeBhayibheli, futhi ukufaka ukholo empilweni ukuze kuthuthukiswe ubuntu.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emhlanganweni wesonto, befunda izindlela zokuphila ngokwethembeka, uthando, nokuxhasa abantu abaswele.

Izingane ziyacula emcimbini wesonto, zifunda izimfundiso zokubambisana, ukuthandaza, nokuhlalisana nabanye ngendlela efanele.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukunikela kwabakhulekeli kubalulekile ekusizeni abanye, ukwakha umphakathi, futhi kufundisa ububele.

Abakhulekeli abasha bahlanganyela emihlanganweni yebandla, befunda ukubambisana, ukuxhumana, nokuphila ngokwethembeka.

Umfundisi uhlangana nabadala nabafundi, bexoxa ngezindlela zokukhulisa ukholo, ukubambisana, nokufundisa abasha izimfundiso ezibalulekile.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emicimbini yomphakathi wesonto, befunda ukufunda izindaba zesonto, ukuthandaza, nokuhlalisana nabanye.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukuzindla njalo nokuthandaza kuyakhulisa ubuntu, kuqinisa ukholo, futhi kuqinisa imishado nomphakathi.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wokuphenduka, befunda izimfundiso zokuxolelana, ukusebenzisa umusa, nokuzinikela ekusizeni abanye.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukugcina imfundiso yesonto empilweni yansuku zonke kukhuthaza ubuntu, uthando, nokusekela abanye.

Abakhulekeli abasha babamba iqhaza ekuseni emcimbini wesonto, befunda izindlela zokuxhumana nabanye futhi bakhuthazwe ukuphila ngobuqotho.

Umfundisi uhlangana nabantu abasanda kufunda, bexoxa ngezindlela zokuthandaza, ukuzindla, nokuphila ngokuhambisana nezimfundiso zenkolo.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wesonto ebusuku, befunda ukuthandaza, ukubambisana, nokuthuthukisa ubuhlobo bomphakathi.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokuphatha ibandla, ukufundisa abakhulekeli, nokwakha umphakathi onobuqotho nomusa.

Abakhulekeli abasha bahlanganyela emihlanganweni yokuzindla, befunda ukubekezelelana, ukuxhumana, nokuphila ngendlela efanele.

Umfundisi uchaza izindlela zokuphila ezihle, uthando, ububele, nokuxhumana nomphakathi ngendlela ephumelelayo.

Abakhulekeli babamba iqhaza emcimbini wesonto, befunda ukuthandaza, ukubambisana, nokukhuthaza ubuntu emiphakathini yabo.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukuthandaza, ukuzindla, nokuzinikela kubalulekile empilweni yomuntu futhi kuqinisa imishado nemindeni.

Abakhulekeli abasha bahlanganyela emcimbini wokukhulekela, befunda izimfundiso zeBhayibheli, uthando, nokuphila ngendlela enobuqotho.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukuhlela imisebenzi yesonto ngokubambisana nabakhulekeli kubalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi ohloniphekile.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emhlanganweni wesonto, befunda izimfundiso zokuphila, uthando, kanye nokusekela abanye abantu.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokuzindla nsuku zonke, ukubukela izimfundiso zeBhayibheli, futhi ukufaka ukholo empilweni.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wokuzindla, befunda ukuthandaza, ukubambisana, nokuzinikela ekusizeni abanye.

Umfundisi uchaza ukuthi ukunikela, ukusekela abakhulekeli abasha, nokwakha ubuntu kubalulekile empilweni yesonto.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emihlanganweni yesonto, befunda izimfundiso zokuphila, uthando, nokuphila ngokwethembeka nabanye.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokukhulekela, ukubambisana, nokuphila ngendlela enobuqotho nomusa.

Abakhulekeli abasha bahlanganyela emcimbini wesonto, befunda ukuthandaza, ukuzindla, nokubambisana nabanye.

Umfundisi uchaza izimfundiso ezibalulekile ezihlobene nobubele, uthando, nokusekela umphakathi.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wesonto, befunda ukubambisana, ukuhamba ngezinyathelo ezinhle, nokuphila ngendlela enobuqotho.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokuphila ngokuzethemba, ukubambisana, nokuzinikela ekusizeni abanye.

Abakhulekeli abasha bahlanganyela emihlanganweni yesonto, befunda izifundo zokuphila, ukuthandaza, nokuphila ngokubambisana.

Umfundisi uchaza indlela yokuphila ngokwethembeka, uthando, nokukhuthaza ubuntu emiphakathini yabo.

Abakhulekeli bahlanganyela emcimbini wesonto, befunda ukuthandaza, ukubambisana, nokuphila ngendlela ephumelelayo.

Ndihlala eKhayelitsha futhi ngibuka abantwana bedlala egcekeni elikhulu lapho behleka khona kakhulu.

Umfundi omncane ufunda ukubhala izincwadi zendabuko ngenkathi uthisha echaza izibonelo eziningi.

Abafowethu nabodadewethu basiza izingane ezincane ukufunda imidlalo yendabuko ngaphandle kokulimala.

Umntwana udlala ngebhola enkundleni yesikole kanti abangane bakhe bayahamba bemlandela.

Abantwana abanesibindi bayakwazi ukukhuluma phambi kwegumbi labafundi befunda ukuzethemba.

Umama ufundisa izingane zakhe ukupheka ukudla okulula, futhi bayathokozela ukudla ndawonye.

Abantwana basebenzisa izincwadi ezinemifanekiso ukufunda amagama amasha nezindaba ezimnandi.

Umfana omncane uyagijima egcekeni elikhulu nomngani wakhe bezama ukubaleka kodwa behleka.

Abafundi abancane basebenzisa amakhadibhodi ukwenza izincwadi zabo zomdlalo futhi bafunda ukufunda nokubhala.

Umntwana ofunda eklasini usebenzisa i-ikhompyutha ukufunda izifundo ezinzima ezifana nesayensi nemathematics.

Abantwana abavakashela isikole samaholide bafunda imidlalo eminingi ephathelene nemvelo nobuntu.

Umfundi omncinci uthatha incwadi yakhe ayifundile ekhaya azama ukuqonda yonke into echazwe nguthisha.

Abantwana bathi bayathanda ukudlala emakhaya nasezinkundleni zokudlala lapho bengaxhumana khona nabangane.

Umfundi uyakwazi ukubhala indaba ende ngemibono yakhe futhi uthisha uyamvumela ukuba ayifunde phambi kwabanye.

Abafundi baseklasini bafunda izifundo zesayensi ngenkathi uthisha echaza izibonelo eziphilayo.

Umfundi omncinci uthatha incwadi yakhe yesayensi ekhaya ukuze afunde amagama amasha.

Abantwana basebenzisa izincwadi ezinemifanekiso ukuze baqonde izifundo ezinzima esikoleni.

Uthisha uchaza izibalo ngendlela ecacile futhi enomdlandla ukuze abafundi baqonde kangcono.

Abafundi bayakwazi ukubhala izivivinyo zabo ngesikhathi esibekiwe ngokunaka yonke imiyalelo.

Umfundi ufunda ukufunda izindaba ezimnandi ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni amagama akhe.

Abafundi bayakwazi ukuxoxa imibono yabo ngemuva kwesifundo ukuze bafunde ukubambisana.

Abafundi abanesibindi bayakwazi ukwenza izethulo ezinkulu phambi kweklasi labo.

Imoto entsha ubaba ayithenge ngesonto eledlule ihamba kahle kakhulu emgwaqeni omkhulu oya eThekwini, futhi injini yayo ithule ngendlela emangalisayo uma iqhathaniswa nemoto yakhe endala.

Ngisuka ekhaya ekuseni ngishayela imoto yami ebomvu eya emsebenzini, ngidlula ezitaladini ezimatasa lapho amaloli, amatekisi nezimoto zomphakathi kugcwele khona.

Abantu abaphumelelayo bavame ukuzilungiselela amathuba ngaphambi kokuba avele.

Impumelelo ayisona isiphetho, kodwa iwuhambo oluqhubekayo.

Umuntu ogcina umgomo wakhe engqondweni uyakwazi ukuwufinyelela.

Impumelelo ifuna ukugxila okuqinile nokusebenza kanzima.

Abantu abaphumelelayo bavame ukufunda nsuku zonke.

Impumelelo ayifiki ngokushesha, kodwa ifika kulabo abaphikelela.

Umuntu osebenza ngokwethembeka uvame ukuthola impumelelo eqinile.

Impumelelo ifuna umuntu akwazi ukulawula isikhathi sakhe kahle.

Abantu abaphumelelayo bavame ukugcina ithemba ngisho nasezikhathini ezinzima.

Impumelelo ivame ukuza kulabo abangayeki naphezu kwezinselelo.

Umdlali womjaho owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emqhudelwaneni wesifunda
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wafunda ukuthi ukwehluleka kuyisifundo esiqinisa ukuzimisela ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokubhukuda owahlangabezana nokwehluleka esigabeni sokugcina
somqhudelwano akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wafunda ukuthi ukwehluleka kuyisifundo esiqinisa
ukuzimisela ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile
ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wethenisi owahlangabezana nokwehluleka esigabeni sokugcina
somqhudelwano akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya

ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe
kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali webhola owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emncintiswaneni wamazwe
ngamazwe akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wethenisi owahlangabezana nokwehluleka esigabeni sokugcina
somqhudelwano akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi waqonda ukuthi ukuphikelela kubaluleke kakhulu
kunokunqoba okukodwa ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo
esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Iqembu lebhola owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emqhudelwaneni wesifunda
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe

ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni
lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wezemidlalo zesikole owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni
obalulekile akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya

kwesikhathi ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile
ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe
kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

wahlaziya amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni
ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi wabona ukuthi amaphutha angamfundisa isu
elingcono ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile
ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Iqembu lebhola owahlangabezana nokwehluleka esigabeni sokugcina
somqhudelwano akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi waqonda ukuthi impumelelo idinga ukuzilolonga
okungapheli ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile
ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali we-rugby owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emjahweni kazwelonke
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wafunda ukuthi ukuzethemba kwakhiwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wethenisi owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emjahweni kazwelonke
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
waqonda ukuthi impumelelo idinga ukuzilolonga okungapheli ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokubhukuda owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emjahweni kazwelonke
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wafunda ukubekezela nokusebenza kanzima ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe
kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali webhasikidi owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni wokuhlunga
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wabona ukuthi amaphutha angamfundisa isu elingcono ngoba ukwehluleka
kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokubhukuda owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emncintiswaneni wamazwe
ngamazwe akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wezemidlalo zesikole owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni
wokuhlunga akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali webhola owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emqhudelwaneni omkhulu
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wafunda ukubekezela nokusebenza kanzima ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe
kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokubhukuda owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emqhudelwaneni
wesifunda akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba
ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe
lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokuqwala izintaba owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni
obalulekile akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela
okukhulu, futhi wafunda ukuthi ukuzethemba kwakhiwa ngokuhamba
kwesikhathi ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile
ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali we-rugby owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni wokuhlunga
akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya amaphutha akhe
ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi
wabona ukuthi ukwesekwa kweqembu kubalulekile ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe
kwakuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Umdlali wokuqwala izintaba owahlangabezana nokwehluleka emdlalweni
obalulekile akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi wahlaziya
