Umdlali wezemidlalo zesikole owahlangabezana nokwehluleka esigabeni
sokugcina somqhudelwano akazange aphele amandla, kodwa wahlala phansi
wahlaziya amaphutha akhe ngokucophelela, wabuyela ekuziqeqesheni
ngokuzimisela okukhulu, futhi waqonda ukuthi ukuphikelela kubaluleke
kakhulu kunokunqoba okukodwa ngoba ukwehluleka kwakhe kwakuyisinyathelo
esibalulekile ohambweni lwakhe lwezemidlalo.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa
emhlabeni wonke ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke
ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emsebenzini nsuku zonke, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba amanani ayo ayahambisana nenani
lomkhiqizo, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani
ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo wesimanje
ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi eside zigqokwa,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajazi kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo
nabadumile ngoba amanani ayo ayahambisana nenani lomkhiqizo, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emsebenzini nsuku zonke, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo odume kakhulu entsheni
ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emsebenzini nsuku zonke, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo
nabadumile ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zomshado kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo
ezibizayo kodwa eziqinile ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside
ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini
esemthethweni, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zokulala kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo
wesimanje ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu
kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amahembe kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo

kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo odume kakhulu entsheni

ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe amajean kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo
wesimanje ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko
emiklamweni yawo ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

isikhathi eside zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa
nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha
umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu
kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele
isikhathi eside zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca
noma ukwenza imidlalo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo
ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye
nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amahembe kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi
kuqinile, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emsebenzini nsuku zonke,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko
endabuko emiklamweni yawo ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe
iphezulu kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amasudi kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko
emiklamweni yawo ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajezi kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo
nabadumile ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi eside
zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni

kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amahembe kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo ezibizayo
kodwa eziqinile ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi

kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini

ephezulu ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo
wesimanje ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo ezibizayo
kodwa eziqinile ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle
kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza

kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izigqoko kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko

indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe
nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi

Abantu abaningi bathenga amahembe kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni

ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela
somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izicathulo kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo ezibizayo
kodwa eziqinile ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle
kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza
imidlalo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhantshi kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko

ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo
olude, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala
indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe
nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amasudi kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke
ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi zingubo
zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha
umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu
kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo odume kakhulu entsheni
ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi zingubo
zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi
ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela
somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajezi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

yakamuva, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza
imidlalo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo odume kakhulu entsheni
ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza imidlalo, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izicathulo kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko
emiklamweni yawo ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi
eside zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma
enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajezi kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside
ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni
noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke
ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni
wonke ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhantshi kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele
isikhathi eside zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa
nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha
umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu
kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni
wonke ngoba amanani ayo ayahambisana nenani lomkhiqizo, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko
emiklamweni yawo ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu
kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani
ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajazi kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke
ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi zingubo
zilungele ukuhamba uhambo olude, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha
umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu
kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa
emhlabeni wonke ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi

ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

ngoba umklamo uhlanganisa ubuhle nokunethezeka, okwenza lezi zingubo
zilungele ukuya emishadweni nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi
ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela
somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni
nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe amajean kumkhiqizo ogxile
ekukhiqizeni ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu
ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele
ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi
ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela
somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izigqoko kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko
emiklamweni yawo ngoba amanani ayo ayahambisana nenani lomkhiqizo,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amasudi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza imidlalo, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza imidlalo, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke

enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo ohlonishwa emhlabeni wonke
ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe amajean kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo
wesimanje ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu
kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo wesimanje
ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi eside zigqokwa,
okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza imidlalo,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izicathulo kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo wesimanje
ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo
nabadumile ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya emishadweni nasemikhosini, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zomshado kumkhiqizo ogxile

ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye
nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo ogxile

zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhantshi kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo

wesimanje ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi
zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni, futhi lokhu kubonisa
ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni
isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo
nabadumile ngoba ikhwalithi yezindwangu ezisetshenzisiwe iphezulu
kakhulu, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emicimbini esemthethweni,
futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima
enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku
zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhulukwe amajean kumkhiqizo ogxile
ekukhiqizeni ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle
futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani
ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amasudi kumkhiqizo odume kakhulu entsheni ngoba
ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi kuqinile, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele
ukuzivocavoca noma ukwenza imidlalo, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi
ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela
somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amakepisi kumkhiqizo ogxile kumklamo wesimanje
ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani ngezimpelasonto, futhi
lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zomshado kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko
endabuko emiklamweni yawo ngoba amanani ayo ayahambisana nenani
lomkhiqizo, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuzijabulisa nabangani
ngezimpelasonto, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajazi kumkhiqizo owaziwa ngekhwalithi
ephezulu ngoba izitayela zayo zilandelana nemfashini yakamuva, okwenza
lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma enyuvesi, futhi lokhu
kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala indima enkulu
ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amajazi kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo ezibizayo
kodwa eziqinile ngoba umbala awupheli kalula noma sekuphele isikhathi
eside zigqokwa, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya esikoleni noma
enyuvesi, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele
kudlala indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba
kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko
endabuko emiklamweni yawo ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside
ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuhamba uhambo
olude, futhi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ukukhetha umkhiqizo ofanele kudlala
indima enkulu ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe
nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo kumkhiqizo ogxile ekukhiqizeni
ngendlela enobungani nemvelo ngoba ukuthungwa kwazo kuhle futhi

ekwakheni isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga amasudi kumkhiqizo ogcina amasiko endabuko

Abantu abaningi bathenga amabhande kumkhiqizo othandwa osaziwayo

isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zomshado kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo
ezibizayo kodwa eziqinile ngoba izingubo zihlala isikhathi eside
ngaphandle kokulimala, okwenza lezi zingubo zilungele ukuya emsebenzini

Abantu abaningi bathenga iziketi kumkhiqizo owenza izingubo ezibizayo

Abantu abaningi bathenga izingubo zemidlalo kumkhiqizo othandwa

isitayela somuntu kanye nokuzethemba kwakhe nsuku zonke.

Abantu abaningi bathanda izilwane ezifuywayo ngoba ziletha injabulo, uthando olungenamibandela, kanye nobungane obuqotho obenza ikhaya lizizwe liphilile futhi ligcwele ukufudumala nsuku zonke.

Inja yami ihlala ilinde emnyango lapho ngibuya emsebenzini, igijime ijabule, igingqike phansi, futhi ibonise uthando ngendlela engenakulinganiswa ngamazwi.

Ikati elincane esilikhulisayo lithanda ukuhlala efasiteleni libuka izinyoni ngaphandle, kodwa ebusuku lifuna ukulala eduze kwethu ukuze lizizwe liphephile futhi lithandwa

Ukondla izilwane ezifuywayo ukudla okunempilo kubalulekile ngoba kusiza ekukhuleni kwazo, ekuqineni komzimba, nasekuvimbeleni izifo ezingazilimaza.

Umntwana wami ufunde umthwalo wemfanelo ngokunakekela unogwaja wethu, emnika amanzi ahlanzekile, ukudla okwanele, kanye nendawo ehlanzekile yokuhlala.

Izilwane ezifuywayo zifundisa izingane umusa, ukubekezela, kanye nokuhlonipha impilo, ngoba zidinga ukunakekelwa okungapheli nokuthandwa.

Inja enkulu esiyifuyile iyavikela ikhaya lethu ebusuku, kodwa emini iyadlala nezingane, ibonise ukuthi inamandla kodwa inobubele.

Ukuyisa isilwane kudokotela wezilwane njalo kuyasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi siphilile futhi asinasifo esingase sisabalale kwabanye.

Ikati lethu liyazimela kakhulu, kodwa lisondela uma lifuna ukudlalwa noma uma lifuna ukudla okwengeziwe.

Izinyoni ezifuywayo endlini zenza umsindo omnandi ekuseni, ziqale usuku lwethu ngomoya wokujabula nokuthula.

Ukugcina indawo yezilwane ihlanzekile kubalulekile ukuze kugwenywe iphunga elibi kanye nokusabalala kwamagciwane angalimaza abantu nezilwane.

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi uphuze amanzi amaningi ngezikhathi zokushisa ukuze umzimba wakho ungalahlekelwa amandla adingekayo.

Ngicela ungisize ngokuhlela i-aphoyintimenti nodokotela onguchwepheshe wezinhliziyo ngoba ngizwa ukushaya kwayo kungajwayelekile.

Ukudla izithelo nemifino enemibala ehlukahlukene kusiza kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasosha omzimba wakho aqine ngokwanele ukulwa nezifo.

Uma ungezwa kahle emva kokuphuza lo muthi, ngicela uyeke ukuwuphuza bese ubuyela emtholampilo ngokushesha okukhulu ukuze uhlolwe kabusha.

Ngizwa ubuhlungu obukhulu emhlane obehlela nasezinyaweni, ikakhulukazi uma ngizama ukuphakamisa izinto ezisindayo noma ngihamba ibanga elide.

Udokotela ungitshele ukuthi kufanele ngyisebenzise njalo imishini yokuzivocavoca ukuze nginciphise ushukela osegazini lami ngendlela ephephile.

Ingane yami ibilokhu ikhwehlela ubusuku bonke futhi kubonakala sengathi isifuba sayo sivalekile, ngakho-ke sidinga usizo lwezokwelapha masinyane.

Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi ugeza izandla zakho kahle ngensipho namanzi afudumele ngaphambi kokuba ulungise ukudla komndeni wakho wonke.

Ngicela unginikeze incazelo ephelele mayelana nemiphumela engemihle engase ivele ngenxa yokusebenzisa leli philisi elisha lokulawula umfutho wegazi.

Ukulala isikhathi esanele ebusuku kusiza ingqondo yakho ukuba iphumule futhi kunciphisa amazinga okukhathazeka kakhulu emsebenzini nasekhaya.

Isilonda esisenzweni sami asifuni ukoma kahle yize ngisebenzisa amafutha okugcoba anikezwe unesi wasemtholampilo waseduze nathi.

Kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi impilo yengqondo ibaluleke kakhulu njengempilo yomzimba, ngakho-ke khuluma nothile uma uzizwa ucindezelekile.

Ngidinga ukwenza uvivinyo lwegazi ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi amazinga ayinsimbi emzimbeni wami alungile ngoba ngihlale ngizizwa ngikhathele.

Ukusetshenziswa kukashukela omningi kakhulu ekudleni naseziphuzweni kungaholela ezifweni ezingelapheki njengesifo sikashukela nohlobo lwesibili.

Umama udinga ukuyohlolwa emtholampilo wezifo zabesifazane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle ngempilo yakhe jikelele.

Uma unomkhuhlane ophakeme kakhulu, kumele usebenzise indwangu emanzi ukupholisa umzimba wakho ngenkathi usalinde ukuyobona udokotela.

Amavithamini asiza kakhulu ekuqiniseni amathambo nemisipha yethu, ikakhulukazi njengoba sikhula eminyakeni yokuphila.

Ngizwa ubuhlungu obungapheli emalungeni eminwe yami ikakhulukazi uma isimo sezulu sibanda kakhulu noma lina imvula.

Kufanele sigomele izifo ezihlukahlukene kusenesikhathi ukuze sivikele izingane zethu ekufeni nasezifweni ezingagwemeka kalula.

Ukuhamba ngezinyawo imizuzu engamashumi amathathu ngosuku kungasiza ekwehliseni ingcindezi nasempilweni enhle yenhliziyo nemithambo yegazi

Kubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi abantu abaphila nesifo sikashukela bahlole izinyawo zabo nsuku zonke ukuze babone uma kunezilonda ezingaqali ukuphola kahle.

Uma uzizwa unesiyezi esikhulu ngenkathi uphakama esituhlini, kungase kusho ukuthi umfutho wegazi lakho wehle kakhulu ngaleso sikhathi.

Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi izingane zakho zithola wonke amavithamini adingekayo ukuze amathambo azo akhule eqinile futhi abe nempilo enhle kakhulu.

Ukusebenzisa amakhondomu ngendlela efanele njalo uma uya ocansini kusiza kakhulu ekunciphiseni ukubhebhetheka kwegciwane lesandulela ngculazi nezinye izifo.

Ngicela ungitshele uma unomlando wemikhuhlane ehlala isikhathi eside emndeni wakho ukuze udokotela akwazi ukukuhlola ngokucophelela okwengeziwe.

Umoya ohlanzekile ongena endlini kusiza kakhulu ekunqandeni ukubhebhetheka kwesifo sofuba ikakhulukazi uma kukhona umuntu okhwehlelayo phakathi kwenu.

Ukuphuza amanzi afudumele anolamula nophepha obabayo ekuseni kungasiza ekuhlanzeni uhlelo lwakho lokugaya ukudla nasekuqiniseni amasosha omzimba.

Uma unomzwelo obuhlungu esinyeni ngenkathi uchama, kumele uye emtholampilo ngokushesha ukuze uhlolele ukuthi awunayo yini inkukhu noma amagciwane.

Kufanele ufunde kabanzi mayelana nokudla okunempilo ukuze ukwazi ukulawula isisindo somzimba wakho ngendlela eyiyo nengenabo ubungozi obukhulu.

Udokotela uncoma ukuthi uyeke ukuphuza iziphuzo ezinoshukela omningi ngoba zilimaza izinso zakho futhi zidala ukukhuluphala ngokweqile emzimbeni.

Uma uzwa ubuhlungu obungajwayelekile esiswini emva kokudla ukudla okunamafutha, kungase kube inkinga yenyongo edinga ukuhlolwa ngudokotela oqeqeshiwe.

Ukuzivocavoca ngokuhamba ngezinyawo noma ukugijima kancane kusiza ekwehliseni amazinga okucindezeleka nasempilweni enhle yengqondo yakho jikelele.

Kumele uqinisekise ukuthi uhlanza amabhodlela okuncelisa ingane yakho ngamanzi abilayo njalo ukuze ubulale amagciwane angadala isifo sohudo.

Ngizwa ubuhlungu obukhulu entanyeni obufika kuye ekhanda, okungenzeka ukuthi budalwa ukuhlala isikhathi eside phambi kwekhompyutha ungaphumuli.

Ukuhlolwa kwesifo sofuba mahhala kuzo zonke izikhungo zezempilo zikahulumeni, ngakho-ke musa ukulinda uma ukhwehlela isikhathi eside.

Kufanele siqinisekise ukuthi abantu asebekhulile bathola ukunakekelwa okwanele kanye nokudla okunezakhamzimba ezizobasiza ukuba bangaqhuleki kalula.

Uma usebenzisa umuthi wokuhlanza amehlo

Umsebenzi wami uqala ekuseni lapho ngifika ehhovisi ngilungele ukuqala usuku ngomoya omusha.

Ukusebenza neqembu elihloniphana kwenza umsebenzi ube lula futhi ujabulise.

Umphathi wami ukhuthaza ukuxhumana okuvulekile phakathi kwabasebenzi.

Nsuku zonke sifunda izinto ezintsha ezisiza ukuthuthukisa amakhono ethu.

Ukubambisana emsebenzini kusisiza ukuthi siqede imisebenzi ngesikhathi esifanele.

Kwesinye isikhathi kuba nengcindezi, kodwa siyasebenzisana ukuze siyinqobe.

Imihlangano yasekuseni isisiza ukuhlela kahle imisebenzi yosuku.

Ukufika ngesikhathi kubalulekile ngoba kukhombisa ukuzibophezela emsebenzini.

Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabalingani kusiza ukugwema ukungaqondani.

Ngiyazama ukugcina ibhalansi phakathi komsebenzi nempilo yangasese.

Umsebenzi unginika ithuba lokukhula nokuthuthuka empilweni.

Ukuthola impendulo kumphathi kusiza ukuthi ngithuthukise ukusebenza kwami.

Emsebenzini sifunda ukubekezela nokuhlonipha imibono yabanye.

Ukusebenza kanzima kuletha imivuzo nemiphumela emihle.

Izikhathi zokuphumula zibalulekile ukuze sibuye namandla emsebenzini.

Ukusebenzisana nabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene kusifundisa ukubekezelelana.

Umoya omuhle ehhovisi wenza indawo yokusebenza ibe nenjabulo.

Uma kukhona inkinga, sihlangana sixoxe ukuze sithole isixazululo.

Ukuzimisela nokusebenza ngokwethembeka kubalulekile empumelelweni yomsebenzi.

Ngiyaziqhenya ngomsebenzi wami ngoba unomthelela omuhle emphakathini.

Abantu abaningi baya emakhaya omthandazo nsuku zonke befuna ukuthula nokukhululeka ezintweni ezibahlupha, bezinikela ngenhliziyo yabo yonke emithandazweni yokuphila okuhle.

Inkolo isiza abantu ukuba babhekane nezikhathi ezinzima, ngoba umthandazo uvula ingqondo nomoya, uqondisa isinqumo sabo futhi ubanike amandla okuphila.

Umfundisi usho njalo ukuthi ukukhulekela ngokuthembeka nokuzinikela kukhuthaza ukuthula ngaphakathi komuntu futhi kuvulela indlela yokuhlakanipha ekuphileni kwansuku zonke.

Umoya wokukhulekela uvusa uthando phakathi kwabantu, ngoba lapho abantu behlangana ndawonye emithandazweni, bayakwazi ukuhlanganyela izifiso zabo futhi bazizwe besondelene kuNkulunkulu.

Abantu basuke bejabulela ukuthula okuphuma emithandazweni, ngoba lapho bethula izinhliziyo zabo kuNkulunkulu, bakhuthazeka ukuba benze okuhle emphakathini nasemindenini yabo.

Umkhuleko uyindlela yokuxhumana noNkulunkulu, futhi lapho umuntu ekhuleka ngenhliziyo yakhe yonke, uthola ukuqonda okwengeziwe nokuthula kwangaphakathi.

Inkolo iphinde ifundise abantu ukubekezela, ngoba ukukhulekela njalo kubafundisa ukuthi bazethembe ekuphileni futhi bangapheli amandla nasezilingweni ezinzima.

Abantu abakholelwa ngokujulile bayakwazi ukuthola amandla ngokomoya, futhi lokhu kubasiza ukuba babhekane nezinkinga zabo ngendlela ehlakaniphile futhi enenhlonipho.

Izinkolo ezahlukene zifundisa ngokubaluleka komthandazo, futhi umuntu ngamunye angakwazi ukuthola indlela yakhe yokukhulekela nokuzithoba emhlabeni.

Umkhuleko awugcini nje ngokuba isenzo somuntu oyedwa, kodwa uyindlela yokuhlanganyela nabanye, ukuqinisa umphakathi nokwabelana ngenhlanhla nezinselelo.


Izihlahla ezindala ezigcwele amagqabi aluhlaza zikhula eduze komfula omkhulu, futhi imifula yawo ihamba kancane idlula emadlelweni aluhlaza agcwele izimbali ezimibalabala.

Izinyoni zasendle zicula ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngemuva kwezintaba, kanti umoya othambile uphonsa iphunga lezimbali emoyeni.

Umoya ushaya phakathi kwamagquma amakhulu, ududuze izihlahla futhi uthokozise izilwane ezincane ezihlala emahlathini.

Amanzi echibini ahlanzekile futhi abandayo, kuhlale kunemifula emincane ehamba phakathi kwamatshe amakhulu namagatsha ezihlahla.

Izimbali ezimibalabala zembethe intaba yonke, futhi izimvemvane nezinyoni ziza ukuzidla ngenkathi umoya ushaya kancane.

Ihlathi ligcwele izilwane ezincane nezinkulu, futhi amagatsha emithi ahamba ngendlela eyenza ukuthi kube nomthunzi omnandi ngaphansi.

Amagagasi olwandle ayageleza kancane ebhishi, kanti izinsimbi zamanzi zidlala nomoya okhanyayo nelanga.

Ilanga liphuma phezulu entabeni njalo ekuseni, likhanyisa amakhona amnyama wehlathi futhi lidale umoya wokuthula phakathi kwezilwane zasendle.

Imvula iyawa phezu komhlabathi omanzi, futhi amanzi ayahlanganisa izintaba nezihlahla zibe nomphumela omuhle wokukhula kwezitshalo.

Izimvemvane zibhakabhaka phakathi kwezimbali ezimibalabala, zidlala emoyeni futhi zidonsela amehlo abantu abahamba eduze kwehlathi.

Izinkuni zomuthi omdala zikhipha iphunga elimnandi elixubene nomoya, kanti izinyoni zihlala emahlathini ziphumula phakathi kwamagatsha.

Amagquma abukeka amnyama lapho kunefu, kodwa lapho ilanga likhanya, imibala yabo igcwala ubuhle bemvelo.

Umfula ugeleza ngesivinini esiphakathi nendawo phakathi kwamadlelo aluhlaza, udonsa izilwane zasendle eziza ukuphuza amanzi.

Izilwane zasendle zithola ukudla emahlathini, kanti ezinye zihlala phakathi kwamagatsha ezihlahla zize zifihle ezinyaweni zemithi.

Umoya wehlathi uthambisa ubuso bomuntu, uphonsa iphunga lezimbali nezihlahla ezindala futhi wenza ukuthi kube nokuthula okukhulu.

Izihlahla ezindala zinikeza umthunzi omkhulu kanti amagatsha azo ayahlala ehamba nomoya, edlala nemisebe yokukhanya kwelanga.

Amagquma ahlanganisa izintaba eziphakeme nezincane, futhi izintaba ezincane zigcwele izihlahla ezincane nezimbali ezikhula ngokwemvelo.

Ilanga lishona kancane phezu kolwandle olukhulu, likhanyisa amanzi futhi lidale izithunzi ezinhle ezidlula ebhishi nasemithambekeni yentaba.

Izinyoni zasendle zidla imbewu emhlane wezihlahla, kanti ezinye ziyaphaphazela zidlule phezulu emoyeni, zibukeka njengezimpiko ezimibalabala.

Imifula emincane ihamba phakathi kwamadlelo aluhlaza, iphethe amanzi ahlanzekile afika kude nezintaba futhi idale indawo efanele izilwane zasendle.

Izihlahla ezincane zibhakabhaka phezu komfula omkhulu lapho amanzi ehamba kancane, futhi izinyoni zicula ngesikhathi sokuphuma kwelanga, kudala umoya wokuthula phakathi kwehlathi.

Amagquma aphakeme agcwele izihlahla nezimbali ezimibalabala, kanti imifula emincane igijima phakathi kwamatshe ikhanyisa umhlaba ngombala okhanyayo.

Umoya ovela olwandle ushaya kancane ezihlahleni, uphonsa iphunga lezinhlobonhlobo zezilimo nemifula eseduze.

Izimbali ezimibalabala zembethe izigodi kanye nezihlahla, futhi izimvemvane zibhakabhaka zidlala phakathi kwamagatsha aluhlaza.

Ihlathi ligcwele izilwane ezincane nezinkulu, futhi amagquma aduduze nawo adala indawo ephephile yezinyoni nezimvemvane.

Amanzi echibini ahlanzekile futhi abandayo, kanti izingwe zihlala emithambekeni yalo zidlala ngenkathi imifula igijima phakathi kwamadwala.

Ilanga liphuma kancane entabeni, likhanyisa amakhona amnyama ehlathi futhi lidala umoya wokuthula phakathi kwezilwane zasendle.

Imvula iyawa phezu kwezintaba eziphakeme, ifaka amanzi emifuleni nasemahlathini, futhi ikhula izitshalo nemifula ngokwemvelo.

Izinyoni zicula kakhulu lapho izihlahla zigcwele amagqabi amasha, kanti imimoya ethambile iphonsa iphunga lezimbali ezintsha emoyeni.

Amagquma amakhulu agcwele izihlahla eziphakeme nezimbali ezimibalabala, futhi umhlaba ushelela ngemuva kwemvula emnandi.

Izinkuni zomuthi omdala zikhipha iphunga elimnandi, kanti izinyoni zasendle zihlala emahlathini ziphumula phakathi kwamagatsha ahlaza.

Umfula ugeleza kancane phakathi kwamadlelo aluhlaza, ulethe amanzi ahlanzekile ezilwaneni nasemithambekeni yezihlahla.

Umoya wehlathi uthambisa ubuso bomuntu, uphonsa iphunga lezimbali ezindala futhi wenza ukuthi kube nokuthula okukhulu phakathi kwezilwane.

Izihlahla ezindala zinikeza umthunzi omkhulu, kanti amagatsha azo adlala nomoya futhi adala izithunzi ezinhle emhlabathini.

Amagquma ahlanganisa izintaba eziphakeme nezincane, futhi izintaba ezincane zigcwele izihlahla ezincane nezimbali ezikhula ngokwemvelo.

Ilanga lishona kancane phezu kolwandle olukhulu, likhanyisa amanzi futhi lidale izithunzi ezinhle ezidlula ebhishi nasemithambekeni yentaba.

Izinyoni zasendle zidla imbewu emhlane wezihlahla, kanti ezinye zibhakabhaka phezulu emoyeni zidlala phakathi kwezihlahla.

Imifula emincane ihamba phakathi kwamadle

Umshado kaSipho noThandi wawuhlelwe ngobunyoninco obukhulu, wonke umuntu emndenini wakhe wayekhona ukuzobungaza lesi sigameko esikhulu empilweni yabo.

Abazali bahlele indawo yokubungaza, bafaka izimbali ezimhlophe nezinsimbi ezivunguzayo, kwathi izivakashi zafika zigqoke izingubo ezinhle kakhulu ukuze ziveze ukuhlonipha lesi sigameko.

Umkhwenyana wahlonipha amasiko omdabu ngesikhathi eshayela izigubhu, kwathi umkakhe wembathwe ingubo yensizwa yesintu ebonisa isithunzi nobuhle.

Ingoma yomshado yahlanganisa wonke umuntu emoyeni wokujabula, kwathi izingane zidlala eduze kwetafula elikhulu lapho kudlalwa khona imidlalo yomshado.

Umndeni wawukhuthaza izithandani ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi bayazithanda futhi bazinikele komunye nomunye, njengoba izithembiso zabo zaziphakeme futhi zithinta izinhliziyo zawo wonke umuntu obukhona.

Abangani babememeza bethokoza ngesikhathi kushaywa umshado, kanti abanye base beqopha ividiyo nezithombe ukuze kugcinwe izinkumbulo ezinhle zomcimbi.

Izivakashi zathola ukudla okumnandi okwakulungele wonke umuntu, futhi amatafula ahlotshiswe ngezimbali ezimibalabala nemibala ejabulisayo.

Abashadayo bagcwele injabulo lapho bezama ukugcina amasiko ahlukene, kubonakala ukuthi isiko nokuphila kwesimanje kuhlangene kahle.

Abazali bahlala eduze kwabashadayo, befundisa abancane ngamasiko omshado kanye nokubaluleka kokuziphatha ngendlela efanele emshadweni.

Umshado wagqokwa ubusuku bonke ngengoma nomdanso, kwathi wonke umuntu wazizwa ehlangene nomndeni omkhulu obumbene ngokuthokoza.

Abashadayo bagqoke iziqholo ezinhle nezingubo eziyisiko, okwenza bonke ababekhona bazizwe besemcimbini oyingqayizivele nenhle.

Umkhwenyana wanikeza umkakhe izimbali ezinhle, wazisho ukuthi lezi zimbali zifanekisela uthando oluhlala njalo nolungenamkhawulo.

Izinkulumo zabazali zazigcwele ukuthokoza nokubonisa isithunzi, kwathi izithandani zazizizwa zithokozile futhi zithonywe yizinhliziyo zabo.

Abazali nezihlobo babhala izincwadi zokubonga ezazigcwele uthando, abazishadayo babona ukuthi umshado wabo uwubudlelwane obukhulu phakathi kwemindeni emibili.

Umshado wawugcwele izimpahla zomdabu, okwakubonisa ukuhlonipha amasiko kanye nokuxhumana nomlando wabo.

Abashadayo bagcina ubusuku behleka futhi bethokozisa izivakashi, kwathi zonke izinkumbulo zomcimbi zagcinwa ngezinhliziyo ezimnandi.

Umzali wami uyacabanga futhi uyakhala amaphupho amahle uma esikhathini esifanele, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, udokotela uya eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali masishane ngobunyoninco ngoba umndenni wakhe umthanda kakhulu.

Kubalulekile ukuthi uthabo uyahamba uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe.

Izingane bayakhuluma izingubo ezinhle ethempelini elikhethekile, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga.

Kubalulekile ukuthi ulungelo uyafunda uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe.

UThabo uyagijima futhi uyagijima izimali ezilingene uma umsebenzi uphelile, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi usihle uyalala indlu enkulu izolo ebusuku ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi intombazane uyajabula injabulo enkulu ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Lapho abazali behlangene, bayathola ubukhosi obuhle ethempelini elikhethekile, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye.

UNokwanda uzithola ikhaya elimnandi kanye noamathuba amaningi ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

Umkhulu uzithola izincwadi ezibalulekile kanye noulwazi oluningi ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, ulindiwe uya esikoleni esikhulu edolobheni kusasa ekuseni lapho elanga liphuma ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu.

Omama bayajabula ubumnandi obukhethekile enkundleni yezemidlalo, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu.

Umzali wami uthanda izingubo ezinhle ehhovisi labo ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla.

UNomvula uzithola isikhathi esanele kanye noamaphupho amahle emgwaqeni omkhulu, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

USiyanda uyasebenza amazwi amnandi egcekeni labantu ababuya endaweni izolo ebusuku, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umuntu uya ethempelini elikhethekile ngesikhathi esikhethekile ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

USiyanda uyaphila futhi uyahleka imisebenzi emihle uma umsebenzi uphelile, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

Amantombazane bayakhuluma ukuthula okukhulu esibhedlela esikhulu, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu.

Inkosi uthanda ukudla okumnandi olwandle oluhle olusezansi ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile.

UThandeka uyasiza ngesikhathi ubongani uyahleka imisebenzi emihle, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

ULungelo uyazibuza futhi uyabona isikhathi esanele uma izingane zisesikole, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga.

Kubalulekile ukuthi ubongani uyafunda uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

UNomsa wafunda ukuthi ulwazi oluningi enkundleni yezemidlalo ubaluleke kakhulu ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umfundi uyapheka futhi uyabika izincwadi ezibalulekile lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa.

UNokwanda uyasiza ngesikhathi uthandeka uyacula ukuthula okukhulu, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

ULindiwe uthanda izingubo ezinhle emakethe enkulu edolobheni ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile.

Umzali wami uyahlanza ubuhle obukhulu esibhedlela esikhulu masishane ngobunyoninco, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

UThemba uthanda izingubo ezinhle eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umkhulu uya endlini enkulu emnandi ngesikhathi esikhethekile ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa.

UThemba uyathenga amathuba amaningi egcekeni labantu ababuya endaweni lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga.

Lapho abafana behlangene, bayathola ubumnandi obukhethekile ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye.

UNhlanhla wafunda ukuthi ukuthula okukhulu empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona ubaluleke kakhulu ngeSonto lelo, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

UNandi uzithola ukudla okumnandi kanye noamazwi amnandi esikoleni esikhulu edolobheni, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

UMbuso uyahlanza ngesikhathi umfana uyahamba isikhathi esanele, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unokwanda uyahamba ukudla okumnandi kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Abantu bayavuka imoto entsha empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona ngeSonto lelo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Kubalulekile ukuthi ubaba uyalala uma izingane zisesikole, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu.

UNokukhanya uyaphila ngesikhathi udokotela uyazibuza ukudla okumnandi, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, usihle uya emgwaqeni omkhulu kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ngoba umndenni wakhe umthanda kakhulu.

USipho uthanda izingubo ezinhle emakethe enkulu edolobheni ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle.

Izihlobo bayabona amanzi ahlanzekile empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona masishane ngobunyoninco ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

UBongani wafunda ukuthi imoto entsha ehhovisi labo ubaluleke kakhulu emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Lapho abantwana behlangene, bayathola izincwadi ezibalulekile eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye.

UNomvula wafunda ukuthi imoto entsha esibhedlela esikhulu ubaluleke kakhulu izolo ebusuku, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umfundi uyajabula imoto entsha olwandle oluhle olusezansi lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo.

Abafana bayahamba izimali ezilingene ethempelini elikhethekile, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga.

Izintombi bayathenga ubumnandi obukhethekile edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli njalo ngenyanga ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Odokotela bayajabula amathuba amaningi endlini enkulu emnandi ngesikhathi esikhethekile ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Umhlengikazi uzithola ukuthula okukhulu kanye noinjabulo enkulu eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

Abantu bayabona amandla amakhulu eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali ngeSonto lelo ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

ULungelo uzithola amandla amakhulu kanye noamathuba amaningi esigodini sakubo, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umfanafuthi uyalala uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle.

Abantwana bayacula injabulo enkulu eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Umngane wami uyavuka ukuthula okukhulu ekhaya emndenini wakhe njalo ngenyanga, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle.

Omakhelwane bayaphila amazwi amnandi ethempelini elikhethekile, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, usihle uya emfuleni ogelezayo kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto.

Uthisha uyahlanza ubukhosi obuhle edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli kusasa ekuseni lapho elanga liphuma, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe.

Intombazane uyabona indlu enkulu enkundleni yezemidlalo ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umuntu omncane uya eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

UMandla uzithola amazwi amnandi kanye noinjabulo enkulu ekhaya emndenini wakhe, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

UMandla uyapheka ngesikhathi umzali wami uyafunda amazwi amnandi, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

USihle uyasebenza ngesikhathi umama uyahleka izimali ezilingene, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

Umuntu omkhulu uyajabula ngesikhathi ugogo uyasebenza imisebenzi emihle, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

Othisha bayapheka ukuthula okukhulu ekhaya emndenini wakhe, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga.

Umngane wami uyahlanza ngesikhathi usipho uyacula isikhathi esanele, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

UBongani uzithola ubuhle obukhulu kanye noisikhathi esanele emfuleni ogelezayo, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

Lapho abantu behlangene, bayathola izincwadi ezibalulekile ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye.

Umuntu omncane uyakhuluma futhi uyacabanga ikhaya elimnandi uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu.

Izinsizwa bayahamba amaphupho amahle empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Omama bayabona izingubo ezinhle eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali njalo ngenyanga ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

UMbuso uthanda ubuhle obukhulu egcekeni labantu ababuya endaweni ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya.

Abangane bayajabula izingubo ezinhle olwandle oluhle olusezansi masishane ngobunyoninco ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Kubalulekile ukuthi usiyanda uyakhala lapho abantu bebonke behlangene, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

UThemba uyagijima imisebenzi emihle ekhaya emndenini wakhe emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

Omakhelwane bayacula ubuhle obukhulu ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu omkhulu uyakhuluma uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto.

Udokotela wafunda ukuthi injabulo enkulu ethempelini elikhethekile ubaluleke kakhulu kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umama uyaphila amanzi ahlanzekile empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlengikazi uyacula uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

Izingane bayakhuthazana izincwadi ezibalulekile eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya.

Ugogo uyakhuluma izimali ezilingene olwandle oluhle olusezansi njalo ngenyanga, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile.

UNokwanda uyahleka indlu enkulu empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma khona lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba umndenni wakhe umthanda kakhulu.

UNhlanhla uyalanda ukuthula okukhulu endlini enkulu emnandi izolo ebusuku, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto.

UNokukhanya wafunda ukuthi injabulo enkulu ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika ubaluleke kakhulu ngesikhathi esikhethekile, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umngane wami uyasebenza ngesikhathi unomvula uyajabula imisebenzi emihle, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu.

Abafana bayagijima amazwi amnandi olwandle oluhle olusezansi, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla.

UZinhle uthanda ukudla okumnandi esigodini sakubo ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile.

UMbuso uyathenga futhi uyalanda ubuhle obukhulu lapho izimali zikhona, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

UZinhle uyakhala futhi uyaphila ukuthula okukhulu uma umsebenzi uphelile, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo.

USipho uzithola ikhaya elimnandi kanye noamandla amakhulu eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile.

UZinhle wafunda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile eGoli ngesikhathi sezikhathi zezikhali ubaluleke kakhulu masishane ngobunyoninco, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umfana uya ehhovisi labo ngonyaka ozayo lapho isimo sezulu sifanele ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle.

Amantombazane bayasebenza amanzi ahlanzekile esibhedlela esikhulu nsuku zonke ekuseni ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi ulungelo uyajabula izincwadi ezibalulekile njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Umzali wami wafunda ukuthi amazwi amnandi ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu ubaluleke kakhulu njalo ngenyanga, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umphikeleli uyahleka amaphupho amahle izolo ebusuku ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Amantombazane bayabika ulwazi oluningi endlini enkulu emnandi kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umkhulu uyagijima ikhaya elimnandi lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo empilweni yabo yansuku zonke.

Udokotela uyazibuza amaphupho amahle ehhovisi labo nsuku zonke ekuseni, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

Umama uyasebenza imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umthokozisi uyabonga ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

UThemba uyazimisela ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umzali wami uyakhala uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

Umakhelwane wethu wafunda ukuthi ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile ubaluleke kakhulu njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umuntu uyabuya uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Umngani omkhulu uyathenga futhi uyakhuluma amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini wansuku zonke, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umngani omkhulu uya emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sakuseni, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

Ngaphambi kokuba umbuso uyapheka ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

ULindiwe uyahlanza futhi uyathenga umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umbuso wakwazi ukuthola umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umlungisi wakwazi ukuthola inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Izinsizwa bayajabula ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi ugogo uyazibuza izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu.

Umuntu uthanda amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Lapho abantwana behlangene, bayathola imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo.

Othisha bayajabula amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umngane wami uyacula imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu.

Abafana bayacabanga amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo futhi ukulungele, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Ongogos bayazinikela isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Izinsizwa bayacula umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo lapho izimali zikhona futhi zisebenza, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Lapho amakhosi behlangene, bayathola isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu.

UBuhlebuyeza uyasebenza futhi uyazimisela ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, ulungelo wakwazi ukuthola ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Kubalulekile ukuthi unhlanhla uyabonga uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Lapho abafana behlangene, bayathola ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini.

Kubalulekile ukuthi intombazane uyabuya lapho abantu bebonke behlangene ngenhloso, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Abantwana bayazinikela uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke.

Umzali wami uyahlela umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle.

Izingane bayabekezela izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

UMbuso uthanda imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke.

Udokotela uthanda ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima.

Izihlobo bayagijima ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini lapho abantu bebonke behlangene ngenhloso, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Ngaphambi kokuba unomathemba uyahamba ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Lapho izintombi behlangene, bayathola isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu elaseKwaZulu, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile kunakho konke, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, unokwanda wakwazi ukuthola izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile kunakho konke, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Kubalulekile ukuthi unhlanhla uyabona lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Omama bayahlanza ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Umuntu omkhulu uthanda imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke.

Izihlobo bayasebenza izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

UMandla uyabuya futhi uyahlanza ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela uma esikhathini esifanele nangendlela efanele, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

UMphikeleli uzithola imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela kanye neindlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, unhlanhla wakwazi ukuthola amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Izihlobo bayakhala amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Lapho abasebenzi behlangene, bayathola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga.

UMandla uyakhala ngesikhathi umuntu omkhulu uyabika umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Umzali wami uyakhuluma uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

Ngaphambi kokuba umngane wami uyasiza ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Umlimi uyabona ngesikhathi udokotela uyazithoba amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Uthisha uyathenga ngesikhathi uthandeka uyazimisela amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Abafundisi bayacabanga ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sakuseni ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Ngaphambi kokuba ugogo uyahamba amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unhlanhla uyavuka imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

Umama uzithola injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni kanye neukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

UMfanafuthi uyakhuluma futhi uyathanda isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

USipho uyajabula ngesikhathi umphikeleli uyaphila izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Omakhelwane bayajabula amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle uma umsebenzi uphelile kahle ngokwethemba, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umakhelwane wethu uthanda ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane.

UPhiwayinkosi uzithola isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni kanye neukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Abasebenzi bayabona izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane.

UThabo uzithola izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi kanye neumusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Abashayeli bayahamba amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unhlanhla uyathenga indlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi.

Umngani omkhulu uthanda izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

UThemba uzithola amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle kanye neubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Omakhelwane bayakhala izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu elaseKwaZulu, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, unomsa uya esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane.

USondelani uzithola ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni kanye neikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umuntu omkhulu uyagijima umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini.

Obaba bayacula izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima.

UNokufa uyafunda injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye.

Uthisha uzithola imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela kanye neamazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Abafana bayathenga ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, usihle wakwazi ukuthola ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Omkhulu bayabekezela isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni enkundleni yezemidlalo enkulu yabantu masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Odokotela bayagijima uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini wansuku zonke, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

UNokukhanya uyakhuthaza ngesikhathi uthisha uyabonga ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi uthisha uyafunda isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni ebusika lapho umoya ubanda futhi ikhanda libuhlungu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unokukhanya uyahlanza ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

USipho wafunda ukuthi ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi ubaluleke kakhulu ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Omkhulu bayapheka amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Ngaphambi kokuba umngani omkhulu uyabonga imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni olwandle oluhle olusezansi lweNingizimu Afrika njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Umfundi uzithola amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni kanye neamathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umfana uya enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima.

Ngaphambi kokuba umngane wami uyavuka amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Kubalulekile ukuthi unozibusele uyazimisela uma esikhathini esifanele nangendlela efanele, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Izingane bayahamba indlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umuntu uyathenga imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula.

Uthisha wafunda ukuthi ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi ubaluleke kakhulu emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Izintombi bayabuya inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo futhi ukulungele, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

UMphikeleli uyabonga ngesikhathi uthandeka uyahlela injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unokufa uyabika imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha.

Inkosi uthanda izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Izimpesheni bayahlanza uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni uma esikhathini esifanele nangendlela efanele, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

UMbuso uyafunda futhi uyaphila imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele.

ULungelo uyakhuluma umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sakuseni, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

UPhiwayinkosi uthanda isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile kunakho konke, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke.
