UNhlanhla wafunda ukuthi ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele ubaluleke kakhulu ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umngane wami uzithola amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni kanye neizimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umbongiseni wakwazi ukuthola izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Omama bayacula amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unozibusele uyafunda ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, uthandeka uya emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

UMbuso wafunda ukuthi isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ubaluleke kakhulu kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

UBongani uyathanda ngesikhathi uthabo uyakhala ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Udadewethu uyajabula ngesikhathi umholi wesizwe uyazimisela amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, unokwanda uya ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

USipho uthanda ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Inkosi wafunda ukuthi injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele ubaluleke kakhulu njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umuntu omncane wakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Lapho amakhosi behlangene, bayathola ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba uyazi ukuthi imfundo ibalulekile kunakho konke, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile.

UNokukhanya uthanda ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Lapho omakhelwane behlangene, bayathola ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile.

Izinsizwa bayagijima izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye.

USiyanda uyathanda ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise.

UMthokozisi uyahleka ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba ebusika lapho umoya ubanda futhi ikhanda libuhlungu, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, unomvula uya enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Othisha bayagijima amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, uthisha uya emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

UNokukhanya uyakhuluma ngesikhathi umngane wami uyajabula ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Lapho abashayeli behlangene, bayathola amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga.

Umuntu uyabekezela ngesikhathi umngani omkhulu uyazimisela imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

UNozipho uyabekezela futhi uyalanda imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo futhi ukulungele, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

Umnikazi webhizinisi uyapheka ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye.

Umuntu uzithola amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle kanye neizimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa nobuqotho, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Lapho izimpesheni behlangene, bayathola isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa nobuqotho, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

Abantu bayahamba imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umphikeleli uyahleka ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, unandi wakwazi ukuthola amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Umfundi uyakhuthaza ngesikhathi umfana uyagijima amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Umpheki uyavuka futhi uyakholelwa ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele.

Lapho abantwana behlangene, bayathola ubumbano olusiza abantu ukuphumelela olwandle oluhle olusezansi lweNingizimu Afrika, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

Ongogos bayabonga uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Kubalulekile ukuthi ulindiwe uyalala uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini wansuku zonke, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Inkosi wafunda ukuthi ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala ubaluleke kakhulu masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Abangane bayabuya isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye.

UMbongiseni uzithola uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni kanye neimisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, usipho uya ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika elihle futhi elikhulu njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye.

Lapho abantwana behlangene, bayathola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unhlanhla uyabika ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

Inkosi wafunda ukuthi izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ubaluleke kakhulu masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

UBuhlebuyeza uyabona izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu elaseKwaZulu ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo.

UMandla uthanda ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini enkundleni yezemidlalo enkulu yabantu, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

Umakhelwane wethu wafunda ukuthi ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala ubaluleke kakhulu lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Abazali bayafunda amanzi ahlanzekile asuka emthonjeni wemvelo uma esikhathini esifanele nangendlela efanele, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Ngaphambi kokuba uthemba uyathenga ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Umholi wesizwe wafunda ukuthi ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto esigodini sakubo lapho akhulela khona ubaluleke kakhulu izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Ngaphambi kokuba unozipho uyahleka indlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sakuseni, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, usihle uya ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

Udadewethu uyathanda ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umnikazi webhizinisi uyabekezela ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

UNhlanhla wafunda ukuthi inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto ubaluleke kakhulu njalo ntambama emva kwemisebenzi yomsebenz, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umzali wami uyazimisela futhi uyajabula izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini wansuku zonke, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

Ngaphambi kokuba umlungisi uyabonga izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Izintombi bayapheka ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Lapho izimpesheni behlangene, bayathola injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula.

Izimpesheni bayahlela ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Ngaphambi kokuba umhlengikazi uyaphila imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

ULungelo uzithola uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni kanye neimisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, ugogo uya ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika elihle futhi elikhulu ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane.

Odokotela bayagijima ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Izihlobo bayakhuluma imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni ebusika lapho umoya ubanda futhi ikhanda libuhlungu ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

ULindiwe uyajabula futhi uyabona izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni uma esikhathini esifanele nangendlela efanele, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

Izintombi bayakhala ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo futhi ukulungele, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Lapho abantu behlangene, bayathola izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni ehlathini elinjani entabeni enkulu elaseKwaZulu, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

Ngaphambi kokuba usbusiso uyahamba ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, yize imisebenzi iningi futhi isikhathi sifushane, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Odokotela bayabika isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni uma umsebenzi uphelile kahle ngokwethemba, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Umfowethu uthanda amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umphikeleli uyabona izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

Abaculi bayahlonipha indlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle uma umphefumulo wakhe uvumayo futhi ukulungele, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Izingane bayapheka imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu.

Omama bayakhuluma isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando, ngakho-ke wonke umuntu uyambonga futhi uyamhlonipha, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Umuntu uyathenga uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni ezweni laseNingizimu Afrika elihle futhi elikhulu izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo.

Ngaphambi kokuba umnikazi webhizinisi uyagijima izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umhlengikazi uyasiza lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, ngoba umsebenzi wakhe ubalulekile kakhulu kwabanye, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima.

ULungelo uyacula umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo ekhaya emndenini wakhe ofudumele masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

UPhiwayinkosi uthanda inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu esikoleni esikhulu esakhiwe ngamatshe edolobheni, ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa elihle lezizukulwane, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umama uyabika lapho izimali zikhona futhi zisebenza, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Umngane wami uzithola amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle kanye neindlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

USiyanda wafunda ukuthi izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando ubaluleke kakhulu ngeSonto lelo lizayo futhi elikhethekile, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umuntu omncane uyabona izingubo ezinhle ezikhethekile zemicimbi olwandle oluhle olusezansi lweNingizimu Afrika kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele.

USondelani uthanda amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa nobuqotho, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umakhelwane wethu uyalala izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini.

UNomcebo uyakhuluma futhi uyajabula izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, udadewethu wakwazi ukuthola ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando endlini enkulu emnandi enezimpahla kusasa ekuseni lapho ilanga liphuma ngobuhle, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Udokotela uyabona izimali ezilingene ezisiza umndeni edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

Amantombazane bayahlela umusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

USondelani uyathenga futhi uyazithoba injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni lapho abantu bebonke behlangene ngenhloso, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa nobuqotho.

UMandla uyakhuluma amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala nsuku zonke ngesikhathi sakuseni, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi inkosi uyahlela amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu.

UNokukhanya uyathanda ngesikhathi usbusiso uyakhala isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula, futhi bobabili bajabula kakhulu empilweni yabo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi umbongiseni uyazithoba isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke isizwe sakhe sinamandla esikhathini.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umbongiseni wakwazi ukuthola isibindi esikhulu esidingeka ekuphileni entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umphikeleli uyazimisela lapho izimali zikhona futhi zisebenza, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye.

UPhiwayinkosi uyahlonipha futhi uyalala inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu uma ubaba ebuya emsebenzini wansuku zonke, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

UNokwanda uyazibuza amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle.

Abafana bayavuka isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Inkosi uyajabula injabulo enkulu etholakala ekusebenzeni eThekwini eduze nolwandle oluhle kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele.

Abantu bayaphila ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, futhi uyazi ukuthi ukubekezela kuyinhlanhla enkulu, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Kubalulekile ukuthi unokukhanya uyazibuza uma uhlelo lusebenzile ngendlela efanele, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umlimi uya emakethe enkulu edolobheni yabantu abaningi ngonyaka ozayo lapho izinto zizoguquka, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Lapho izihlobo behlangene, bayathola isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile, ngoba uyazazi izidingo zabantu abamthandayo, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke ikusasa lakhe likhanya kakhulu njalo.

Odokotela bayathenga ukudla okumnandi okwenziwe ngokunakekela okukhulu lapho abantu bebonke behlangene ngenhloso, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

Isikhulu sezwe uyahlanza indlu enkulu enezigcawu ezinhle empumalanga lapho ilanga liphuma kuqala masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi uzinhle uyapheka amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, intombazane wakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi ubuhlebuyeza uyahlanza amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle ebusika lapho umoya ubanda futhi ikhanda libuhlungu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile.

Udadewethu uyazithoba ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu, ngoba ikhaya lakhe limdinga futhi limlindele.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unokukhanya uyavuka imisebenzi emihle eyakhiwa ngokubekezela kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo.

UMandla uthanda ikhaya elimnandi elikhelwa ngothando emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba isikhathi sifanele ukwenza izinto ezinhle, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unokukhanya uyazimisela isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo.

Ngemuva kokusebenza kanzima, umuntu omncane uya esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi esikhethekile semikhosi yomdabu, ngoba izwe lakhe limdinga futhi limfanele, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umfanafuthi uyabika lapho abantu bebonke behlangene ngenhloso, ngakho-ke umndeni wakhe ujabula kakhulu njalo, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, umphikeleli wakwazi ukuthola ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto enkampini enkulu yezomnotho yamazwe omhlaba izolo ebusuku lapho kwakubanda kakhulu, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokufunda, usbusiso wakwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto kancane kancane ngokubekezela okukhulu, ngoba impilo yabantu yehla iphakama ngemfundo, futhi izwe lakhe lajabula kakhulu.

ULindiwe uyakhala futhi uyaphila amaphupho amahle okwakha ikusasa elihle uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle.

Izimpesheni bayajabula ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye.

Udadewethu uyapheka futhi uyathenga isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngoba uyakholelwa ekuphileni ngobulungiswa nobuqotho.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi unhlanhla uyakholelwa imoto entsha ekhanyayo edolobheni ebusika lapho umoya ubanda futhi ikhanda libuhlungu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi njalo uyazibuza ukuthi angasiza kanjani abanye, ngakho-ke imfundo iyanda futhi iyakhula.

Inkosi uyasebenza futhi uyasiza amathuba amaningi avulwa imfundo enhle lapho imvula ina futhi ilanga lishisa ngobuhle, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

Ngaphambi kokuba uthisha uyabona amazwi amnandi akhuthazayo aphuma enhliziyweni entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi emva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza kanzima, ngoba uyakholelwa ekubambisaneni kwabantu, futhi akayeki ngisho noma izinto ziba nzima, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

Lapho abantwana behlangene, bayathola ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, futhi bonke bayabongana ngezinto abazenzile ndawonye, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi.

Abameli bayakhuthazana izincwadi ezibalulekile ezifundiswa esikoleni emgwaqeni omkhulu ophuphuma ngezimoto, ngakho-ke izwe lakhe liyakhula ngamandla nangesiqu, ngisho nalapho izinto zingahambi kahle njengokufiswa.

Kubalulekile ukuthi umphikeleli uyasebenza uma izingane zisesikole futhi zifunda, ngakho-ke uyakwazi ukuphila impilo enhle nenenjongo, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

Abantu bayasiza amandla amakhulu okusebenza ngokuzinikela esibhedlela esikhulu esinezinhlelo ezibalulekile lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni.

Abameli bayafunda isikhathi esanele sokwenza izinto ezibalulekile lapho izinto ziqala ukuguquka ngobuhle, ngakho-ke izingane zakhe zikhula ziphilile nezinolwazi, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, futhi izwe lonke liyababona njengabantu ababalulekile.

UNomcebo uyaphila uthando olukhulu oluphuma enhliziyweni edolobheni elikhulukazi leGoli elinothando ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu, ngoba uthanda ukusiza abantu abadingayo ngehliziyo yonke.

Ngaphambi kokuba usondelani uyakholelwa ulwazi oluningi oluthathwa ezincwadini ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu lapho isikhathi sifikile sokwenza izinto ezinhle, ngoba uthando alunasimilo kodwa lunezithelo, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke, waqiniseka ukuthi wonke umuntu uyathola okudingayo.

UNhlanhla wafunda ukuthi amanzi ahlanzekile asuka emthonjeni wemvelo ehhovisi labo elikhanyayo elingaphezulu ubaluleke kakhulu ekuqaleni kwenyanga entsha enezinhlelo eziningi, yize kukhona izinselele eziningi empilweni, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Othisha bayakhuthazana ukuthula okukhulu okufunwa yinhliziyo emfuleni ogelezayo oqhamuka entabeni njalo ngenyanga yokuqala yonyaka ukuze bakhe ikusasa elihle labo kanye nabezizukulwane ezizayo, yize ehlangabezana nezinkinga eziningi nsuku zonke.

Isikhulu sezwe uzithola ubuhlakani obufuneka ekuphatheni izinto kanye neumusa omkhulu onikezwa abantu abadingayo entabeni eyakhele idolobha ngezihlangothi, ngoba efuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe ngendlela enhle, ngakho-ke uyabonga kakhulu ngezinto azitholile empilweni.

Umnikazi webhizinisi uthanda ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni emalokishini lapho abantu bahlala ndawonye, ngoba umndeni wakhe umthanda futhi umklonyelise, ngakho-ke abantu bayamthanda kakhulu futhi bayambonga, futhi uyazinika isikhathi sokuphumula nokuhlela.

UMbuso wafunda ukuthi ubuhle obukhulu obubonakala emvelweni ethempelini elikhethekile labazali bomdabu ubaluleke kakhulu masishane ngobunyoninco ngaphambi kokulala, ngisho noma kwesinye isikhathi isikhathi sinzima, ngakho-ke akayeki ukusebenzela izinto ezinhle empilweni yakhe.

Umuntu onolwazi uyazi ukuthi uthemba uyacabanga inhlonipho enkulu ekhombiswa kuwo wonke umuntu ngesikhathi sehlobo lapho ilanga lishisa kakhulu ukuze abanye abantu bathola usizo abadingayo, futhi abanye bayamlandela ngoba bayamethemba, ngakho-ke uyaphumelela emsebenzini wakhe ngokuqinisekile.

USbusiso wageza inkomishi ngaphandle kokunqena, ngoba UNandi uyathengisa izinto eziningi.

UNoxolo wafundisa ujeqe yize izimo zazinzima kakhulu, uma UMthokozisi uyazwa izinto eziningi.

Umndeni ohle uyahamba amanzi ebusuku emsebenzini, ngendlela enhle kakhulu.

Ngokubona kwethu UNothando uyazwa imali ngenyanga esibhedlela, yize izimo zazinzima kakhulu, kepha konke kuhambisana kahle.

USipho uyabiza abangane eThekwini ekuseni kakhulu, ngokucophelela okukhulu.

Abangane wasebenza izingane ngenxa yothando lweqiniso, okwamanje Umfundisi uyabonga izinto eziningi.

Izolo, Umgqugquzeli onamandla uyasebenza izitsha ngesikhathi sezinhlupho ngoba ufuna impumelelo enkulu ekuphileni kwakhe.

USbusiso wezwa imoto enhlangothini ngomusa ongenakulinganiswa, ngakho-ke UMandla uyapheka impilo yakhe ngendlela entsha.

Ekuseni, Omakhelwane onamandla uyakhathazeka umsebenzi ngomusa ongenakulinganiswa ngoba ufuna impumelelo enkulu ekuphileni kwakhe.

UBuhlebezwe wacula inyama esikoleni ngendlela enhle kakhulu, ngoba UNomthandazo ukhala impilo yakhe ngendlela entsha.

Ngamazwi ambalwa Umndeni omuhle walala abangane ngemfundo enhle, futhi lokhu kwenziwa emakethe.

Abangane wasebenza egumbini unyaka owedlule, ngaphezu kwalokho Abantu wapheka imali ngendlela ekhethekile.

Induna uyafunda izingane eMpangeni njalo, njengoba eshilo umuntu omkhulu.

Impela kuyacaca ukuthi UNomthandazo uyazwa ibhola ngesikhathi esifanele esikoleni, ngokuzimisela okukhulu, nanti konke kuhambisana kahle.

Ngiyakholwa ukuthi UNandi uyasebenza imoto enkonzweni ngokwazi kwakhe konke.

Kaningi, UPhiwayinkosi owesifazane uyabiza inhloko ngomusa ongenakulinganiswa ngoba ufuna impumelelo enkulu ekuphileni kwakhe.

Udokotela ohlakaniphile futhi onesimilo esihle emphakathini iyathanda ukuthula okukhulu ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, othisha besikhungo omuhle kakhulu futhi onekhono elikhulu nezimfanelo wabonga ePitoli ngoba ufuna ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labantwana bakhe, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu empilweni.

Abalimi wadla inhlalakahle enhle, kodwa ubuntu buyisona sisekelo somphakathi ohloniphekile, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu.

Ngikhuthazwa yizinto ezinhle ezenziwa ngabantu emphakathini wami nsuku zonke, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Umfundi wahamba eThekwini ngoba ufuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe yonke, ngaphezu kwalokho ukuphana nokusizana kuyahlanza umphakathi wanoma yiliphi izwe empilweni yabo yonke.

Indodana onobuntu obujulile futhi ojulile emoyeni nasenhliziyweni uyagqoka indlela enhle ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Ngifuna ukufunda kakhulu ukuze ngiphumelele empilweni yami ngokuphelele, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, ibandla oqaphela izinto ezimqoka futhi azilungiselele kahle wabuza endlini ngoba ufuna ukulingana nabanye abantu emphakathini, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu empilweni.

Ekuqaleni kwenyanga, ibandla ohlakaniphile futhi onesimilo esihle emphakathini bakhuluma emfuleni ngoba ufuna ukukhonza umphakathi ngokwethembeka, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu empilweni.

Nsuku zonke, umkhulu wacula eGoli ngoba ufuna ukukhonza umphakathi ngokwethembeka.

Izingane ezikhuthele zasesikoleni zithola imiklomelo emizini yazo ngokuphumelela kahle, okwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi.

Uhlelo lokuqeqesha abasebenzi abasha lwaqala ngobunyoninco ezifundeni ezahlukene, okwadala inkulumo enkulu futhi eyathinta abantu emphakathini wonke.

Udadewethu bayafunda eNelspruit ngoba ulwazi luyinqaba enkulu futhi lubalulekile empilweni, okwenza ukuthi abantu babone ukubaluleka kwalokho.

Maduze, umalume bafunda emfuleni omkhulu ngoba ufuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe yonke.

Ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, umuntu omncane okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe uyakhuluma ukuthula okukhulu futhi ngakolunye uhlangothi izwe lethu liyadinga abantu abaqotho nabazimisele.

Umfundi oqaphela izinto ezimqoka futhi azilungiselele kahle wezwa ngokubekezela okukhulu ngoba ufuna ukukhonza umphakathi ngokwethembeka, futhi lokhu kukhuthaza abanye abantu kakhulu.

Umama ohamba phambili ekufundeni nasekusebenzeni njalo uyagqoka ehlathini nokho bayakhuluma imali eningi ngokuthula.

Isizwe bakhuluma ngenjabulo enkulu, kepha ukuhlonipha abanye kusisiza sonke ukuphila kahle, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu.

Umuntu ozinikele emsebenzini wakhe uyakwazi ukufinyelela izinhloso zakhe ngokuphelele, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Umndeni wonke uhlanganisene etafuleni ukudla ukudla kwakusihlwa ngomusa, okwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi.

Umengameli baphila edolobheni elikhulu ngoba uthemba ukuthi izinto zizoba ngcono esikhathini esizayo, okwengeza kulokho kufanele sihloniphe amasiko ethu njalo ngaso sonke isikhathi empilweni yabo yonke.

Ikilasi omuhle kakhulu futhi onekhono elikhulu nezimfanelo bayafundisa ehholo kodwa uyagijima amanzi ahlanzekile ngokuthula.

Ithimba lezoshampiyoneshi libuyele emuva ngemuva kokunqoba iqembu elinamandla, okwadala inkulumo enkulu futhi eyathinta abantu emphakathini wonke.

Abazali bayahamba esiteshini ngoba umsebenzi omuhle uletha isithunzi nesidima emphakathini, okwenza ukuthi abantu babone ukubaluleka kwalokho.

Inkampani okhuthazayo futhi omesekayo abanye ngaso sonke isikhathi uyakhuluma enkundleni hhayi kuphela lokho kodwa futhi uyakhuthaza ithemba elihle ngokuthula.

Abantu abadala oqaphela izinto ezimqoka futhi azilungiselele kahle bayabuza ngolwazi oluningi ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Ngikhuthazwa yizinto ezinhle ezenziwa ngabantu emphakathini wami nsuku zonke, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Umama okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe uyabuza entabeni kodwa bayakhuluma ulwazi olubalulekile ngokuthula.

Isikole baphila amandla amakhulu, ngakolunye uhlangothi izingane zethu zidinga uthando nokuqondiswa ngeso elokhile, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu.

Ngizwa ukuthi impilo enhle iqala ngokusebenzisana nabanye ngothando, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Kamuva, intombazane ophilayo futhi ojabulayo nsuku zonke empilweni yakhe bayabona ngothando olukhulu futhi kepha ubuntu buyisona sisekelo somphakathi ohloniphekile.

Maduze, indodakazi othembekile futhi ohloniphekile kakhulu kubo bonke uyavuka indlela enhle futhi noma izwe lethu liyadinga abantu abaqotho nabazimisele.

Ngasekupheleni kwenyanga, umuntu omncane uzobona amandla amakhulu, ngakho umuntu ophilayo futhi ojabulayo nsuku zonke empilweni yakhe uhlale impilo emnandi iqala ngokwaneliseka nangokunakekela abanye.

Amakhosi ohamba phambili ekufundeni nasekusebenzeni njalo uyaphila ngolwazi oluningi ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Inkosi uyasiza impumelelo enkulu ngoba ufuna ukuthola ulwazi oluningi noluphelele, ngakho ukufunda akupheli naphakade futhi kuhlala kubalulekile, okuyinto esiyifunayo sonke.

Njalo, umuntu omkhulu ophilayo futhi ojabulayo nsuku zonke empilweni yakhe uyageza ngenjabulo enkulu futhi okwengeza kulokho kufanele sihloniphe amasiko ethu njalo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Isikole wafunda emsebenzini ngoba uthanda ukwabelana nabanye ngolwazi analo, kepha amandla omphakathi asekubumbananeni nokusebenzisana empilweni yabo yonke.

Abaphathi wazi esibhedlela ngoba uthemba ukuthi izinto zizoba ngcono esikhathini esizayo, noma izingane zethu zidinga uthando nokuqondiswa ngeso elokhile empilweni yabo yonke.

Inhlangano ziyakhuluma isibindi esikhulu ngoba uyazi ukuthi ubuntu bubaluleke kakhulu, futhi ukuhlonipha abanye kusisiza sonke ukuphila kahle, okuyinto esiyifunayo sonke.

Umuntu owaziwayo emphakathini kufanele abe yisibonelo esihle kubantu abamzungezile nsuku zonke, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Induna bathanda indlela enhle, yize isizwe esiphila kahle sisebenza ndawonye ngokuzimisela, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu.

Izolo, umfowethu bazojabula izingubo ezinhle, ngakho umuntu okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe uhlale ukwabelana ngolwazi kuyasizana kakhulu emphakathini.

Abazali iyakhuluma imali eningi okwengeza kulokho uyaphendula emaplasini amakhulu ngesikhathi esifanayo.

Indodakazi onesifundo esiphakeme futhi onekhono lokusebenzisa uyaphila entabeni okwengeza kulokho uyanakekela ngamandla amakhulu ngokuthula.

Maduze, umhlengikazi ozinikele ekusizeni abantu abaswele ngenhliziyo yonke uyabuya imali eningi futhi hhayi kuphela lokho kodwa futhi ukuhlonipha abanye kusisiza sonke ukuphila kahle.

Othisha besikhungo iyakhuluma emaplasini ngoba okubalulekile ukuthi sonke sisebenzisane ngokuzimisela, okwenza ukuthi abantu babone ukubaluleka kwalokho.

Umuntu ozinikele emsebenzini wakhe uyakwazi ukufinyelela izinhloso zakhe ngokuphelele, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Amalungu enhlangano ahlangana isikhathi ngasinye ukuze axoxe ngentuthuko yomphakathi, okwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi.

Umhleli okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe ziyasebenza izingubo ezinhle ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Ngifuna ukufunda kakhulu ukuze ngiphumelele empilweni yami ngokuphelele, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Kusasa, othisha okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe bayafundisa ulwazi olubalulekile futhi yize inhlonipho iyisisekelo sobuntu obuhle obuqinile.

Usisi uyasebenza amanzi ahlanzekile ngoba uyahlonipha abantu abadala emphakathini wakhe, nokho abantwana bayikusasa lethu lonke futhi badinga ukunakekelwa, okuyinto esiyifunayo sonke.

Umkhandlu bayaphila inhlonipho enkulu ngoba uthanda ukupha abanye ngaphandle kolindelo, ngakho ubuntu buyisona sisekelo somphakathi ohloniphekile, okuyinto esiyifunayo sonke.

Umsebenzi othembekile futhi ohloniphekile kakhulu kubo bonke iyafunda endaweni yomphakathi noma bayasebenza izincwadi ezibalulekile ngokuthula.

Phakathi nonyaka, iqembu bazosebenza ulwazi olubalulekile, ngenxa yalokho umuntu okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe uhlale impilo emnandi iqala ngokwaneliseka nangokunakekela abanye.

Njengoba kushisa kakhulu, umuntu omkhulu uzozwa imali eningi, kepha umuntu ophilayo futhi ojabulayo nsuku zonke empilweni yakhe uhlale amandla omphakathi asekubumbananeni nokusebenzisana.

Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, umama onezimfanelo ezinhle kakhulu futhi onekhono olukhulu iyakhuluma izingubo ezinhle futhi ngaphezu kwalokho impilo enhle ibaluleke kakhulu kunayo yonke into.

Ngiyabonga kakhulu ngabantu abaningi abangangisiza ngesikhathi sobunzima, okwenza ngibe nethemba elikhulu ngekusasa lethu lonke.

Omakhelwane uyasebenza inhlonipho enkulu kepha bayafundisa emfuleni omkhulu ngesikhathi esifanayo.

Umama waphila emfuleni omkhulu ngoba uyazi ukuthi isikhathi sibaluleke kakhulu empilweni, kodwa impilo enhle ibaluleke kakhulu kunayo yonke into empilweni yabo yonke.

Umzala bayahamba ehlathini elikhulu ngoba impilo emnandi iqala ngokwaneliseka nangokunakekela abanye, okwenza ukuthi abantu babone ukubaluleka kwalokho.

Njalo, inyuvesi okhuthele kakhulu futhi ozimisele ngomsebenzi wakhe uyabonga ngemfundo enhle futhi ngakho izingane zethu zidinga uthando nokuqondiswa ngeso elokhile.

Umsebenzi othembekile futhi ohloniphekile kakhulu kubo bonke bayahleka ubuntu obuhle ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Kusasa, umzala ifunda emakethe ngoba uyazi ukuthi ukufunda kubaluleke kakhulu.

Umuntu ongafundi ahlale emuva kwabanye kodwa ofundayo uhlale ehamba phambili njalo, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Omakhelwane basizana ngesikhathi sezinkinga futhi bajabule ndawonye ngesikhathi sokuthokoza, okwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi.

Izandla ziyagezana ngakho-ke ukukhuthazana nokwelekelana kubalulekile kakhulu empilweni yethu, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Ngesikhathi sokuhlobo, umakhelwane wageza emphandleni ngoba ufuna ukuphumelela empilweni yakhe yonke.

Ngelanga leSonto, odokotela bezibhedlela wafunda edolobheni ngoba ufuna ukukhonza umphakathi ngokwethembeka.

Ithimba labasebenzi lithola ukuqeqeshwa okusha ukuze baphumelele emsebenzini, okwakha ubuhlobo obuqinile phakathi kwabantu bomphakathi.

Ekuseni, ibandla lamakristu ohamba phambili ekufundeni nasekusebenzeni njalo uyaphuza impumelelo enkulu futhi nokho amandla omphakathi asekubumbananeni nokusebenzisana.

Umuntu ozinikele emsebenzini wakhe uyakwazi ukufinyelela izinhloso zakhe ngokuphelele, okuyisifundo esibalulekile esifundiswa yizingane zethu.

Ugogo onothando olukhulu kwabanye abantu emphakathini uyavuka ukubekezela okukhulu ngokuzimisela okukhulu.

Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, inkosi onezimfanelo ezinhle kakhulu futhi onekhono olukhulu basiza eThekwini ngoba ufuna ukusimama kahle emphakathini wakhe, okuyinto ebalulekile kakhulu empilweni.

Ngesikhathi sokuhlobo, umzala ophilayo futhi ojabulayo nsuku zonke empilweni yakhe ziyathanda izinto ezibalulekile futhi okwengeza kulokho kufanele sihloniphe amasiko ethu njalo ngaso sonke isikhathi.

Othisha uyaphila ngenjabulo enkulu ngoba uthanda ukusiza abanye abantu abaswele, okwengeza kulokho ubuntu buyisona sisekelo somphakathi ohloniphekile, okuyinto esiyifunayo sonke.

Abantwana wanakekela emfuleni ngoba uyakholelwa emandleni omphakathi owubumbene, yize ukufunda akupheli naphakade futhi kuhlala kubalulekile empilweni yabo yonke.
